verses.Ps.90.7: For we are consumed in thine anger, And in thy wrath are we troubled.
verses.Ps.90.8: Thou hast set our iniquities before thee, Our secret sins in the light of thy countenance.
verses.Ps.90.9: For all our days are passed away in thy wrath: We bring our years to an end as a sigh.
verses.Ps.90.10: The days of our years are threescore years and ten, Or even by reason of strength fourscore years; Yet is their pride but labor and sorrow; For it is soon gone, and we fly away.
verses.Ps.90.11: Who knoweth the power of thine anger, And thy wrath according to the fear that is due unto thee?
verses.Ps.90.12: So teach us to number our days, That we may get us a heart of wisdom.
verses.Ps.90.13: Return, O Jehovah; how long? And let it repent thee concerning thy servants.
verses.Ps.90.14: Oh satisfy us in the morning with thy lovingkindness, That we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
verses.Ps.90.15: Make us glad according to the days wherein thou hast afflicted us, And the years wherein we have seen evil.
verses.Ps.90.16: Let thy work appear unto thy servants, And thy glory upon their children.
verses.Ps.90.17: And let the favor of the Lord our God be upon us; And establish thou the work of our hands upon us; Yea, the work of our hands establish thou it.
verses.Ps.91.1: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the Most High Shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
verses.Ps.91.2: I will say of Jehovah, He is my refuge and my fortress; My God, in whom I trust.
verses.Ps.91.3: For he will deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, And from the deadly pestilence.
verses.Ps.91.4: He will cover thee with his pinions, And under his wings shalt thou take refuge: His truth is a shield and a buckler.
verses.Ps.91.5: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night, Nor for the arrow that flieth by day;
verses.Ps.91.6: For the pestilence that walketh in darkness, Nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.
verses.Ps.91.7: A thousand shall fall at thy side, And ten thousand at thy right hand; But it shall not come nigh thee.
verses.Ps.91.8: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold, And see the reward of the wicked.
verses.Ps.91.9: For thou, O Jehovah, art my refuge! Thou hast made the Most High thy habitation;
verses.Ps.91.10: There shall no evil befall thee, Neither shall any plague come nigh thy tent.
verses.Ps.91.11: For he will give his angels charge over thee, To keep thee in all thy ways.
verses.Ps.91.12: They shall bear thee up in their hands, Lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.
verses.Ps.91.13: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder: The young lion and the serpent shalt thou trample under foot.
verses.Ps.91.14: Because he hath set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him: I will set him on high, because he hath known my name.
verses.Ps.91.15: He shall call upon me, and I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble: I will deliver him, and honor him.
verses.Ps.91.16: With long life will I satisfy him, And show him my salvation.
verses.Ps.92.1: A Psalm, a Song for the sabbath day. It is a good thing to give thanks unto Jehovah, And to sing praises unto thy name, O Most High;
verses.Ps.92.2: To show forth thy lovingkindness in the morning, And thy faithfulness every night,
verses.Ps.92.3: With an instrument of ten strings, and with the psaltery; With a solemn sound upon the harp.
verses.Ps.92.4: For thou, Jehovah, hast made me glad through thy work: I will triumph in the works of thy hands.
verses.Ps.92.5: How great are thy works, O Jehovah! Thy thoughts are very deep.
verses.Ps.92.6: A brutish man knoweth not; Neither doth a fool understand this:
verses.Ps.92.7: When the wicked spring as the grass, And when all the workers of iniquity do flourish; It is that they shall be destroyed for ever.
verses.Ps.92.8: But thou, O Jehovah, art on high for evermore.
verses.Ps.92.9: For, lo, thine enemies, O Jehovah, For, lo, thine enemies shall perish; All the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.
verses.Ps.92.10: But my horn hast thou exalted like the horn of the wild-ox: I am anointed with fresh oil.
verses.Ps.92.11: Mine eye also hath seen my desire on mine enemies, Mine ears have heard my desire of the evil-doers that rise up against me.
verses.Ps.92.12: The righteous shall flourish like the palm-tree: He shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
verses.Ps.92.13: They are planted in the house of Jehovah; They shall flourish in the courts of our God.
verses.Ps.92.14: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; They shall be full of sap and green:
verses.Ps.92.15: To show that Jehovah is upright; He is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.
verses.Ps.93.1: Jehovah reigneth; he is clothed with majesty; Jehovah is clothed with strength; he hath girded himself therewith: The world also is established, that it cannot be moved.
verses.Ps.93.2: Thy throne is established of old: Thou art from everlasting.
verses.Ps.93.3: The floods have lifted up, O Jehovah, The floods have lifted up their voice; The floods lift up their waves.
verses.Ps.93.4: Above the voices of many waters, The mighty breakers of the sea, Jehovah on high is mighty.
verses.Ps.93.5: Thy testimonies are very sure: Holiness becometh thy house, O Jehovah, for evermore.
verses.Ps.94.1: O Jehovah, thou God to whom vengeance belongeth, Thou God to whom vengeance belongeth, shine forth.
verses.Ps.94.2: Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth: Render to the proud their desert.
verses.Ps.94.3: Jehovah, how long shall the wicked, How long shall the wicked triumph?
verses.Ps.94.4: They prate, they speak arrogantly: All the workers of iniquity boast themselves.
verses.Ps.94.5: They break in pieces thy people, O Jehovah, And afflict thy heritage.
verses.Ps.94.6: They slay the widow and the sojourner, And murder the fatherless.
verses.Ps.94.7: And they say, Jehovah will not see, Neither will the God of Jacob consider.
verses.Ps.94.8: Consider, ye brutish among the people; And ye fools, when will ye be wise?
verses.Ps.94.9: He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? He that formed the eye, shall he not see?
verses.Ps.94.10: He that chastiseth the nations, shall not he correct, Even he that teacheth man knowledge?
verses.Ps.94.11: Jehovah knoweth the thoughts of man, That they are vanity.
verses.Ps.94.12: Blessed is the man whom thou chastenest, O Jehovah, And teachest out of thy law;
verses.Ps.94.13: That thou mayest give him rest from the days of adversity, Until the pit be digged for the wicked.
verses.Ps.94.14: For Jehovah will not cast off his people, Neither will he forsake his inheritance.
verses.Ps.94.15: For judgment shall return unto righteousness; And all the upright in heart shall follow it.
verses.Ps.94.16: Who will rise up for me against the evil-doers? Who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?
verses.Ps.94.17: Unless Jehovah had been my help, My soul had soon dwelt in silence.
verses.Ps.94.18: When I said, My foot slippeth; Thy lovingkindness, O Jehovah, held me up.
verses.Ps.94.19: In the multitude of my thoughts within me Thy comforts delight my soul.
verses.Ps.94.20: Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with thee, Which frameth mischief by statute?
verses.Ps.94.21: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, And condemn the innocent blood.
verses.Ps.94.22: But Jehovah hath been my high tower, And my God the rock of my refuge.
verses.Ps.94.23: And he hath brought upon them their own iniquity, And will cut them off in their own wickedness; Jehovah our God will cut them off.
verses.Ps.95.1: Oh come, let us sing unto Jehovah; Let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.
verses.Ps.95.2: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving; Let us make a joyful noise unto him with psalms.
verses.Ps.95.3: For Jehovah is a great God, And a great King above all gods.
verses.Ps.95.4: In his hand are the deep places of the earth; The heights of the mountains are his also.
verses.Ps.95.5: The sea is his, and he made it; And his hands formed the dry land.
verses.Ps.95.6: Oh come, let us worship and bow down; Let us kneel before Jehovah our Maker:
verses.Ps.95.7: For he is our God, And we are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. To-day, oh that ye would hear his voice!
verses.Ps.95.8: Harden not your heart, as at Meribah, As in the day of Massah in the wilderness;
verses.Ps.95.9: When your fathers tempted me, Proved me, and saw my work.
verses.Ps.95.10: Forty years long was I grieved with that generation, And said, It is a people that do err in their heart, And they have not known my ways:
verses.Ps.95.11: Wherefore I sware in my wrath, That they should not enter into my rest.
verses.Ps.96.1: Oh sing unto Jehovah a new song: Sing unto Jehovah, all the earth.
verses.Ps.96.2: Sing unto Jehovah, bless his name; Show forth his salvation from day to day.
verses.Ps.96.3: Declare his glory among the nations, His marvellous works among all the peoples.
verses.Ps.96.4: For great is Jehovah, and greatly to be praised: He is to be feared above all gods.
verses.Ps.96.5: For all the gods of the peoples are idols; But Jehovah made the heavens.
verses.Ps.96.6: Honor and majesty are before him: Strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.
verses.Ps.96.7: Ascribe unto Jehovah, ye kindreds of the peoples, Ascribe unto Jehovah glory and strength.
verses.Ps.96.8: Ascribe unto Jehovah the glory due unto his name: Bring an offering, and come into his courts.
verses.Ps.96.9: Oh worship Jehovah in holy array: Tremble before him, all the earth.
verses.Ps.96.10: Say among the nations, Jehovah reigneth: The world also is established that it cannot be moved: He will judge the peoples with equity.
verses.Ps.96.11: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice; Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof;
verses.Ps.96.12: Let the field exult, and all that is therein; Then shall all the trees of the wood sing for joy
verses.Ps.96.13: Before Jehovah; for he cometh, For he cometh to judge the earth: He will judge the world with righteousness, And the peoples with his truth.
verses.Ps.97.1: Jehovah reigneth; let the earth rejoice; Let the multitude of isles be glad.
verses.Ps.97.2: Clouds and darkness are round about him: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.
verses.Ps.97.3: A fire goeth before him, And burneth up his adversaries round about.
verses.Ps.97.4: His lightnings lightened the world: The earth saw, and trembled.
verses.Ps.97.5: The mountains melted like wax at the presence of Jehovah, At the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
verses.Ps.97.6: The heavens declare his righteousness, And all the peoples have seen his glory.
verses.Ps.97.7: Let all them be put to shame that serve graven images, That boast themselves of idols: Worship him, all ye gods.
verses.Ps.97.8: Zion heard and was glad, And the daughters of Judah rejoiced, Because of thy judgments, O Jehovah.
verses.Ps.97.9: For thou, Jehovah, art most high above all the earth: Thou art exalted far above all gods.
verses.Ps.97.10: O ye that love Jehovah, hate evil: He preserveth the souls of his saints; He delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked.
verses.Ps.97.11: Light is sown for the righteous, And gladness for the upright in heart.
verses.Ps.97.12: Be glad in Jehovah, ye righteous; And give thanks to his holy memorial name.
verses.Ps.98.1: A Psalm. Oh sing unto Jehovah a new song; For he hath done marvellous things: His right hand, and his holy arm, hath wrought salvation for him.
verses.Ps.98.2: Jehovah hath made known his salvation: His righteousness hath he openly showed in the sight of the nations.
verses.Ps.98.3: He hath remembered his lovingkindness and his faithfulness toward the house of Israel: All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
verses.Ps.98.4: Make a joyful noise unto Jehovah, all the earth: Break forth and sing for joy, yea, sing praises.
verses.Ps.98.5: Sing praises unto Jehovah with the harp; With the harp and the voice of melody.
verses.Ps.98.6: With trumpets and sound of cornet Make a joyful noise before the King, Jehovah.
verses.Ps.98.7: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; The world, and they that dwell therein;
verses.Ps.98.8: Let the floods clap their hands; Let the hills sing for joy together
verses.Ps.98.9: Before Jehovah; for he cometh to judge the earth: He will judge the world with righteousness, And the peoples with equity.
verses.Ps.99.1: Jehovah reigneth; let the peoples tremble: He sitteth above the cherubim; let the earth be moved.
verses.Ps.99.2: Jehovah is great in Zion; And he is high above all the peoples.
verses.Ps.99.3: Let them praise thy great and terrible name: Holy is he.
verses.Ps.99.4: The king’s strength also loveth justice; Thou dost establish equity; Thou executest justice and righteousness in Jacob.
verses.Ps.99.5: Exalt ye Jehovah our God, And worship at his footstool: Holy is he.
verses.Ps.99.6: Moses and Aaron among his priests, And Samuel among them that call upon his name; They called upon Jehovah, and he answered them.
verses.Ps.99.7: He spake unto them in the pillar of cloud: They kept his testimonies, And the statute that he gave them.
verses.Ps.99.8: Thou answeredst them, O Jehovah our God: Thou wast a God that forgavest them, Though thou tookest vengeance of their doings.
verses.Ps.99.9: Exalt ye Jehovah our God, And worship at his holy hill; For Jehovah our God is holy.
verses.Ps.100.1: A Psalm of thanksgiving. Make a joyful noise unto Jehovah, all ye lands.
verses.Ps.100.2: Serve Jehovah with gladness: Come before his presence with singing.
verses.Ps.100.3: Know ye that Jehovah, he is God: It is he that hath made us, and we are his; We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
verses.Ps.100.4: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, And into his courts with praise: Give thanks unto him, and bless his name.
verses.Ps.100.5: For Jehovah is good; his lovingkindness endureth for ever, And his faithfulness unto all generations.
verses.Ps.101.1: A Psalm of David. I will sing of lovingkindness and justice: Unto thee, O Jehovah, will I sing praises.
verses.Ps.101.2: I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way: Oh when wilt thou come unto me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.
verses.Ps.101.3: I will set no base thing before mine eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside; It shall not cleave unto me.
verses.Ps.101.4: A perverse heart shall depart from me: I will know no evil thing.
verses.Ps.101.5: Whoso privily slandereth his neighbor, him will I destroy: Him that hath a high look and a proud heart will I not suffer.
verses.Ps.101.6: Mine eyes shall be upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me: He that walketh in a perfect way, he shall minister unto me.
verses.Ps.101.7: He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house: He that speaketh falsehood shall not be established before mine eyes.
verses.Ps.101.8: Morning by morning will I destroy all the wicked of the land; To cut off all the workers of iniquity from the city of Jehovah.
verses.Ps.102.1: A Prayer of the afflicted, when he is overwhelmed, and poureth out his complaint before Jehovah. Hear my prayer, O Jehovah, And let my cry come unto thee.
verses.Ps.102.2: Hide not thy face from me in the day of my distress: Incline thine ear unto me; In the day when I call answer me speedily.
verses.Ps.102.3: For my days consume away like smoke, And my bones are burned as a firebrand.
verses.Ps.102.4: My heart is smitten like grass, and withered; For I forget to eat my bread.
verses.Ps.102.5: By reason of the voice of my groaning My bones cleave to my flesh.
verses.Ps.102.6: I am like a pelican of the wilderness; I am become as an owl of the waste places.
verses.Ps.102.7: I watch, and am become like a sparrow That is alone upon the house-top.
verses.Ps.102.8: Mine enemies reproach me all the day; They that are mad against me do curse by me.
verses.Ps.102.9: For I have eaten ashes like bread, And mingled my drink with weeping,
verses.Ps.102.10: Because of thine indignation and thy wrath: For thou hast taken me up, and cast me away.
verses.Ps.102.11: My days are like a shadow that declineth; And I am withered like grass.
verses.Ps.102.12: But thou, O Jehovah, wilt abide for ever; And thy memorial name unto all generations.
verses.Ps.102.13: Thou wilt arise, and have mercy upon Zion; For it is time to have pity upon her, Yea, the set time is come.
verses.Ps.102.14: For thy servants take pleasure in her stones, And have pity upon her dust.
verses.Ps.102.15: So the nations shall fear the name of Jehovah, And all the kings of the earth thy glory.
verses.Ps.102.16: For Jehovah hath built up Zion; He hath appeared in his glory.
verses.Ps.102.17: He hath regarded the prayer of the destitute, And hath not despised their prayer.
verses.Ps.102.18: This shall be written for the generation to come; And a people which shall be created shall praise Jehovah.
verses.Ps.102.19: For he hath looked down from the height of his sanctuary; From heaven did Jehovah behold the earth;
verses.Ps.102.20: To hear the sighing of the prisoner; To loose those that are appointed to death;
verses.Ps.102.21: That men may declare the name of Jehovah in Zion, And his praise in Jerusalem;
verses.Ps.102.22: When the peoples are gathered together, And the kingdoms, to serve Jehovah.
verses.Ps.102.23: He weakened my strength in the way; He shortened my days.
verses.Ps.102.24: I said, O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days: Thy years are throughout all generations.
verses.Ps.102.25: Of old didst thou lay the foundation of the earth; And the heavens are the work of thy hands.
verses.Ps.102.26: They shall perish, but thou shalt endure; Yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment; As a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed:
verses.Ps.102.27: But thou art the same, And thy years shall have no end.
verses.Ps.102.28: The children of thy servants shall continue, And their seed shall be established before thee.
verses.Ps.103.1: A Psalm of David. Bless Jehovah, O my soul; And all that is within me, bless his holy name.
verses.Ps.103.2: Bless Jehovah, O my soul, And forget not all his benefits:
verses.Ps.103.3: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; Who healeth all thy diseases;
verses.Ps.103.4: Who redeemeth thy life from destruction; Who crowneth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies;
verses.Ps.103.5: Who satisfieth thy desire with good things, So that thy youth is renewed like the eagle.
verses.Ps.103.6: Jehovah executeth righteous acts, And judgments for all that are oppressed.
verses.Ps.103.7: He made known his ways unto Moses, His doings unto the children of Israel.
verses.Ps.103.8: Jehovah is merciful and gracious, Slow to anger, and abundant in lovingkindness.
verses.Ps.103.9: He will not always chide; Neither will he keep his anger for ever.
verses.Ps.103.10: He hath not dealt with us after our sins, Nor rewarded us after our iniquities.
verses.Ps.103.11: For as the heavens are high above the earth, So great is his lovingkindness toward them that fear him.
verses.Ps.103.12: As far as the east is from the west, So far hath he removed our transgressions from us.
verses.Ps.103.13: Like as a father pitieth his children, So Jehovah pitieth them that fear him.
verses.Ps.103.14: For he knoweth our frame; He remembereth that we are dust.
verses.Ps.103.15: As for man, his days are as grass; As a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.
verses.Ps.103.16: For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone; And the place thereof shall know it no more.
verses.Ps.103.17: But the lovingkindness of Jehovah is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear him, And his righteousness unto children’s children;
verses.Ps.103.18: To such as keep his covenant, And to those that remember his precepts to do them.
verses.Ps.103.19: Jehovah hath established his throne in the heavens; And his kingdom ruleth over all.
verses.Ps.103.20: Bless Jehovah, ye his angels, That are mighty in strength, that fulfil his word, Hearkening unto the voice of his word.
verses.Ps.103.21: Bless Jehovah, all ye his hosts, Ye ministers of his, that do his pleasure.
verses.Ps.103.22: Bless Jehovah, all ye his works, In all places of his dominion: Bless Jehovah, O my soul.
verses.Ps.104.1: Bless Jehovah, O my soul. O Jehovah my God, thou art very great; Thou art clothed with honor and majesty:
verses.Ps.104.2: Who coverest thyself with light as with a garment; Who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain;
verses.Ps.104.3: Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters; Who maketh the clouds his chariot; Who walketh upon the wings of the wind;
verses.Ps.104.4: Who maketh winds his messengers; Flames of fire his ministers;
verses.Ps.104.5: Who laid the foundations of the earth, That it should not be moved for ever.
verses.Ps.104.6: Thou coveredst it with the deep as with a vesture; The waters stood above the mountains.
verses.Ps.104.7: At thy rebuke they fled; At the voice of thy thunder they hasted away
verses.Ps.104.8: (The mountains rose, the valleys sank down) Unto the place which thou hadst founded for them.
verses.Ps.104.9: Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over; That they turn not again to cover the earth.
verses.Ps.104.10: He sendeth forth springs into the valleys; They run among the mountains;
verses.Ps.104.11: They give drink to every beast of the field; The wild asses quench their thirst.
verses.Ps.104.12: By them the birds of the heavens have their habitation; They sing among the branches.
verses.Ps.104.13: He watereth the mountains from his chambers: The earth is filled with the fruit of thy works.
verses.Ps.104.14: He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle, And herb for the service of man; That he may bring forth food out of the earth,
verses.Ps.104.15: And wine that maketh glad the heart of man, And oil to make his face to shine, And bread that strengtheneth man’s heart.
verses.Ps.104.16: The trees of Jehovah are filled with moisture, The cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted;
verses.Ps.104.17: Where the birds make their nests: As for the stork, the fir-trees are her house.
verses.Ps.104.18: The high mountains are for the wild goats; The rocks are a refuge for the conies.
verses.Ps.104.19: He appointed the moon for seasons: The sun knoweth his going down.
verses.Ps.104.20: Thou makest darkness, and it is night, Wherein all the beasts of the forest creep forth.
verses.Ps.104.21: The young lions roar after their prey, And seek their food from God.
verses.Ps.104.22: The sun ariseth, they get them away, And lay them down in their dens.
verses.Ps.104.23: Man goeth forth unto his work And to his labor until the evening.
verses.Ps.104.24: O Jehovah, how manifold are thy works! In wisdom hast thou made them all: The earth is full of thy riches.
verses.Ps.104.25: Yonder is the sea, great and wide, Wherein are things creeping innumerable, Both small and great beasts.
verses.Ps.104.26: There go the ships; There is leviathan, whom thou hast formed to play therein.
verses.Ps.104.27: These wait all for thee, That thou mayest give them their food in due season.
verses.Ps.104.28: Thou givest unto them, they gather; Thou openest thy hand, they are satisfied with good.
verses.Ps.104.29: Thou hidest thy face, they are troubled; Thou takest away their breath, they die, And return to their dust.
verses.Ps.104.30: Thou sendest forth thy Spirit, they are created; And thou renewest the face of the ground.
verses.Ps.104.31: Let the glory of Jehovah endure for ever; Let Jehovah rejoice in his works:
verses.Ps.104.32: Who looketh on the earth, and it trembleth; He toucheth the mountains, and they smoke.
verses.Ps.104.33: I will sing unto Jehovah as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have any being.
verses.Ps.104.34: Let my meditation be sweet unto him: I will rejoice in Jehovah.
verses.Ps.104.35: Let sinners be consumed out of the earth. And let the wicked be no more. Bless Jehovah, O my soul. Praise ye Jehovah.
verses.Ps.105.1: Oh give thanks unto Jehovah, call upon his name; Make known among the peoples his doings.
verses.Ps.105.2: Sing unto him, sing praises unto him; Talk ye of all his marvellous works.
verses.Ps.105.3: Glory ye in his holy name: Let the heart of them rejoice that seek Jehovah.
verses.Ps.105.4: Seek ye Jehovah and his strength; Seek his face evermore.
verses.Ps.105.5: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done, His wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,
verses.Ps.105.6: O ye seed of Abraham his servant, Ye children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
verses.Ps.105.7: He is Jehovah our God: His judgments are in all the earth.
verses.Ps.105.8: He hath remembered his covenant for ever, The word which he commanded to a thousand generations,
verses.Ps.105.9: The covenant which he made with Abraham, And his oath unto Isaac,
verses.Ps.105.10: And confirmed the same unto Jacob for a statute, To Israel for an everlasting covenant,
verses.Ps.105.11: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, The lot of your inheritance;
verses.Ps.105.12: When they were but a few men in number, Yea, very few, and sojourners in it.
verses.Ps.105.13: And they went about from nation to nation, From one kingdom to another people.
verses.Ps.105.14: He suffered no man to do them wrong; Yea, he reproved kings for their sakes,
verses.Ps.105.15: Saying, Touch not mine anointed ones, And do my prophets no harm.
verses.Ps.105.16: And he called for a famine upon the land; He brake the whole staff of bread.
verses.Ps.105.17: He sent a man before them; Joseph was sold for a servant:
verses.Ps.105.18: His feet they hurt with fetters: He was laid in chains of iron,
verses.Ps.105.19: Until the time that his word came to pass, The word of Jehovah tried him.
verses.Ps.105.20: The king sent and loosed him; Even the ruler of peoples, and let him go free.
verses.Ps.105.21: He made him lord of his house, And ruler of all his substance;
verses.Ps.105.22: To bind his princes at his pleasure, And teach his elders wisdom.
verses.Ps.105.23: Israel also came into Egypt; And Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.
verses.Ps.105.24: And he increased his people greatly, And made them stronger than their adversaries.
verses.Ps.105.25: He turned their heart to hate his people, To deal subtly with his servants.
verses.Ps.105.26: He sent Moses his servant, And Aaron whom he had chosen.
verses.Ps.105.27: They set among them his signs, And wonders in the land of Ham.
verses.Ps.105.28: He sent darkness, and made it dark; And they rebelled not against his words.
verses.Ps.105.29: He turned their waters into blood, And slew their fish.
verses.Ps.105.30: Their land swarmed with frogs In the chambers of their kings.
verses.Ps.105.31: He spake, and there came swarms of flies, And lice in all their borders.
verses.Ps.105.32: He gave them hail for rain, And flaming fire in their land.
verses.Ps.105.33: He smote their vines also and their fig-trees, And brake the trees of their borders.
verses.Ps.105.34: He spake, and the locust came, And the grasshopper, and that without number,
verses.Ps.105.35: And did eat up every herb in their land, And did eat up the fruit of their ground.
verses.Ps.105.36: He smote also all the first-born in their land, The chief of all their strength.
verses.Ps.105.37: And he brought them forth with silver and gold; And there was not one feeble person among his tribes.
verses.Ps.105.38: Egypt was glad when they departed; For the fear of them had fallen upon them.
verses.Ps.105.39: He spread a cloud for a covering, And fire to give light in the night.
verses.Ps.105.40: They asked, and he brought quails, And satisfied them with the bread of heaven.
verses.Ps.105.41: He opened the rock, and waters gushed out; They ran in the dry places like a river.
verses.Ps.105.42: For he remembered his holy word, And Abraham his servant.
verses.Ps.105.43: And he brought forth his people with joy, And his chosen with singing.
verses.Ps.105.44: And he gave them the lands of the nations; And they took the labor of the peoples in possession:
verses.Ps.105.45: That they might keep his statutes, And observe his laws. Praise ye Jehovah.
verses.Ps.106.1: Praise ye Jehovah. Oh give thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever.
verses.Ps.106.2: Who can utter the mighty acts of Jehovah, Or show forth all his praise?
verses.Ps.106.3: Blessed are they that keep justice, And he that doeth righteousness at all times.
verses.Ps.106.4: Remember me, O Jehovah, with the favor that thou bearest unto thy people; Oh visit me with thy salvation,
verses.Ps.106.5: That I may see the prosperity of thy chosen, That I may rejoice in the gladness of thy nation, That I may glory with thine inheritance.
verses.Ps.106.6: We have sinned with our fathers, We have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.
verses.Ps.106.7: Our fathers understood not thy wonders in Egypt; They remembered not the multitude of thy lovingkindnesses, But were rebellious at the sea, even at the Red Sea.
verses.Ps.106.8: Nevertheless he saved them for his name’s sake, That he might make his mighty power to be known.
verses.Ps.106.9: He rebuked the Red Sea also, and it was dried up: So he led them through the depths, as through a wilderness.
verses.Ps.106.10: And he saved them from the hand of him that hated them, And redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
verses.Ps.106.11: And the waters covered their adversaries; There was not one of them left.
verses.Ps.106.12: Then believed they his words; They sang his praise.
verses.Ps.106.13: They soon forgat his works; They waited not for his counsel,
verses.Ps.106.14: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, And tempted God in the desert.
verses.Ps.106.15: And he gave them their request, But sent leanness into their soul.
verses.Ps.106.16: They envied Moses also in the camp, And Aaron the saint of Jehovah.
verses.Ps.106.17: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, And covered the company of Abiram.
verses.Ps.106.18: And a fire was kindled in their company; The flame burned up the wicked.
verses.Ps.106.19: They made a calf in Horeb, And worshipped a molten image.
verses.Ps.106.20: Thus they changed their glory For the likeness of an ox that eateth grass.
verses.Ps.106.21: They forgat God their Saviour, Who had done great things in Egypt,
verses.Ps.106.22: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, And terrible things by the Red Sea.
verses.Ps.106.23: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, Had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach, To turn away his wrath, lest he should destroy them.
verses.Ps.106.24: Yea, they despised the pleasant land, They believed not his word,
verses.Ps.106.25: But murmured in their tents, And hearkened not unto the voice of Jehovah.
verses.Ps.106.26: Therefore he sware unto them, That he would overthrow them in the wilderness,
verses.Ps.106.27: And that he would overthrow their seed among the nations, And scatter them in the lands.
verses.Ps.106.28: They joined themselves also unto Baal-peor, And ate the sacrifices of the dead.
verses.Ps.106.29: Thus they provoked him to anger with their doings; And the plague brake in upon them.
verses.Ps.106.30: Then stood up Phinehas, and executed judgment; And so the plague was stayed.
verses.Ps.106.31: And that was reckoned unto him for righteousness, Unto all generations for evermore.
verses.Ps.106.32: They angered him also at the waters of Meribah, So that it went ill with Moses for their sakes;
verses.Ps.106.33: Because they were rebellious against his spirit, And he spake unadvisedly with his lips.
verses.Ps.106.34: They did not destroy the peoples, As Jehovah commanded them,
verses.Ps.106.35: But mingled themselves with the nations, And learned their works,
verses.Ps.106.36: And served their idols, Which became a snare unto them.
verses.Ps.106.37: Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto demons,
verses.Ps.106.38: And shed innocent blood, Even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, Whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan; And the land was polluted with blood.
verses.Ps.106.39: Thus were they defiled with their works, And played the harlot in their doings.
verses.Ps.106.40: Therefore was the wrath of Jehovah kindled against his people, And he abhorred his inheritance.
verses.Ps.106.41: And he gave them into the hand of the nations; And they that hated them ruled over them.
verses.Ps.106.42: Their enemies also oppressed them, And they were brought into subjection under their hand.
verses.Ps.106.43: Many times did he deliver them; But they were rebellious in their counsel, And were brought low in their iniquity.
verses.Ps.106.44: Nevertheless he regarded their distress, When he heard their cry:
verses.Ps.106.45: And he remembered for them his covenant, And repented according to the multitude of his lovingkindnesses.
verses.Ps.106.46: He made them also to be pitied Of all those that carried them captive.
verses.Ps.106.47: Save us, O Jehovah our God, And gather us from among the nations, To give thanks unto thy holy name, And to triumph in thy praise.
verses.Ps.106.48: Blessed be Jehovah, the God of Israel, From everlasting even to everlasting. And let all the people say, Amen. Praise ye Jehovah.
verses.Ps.107.1: O give thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever.
verses.Ps.107.2: Let the redeemed of Jehovah say so, Whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the adversary,
verses.Ps.107.3: And gathered out of the lands, From the east and from the west, From the north and from the south.
verses.Ps.107.4: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way; They found no city of habitation.
verses.Ps.107.5: Hungry and thirsty, Their soul fainted in them.
verses.Ps.107.6: Then they cried unto Jehovah in their trouble, And he delivered them out of their distresses,
verses.Ps.107.7: He led them also by a straight way, That they might go to a city of habitation.
verses.Ps.107.8: Oh that men would praise Jehovah for his lovingkindness, And for his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.Ps.107.9: For he satisfieth the longing soul, And the hungry soul he filleth with good.
verses.Ps.107.10: Such as sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, Being bound in affliction and iron,
verses.Ps.107.11: Because they rebelled against the words of God, And contemned the counsel of the Most High:
verses.Ps.107.12: Therefore he brought down their heart with labor; They fell down, and there was none to help.
verses.Ps.107.13: Then they cried unto Jehovah in their trouble, And he saved them out of their distresses.
verses.Ps.107.14: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, And brake their bonds in sunder.
verses.Ps.107.15: Oh that men would praise Jehovah for his lovingkindness, And for his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.Ps.107.16: For he hath broken the gates of brass, And cut the bars of iron in sunder.
verses.Ps.107.17: Fools because of their transgression, And because of their iniquities, are afflicted.
verses.Ps.107.18: Their soul abhorreth all manner of food; And they draw near unto the gates of death.
verses.Ps.107.19: Then they cry unto Jehovah in their trouble, And he saveth them out of their distresses.
verses.Ps.107.20: He sendeth his word, and healeth them, And delivereth them from their destructions.
verses.Ps.107.21: Oh that men would praise Jehovah for his lovingkindness, And for his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.Ps.107.22: And let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, And declare his works with singing.
verses.Ps.107.23: They that go down to the sea in ships, That do business in great waters;
verses.Ps.107.24: These see the works of Jehovah, And his wonders in the deep.
verses.Ps.107.25: For he commandeth, and raiseth the stormy wind, Which lifteth up the waves thereof.
verses.Ps.107.26: They mount up to the heavens, they go down again to the depths: Their soul melteth away because of trouble.
verses.Ps.107.27: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, And are at their wits’ end.
verses.Ps.107.28: Then they cry unto Jehovah in their trouble, And he bringeth them out of their distresses.
verses.Ps.107.29: He maketh the storm a calm, So that the waves thereof are still.
verses.Ps.107.30: Then are they glad because they are quiet; So he bringeth them unto their desired haven.
verses.Ps.107.31: Oh that men would praise Jehovah for his lovingkindness, And for his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.Ps.107.32: Let them exalt him also in the assembly of the people, And praise him in the seat of the elders.
verses.Ps.107.33: He turneth rivers into a wilderness, And watersprings into a thirsty ground;
verses.Ps.107.34: A fruitful land into a salt desert, For the wickedness of them that dwell therein.
verses.Ps.107.35: He turneth a wilderness into a pool of water, And a dry land into watersprings.
verses.Ps.107.36: And there he maketh the hungry to dwell, That they may prepare a city of habitation,
verses.Ps.107.37: And sow fields, and plant vineyards, And get them fruits of increase.
verses.Ps.107.38: He blesseth them also, so that they are multiplied greatly; And he suffereth not their cattle to decrease.
verses.Ps.107.39: Again, they are diminished and bowed down Through oppression, trouble, and sorrow.
verses.Ps.107.40: He poureth contempt upon princes, And causeth them to wander in the waste, where there is no way.
verses.Ps.107.41: Yet setteth he the needy on high from affliction, And maketh him families like a flock.
verses.Ps.107.42: The upright shall see it, and be glad; And all iniquity shall stop her mouth.
verses.Ps.107.43: Whoso is wise will give heed to these things; And they will consider the lovingkindnesses of Jehovah.
verses.Ps.108.1: A Song, a Psalm of David. My heart is fixed, O God; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises, even with my glory.
verses.Ps.108.2: Awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake right early.
verses.Ps.108.3: I will give thanks unto thee, O Jehovah, among the peoples; And I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.
verses.Ps.108.4: For thy lovingkindness is great above the heavens; And thy truth reacheth unto the skies.
verses.Ps.108.5: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens, And thy glory above all the earth.
verses.Ps.108.6: That thy beloved may be delivered, Save with thy right hand, and answer us.
verses.Ps.108.7: God hath spoken in his holiness: I will exult; I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
verses.Ps.108.8: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the defence of my head; Judah is my sceptre.
verses.Ps.108.9: Moab is my washpot; Upon Edom will I cast my shoe; Over Philistia will I shout.
verses.Ps.108.10: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who hath led me unto Edom?
verses.Ps.108.11: Hast not thou cast us off, O God? And thou goest not forth, O God, with our hosts.
verses.Ps.108.12: Give us help against the adversary; For vain is the help of man.
verses.Ps.108.13: Through God we shall do valiantly: For he it is that will tread down our adversaries.
verses.Ps.109.1: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;
verses.Ps.109.2: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit have they opened against me: They have spoken unto me with a lying tongue.
verses.Ps.109.3: They have compassed me about also with words of hatred, And fought against me without a cause.
verses.Ps.109.4: For my love they are my adversaries: But I give myself unto prayer.
verses.Ps.109.5: And they have rewarded me evil for good, And hatred for my love.
verses.Ps.109.6: Set thou a wicked man over him; And let an adversary stand at his right hand.
verses.Ps.109.7: When he is judged, let him come forth guilty; And let his prayer be turned into sin.
verses.Ps.109.8: Let his days be few; And let another take his office.
verses.Ps.109.9: Let his children be fatherless, And his wife a widow.
verses.Ps.109.10: Let his children be vagabonds, and beg; And let them seek their bread out of their desolate places.
verses.Ps.109.11: Let the extortioner catch all that he hath; And let strangers make spoil of his labor.
verses.Ps.109.12: Let there be none to extend kindness unto him; Neither let there be any to have pity on his fatherless children.
verses.Ps.109.13: Let his posterity be cut off; In the generation following let their name be blotted out.
verses.Ps.109.14: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with Jehovah; And let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.
verses.Ps.109.15: Let them be before Jehovah continually, That he may cut off the memory of them from the earth;
verses.Ps.109.16: Because he remembered not to show kindness, But persecuted the poor and needy man, And the broken in heart, to slay them.
verses.Ps.109.17: Yea, he loved cursing, and it came unto him; And he delighted not in blessing, and it was far from him.
verses.Ps.109.18: He clothed himself also with cursing as with his garment, And it came into his inward parts like water, And like oil into his bones.
verses.Ps.109.19: Let it be unto him as the raiment wherewith he covereth himself, And for the girdle wherewith he is girded continually.
verses.Ps.109.20: This is the reward of mine adversaries from Jehovah, And of them that speak evil against my soul.
verses.Ps.109.21: But deal thou with me, O Jehovah the Lord, for thy name’s sake: Because thy lovingkindness is good, deliver thou me;
verses.Ps.109.22: For I am poor and needy, And my heart is wounded within me.
verses.Ps.109.23: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.
verses.Ps.109.24: My knees are weak through fasting; And my flesh faileth of fatness.
verses.Ps.109.25: I am become also a reproach unto them: When they see me, they shake their head.
verses.Ps.109.26: Help me, O Jehovah my God; Oh save me according to thy lovingkindness:
verses.Ps.109.27: That they may know that this is thy hand; That thou, Jehovah, hast done it.
verses.Ps.109.28: Let them curse, but bless thou: When they arise, they shall be put to shame, But thy servant shall rejoice.
verses.Ps.109.29: Let mine adversaries be clothed with dishonor, And let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe.
verses.Ps.109.30: I will give great thanks unto Jehovah with my mouth; Yea, I will praise him among the multitude.
verses.Ps.109.31: For he will stand at the right hand of the needy, To save him from them that judge his soul.
verses.Ps.110.1: A Psalm of David. Jehovah saith unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, Until I make thine enemies thy footstool.
verses.Ps.110.2: Jehovah will send forth the rod of thy strength out of Zion: Rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.
verses.Ps.110.3: Thy people offer themselves willingly In the day of thy power, in holy array: Out of the womb of the morning Thou hast the dew of thy youth.
verses.Ps.110.4: Jehovah hath sworn, and will not repent: Thou art a priest for ever After the order of Melchizedek.
verses.Ps.110.5: The Lord at thy right hand Will strike through kings in the day of his wrath.
verses.Ps.110.6: He will judge among the nations, He will fill the places with dead bodies; He will strike through the head in many countries.
verses.Ps.110.7: He will drink of the brook in the way: Therefore will he lift up the head.
verses.Ps.111.1: Praise ye Jehovah. I will give thanks unto Jehovah with my whole heart, In the council of the upright, and in the congregation.
verses.Ps.111.2: The works of Jehovah are great, Sought out of all them that have pleasure therein.
verses.Ps.111.3: His work is honor and majesty; And his righteousness endureth for ever.
verses.Ps.111.4: He hath made his wonderful works to be remembered: Jehovah is gracious and merciful.
verses.Ps.111.5: He hath given food unto them that fear him: He will ever be mindful of his covenant.
verses.Ps.111.6: He hath showed his people the power of his works, In giving them the heritage of the nations.
verses.Ps.111.7: The works of his hands are truth and justice; All his precepts are sure.
verses.Ps.111.8: They are established for ever and ever; They are done in truth and uprightness.
verses.Ps.111.9: He hath sent redemption unto his people; He hath commanded his covenant for ever: Holy and reverend is his name.
verses.Ps.111.10: The fear of Jehovah is the beginning of wisdom; A good understanding have all they that do his commandments: His praise endureth for ever.
verses.Ps.112.1: Praise ye Jehovah. Blessed is the man that feareth Jehovah, That delighteth greatly in his commandments.
verses.Ps.112.2: His seed shall be mighty upon earth: The generation of the upright shall be blessed.
verses.Ps.112.3: Wealth and riches are in his house; And his righteousness endureth for ever.
verses.Ps.112.4: Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness: He is gracious, and merciful, and righteous.
verses.Ps.112.5: Well is it with the man that dealeth graciously and lendeth; He shall maintain his cause in judgment.
verses.Ps.112.6: For he shall never be moved; The righteous shall be had in everlasting remembrance.
verses.Ps.112.7: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: His heart is fixed, trusting in Jehovah.
verses.Ps.112.8: His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, Until he see his desire upon his adversaries.
verses.Ps.112.9: He hath dispersed, he hath given to the needy; His righteousness endureth for ever: His horn shall be exalted with honor.
verses.Ps.112.10: The wicked shall see it, and be grieved; He shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away: The desire of the wicked shall perish.
verses.Ps.113.1: Praise ye Jehovah. Praise, O ye servants of Jehovah, Praise the name of Jehovah.
verses.Ps.113.2: Blessed be the name of Jehovah From this time forth and for evermore.
verses.Ps.113.3: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same Jehovah’s name is to be praised.
verses.Ps.113.4: Jehovah is high above all nations, And his glory above the heavens.
verses.Ps.113.5: Who is like unto Jehovah our God, That hath his seat on high,
verses.Ps.113.6: That humbleth himself to behold The things that are in heaven and in the earth?
verses.Ps.113.7: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, And lifteth up the needy from the dunghill;
verses.Ps.113.8: That he may set him with princes, Even with the princes of his people.
verses.Ps.113.9: He maketh the barren woman to keep house, And to be a joyful mother of children. Praise ye Jehovah.
verses.Ps.114.1: When Israel went forth out of Egypt, The house of Jacob from a people of strange language;
verses.Ps.114.2: Judah became his sanctuary, Israel his dominion.
verses.Ps.114.3: The sea saw it, and fled; The Jordan was driven back.
verses.Ps.114.4: The mountains skipped like rams, The little hills like lambs.
verses.Ps.114.5: What aileth thee, O thou sea, that thou fleest? Thou Jordan, that thou turnest back?
verses.Ps.114.6: Ye mountains, that ye skip like rams; Ye little hills, like lambs?
verses.Ps.114.7: Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord, At the presence of the God of Jacob,
verses.Ps.114.8: Who turned the rock into a pool of water, The flint into a fountain of waters.
verses.Ps.115.1: Not unto us, O Jehovah, not unto us, But unto thy name give glory, For thy lovingkindness, and for thy truth’s sake.
verses.Ps.115.2: Wherefore should the nations say, Where is now their God?
verses.Ps.115.3: But our God is in the heavens: He hath done whatsoever he pleased.
verses.Ps.115.4: Their idols are silver and gold, The work of men’s hands.
verses.Ps.115.5: They have mouths, but they speak not; Eyes have they, but they see not;
verses.Ps.115.6: They have ears, but they hear not; Noses have they, but they smell not;
verses.Ps.115.7: They have hands, but they handle not; Feet have they, but they walk not; Neither speak they through their throat.
verses.Ps.115.8: They that make them shall be like unto them; Yea, every one that trusteth in them.
verses.Ps.115.9: O Israel, trust thou in Jehovah: He is their help and their shield.
verses.Ps.115.10: O house of Aaron, trust ye in Jehovah: He is their help and their shield.
verses.Ps.115.11: Ye that fear Jehovah, trust in Jehovah: He is their help and their shield.
verses.Ps.115.12: Jehovah hath been mindful of us; he will bless us: He will bless the house of Israel; He will bless the house of Aaron.
verses.Ps.115.13: He will bless them that fear Jehovah, Both small and great.
verses.Ps.115.14: Jehovah increase you more and more, You and your children.
verses.Ps.115.15: Blessed are ye of Jehovah, Who made heaven and earth.
verses.Ps.115.16: The heavens are the heavens of Jehovah; But the earth hath he given to the children of men.
verses.Ps.115.17: The dead praise not Jehovah, Neither any that go down into silence;
verses.Ps.115.18: But we will bless Jehovah From this time forth and for evermore. Praise ye Jehovah.
verses.Ps.116.1: I love Jehovah, because he heareth My voice and my supplications.
verses.Ps.116.2: Because he hath inclined his ear unto me, Therefore will I call upon him as long as I live.
verses.Ps.116.3: The cords of death compassed me, And the pains of Sheol gat hold upon me: I found trouble and sorrow.
verses.Ps.116.4: Then called I upon the name of Jehovah: O Jehovah, I beseech thee, deliver my soul.
verses.Ps.116.5: Gracious is Jehovah, and righteous; Yea, our God is merciful.
verses.Ps.116.6: Jehovah preserveth the simple: I was brought low, and he saved me.
verses.Ps.116.7: Return unto thy rest, O my soul; For Jehovah hath dealt bountifully with thee.
verses.Ps.116.8: For thou hast delivered my soul from death, Mine eyes from tears, And my feet from falling.
verses.Ps.116.9: I will walk before Jehovah In the land of the living.
verses.Ps.116.10: I believe, for I will speak: I was greatly afflicted:
verses.Ps.116.11: I said in my haste, All men are liars.
verses.Ps.116.12: What shall I render unto Jehovah For all his benefits toward me?
verses.Ps.116.13: I will take the cup of salvation, And call upon the name of Jehovah.
verses.Ps.116.14: I will pay my vows unto Jehovah, Yea, in the presence of all his people.
verses.Ps.116.15: Precious in the sight of Jehovah Is the death of his saints.
verses.Ps.116.16: O Jehovah, truly I am thy servant: I am thy servant, the son of thy handmaid; Thou hast loosed my bonds.
verses.Ps.116.17: I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving, And will call upon the name of Jehovah.
verses.Ps.116.18: I will pay my vows unto Jehovah, Yea, in the presence of all his people,
verses.Ps.116.19: In the courts of Jehovah’s house, In the midst of thee, O Jerusalem. Praise ye Jehovah.
verses.Ps.117.1: O praise Jehovah, all ye nations; Laud him, all ye peoples.
verses.Ps.117.2: For his lovingkindness is great toward us; And the truth of Jehovah endureth for ever. Praise ye Jehovah.
verses.Ps.118.1: Oh give thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever.
verses.Ps.118.2: Let Israel now say, That his lovingkindness endureth for ever.
verses.Ps.118.3: Let the house of Aaron now say, That his lovingkindness endureth for ever.
verses.Ps.118.4: Let them now that fear Jehovah say, That his lovingkindness endureth for ever.
verses.Ps.118.5: Out of my distress I called upon Jehovah: Jehovah answered me and set me in a large place.
verses.Ps.118.6: Jehovah is on my side; I will not fear: What can man do unto me?
verses.Ps.118.7: Jehovah is on my side among them that help me: Therefore shall I see my desire upon them that hate me.
verses.Ps.118.8: It is better to take refuge in Jehovah Than to put confidence in man.
verses.Ps.118.9: It is better to take refuge in Jehovah Than to put confidence in princes.
verses.Ps.118.10: All nations compassed me about: In the name of Jehovah I will cut them off.
verses.Ps.118.11: They compassed me about; yea, they compassed me about: In the name of Jehovah I will cut them off.
verses.Ps.118.12: They compassed me about like bees; they are quenched as the fire of thorns: In the name of Jehovah I will cut them off.
verses.Ps.118.13: Thou didst thrust sore at me that I might fall; But Jehovah helped me.
verses.Ps.118.14: Jehovah is my strength and song; And he is become my salvation.
verses.Ps.118.15: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous: The right hand of Jehovah doeth valiantly.
verses.Ps.118.16: The right hand of Jehovah is exalted: The right hand of Jehovah doeth valiantly.
verses.Ps.118.17: I shall not die, but live, And declare the works of Jehovah.
verses.Ps.118.18: Jehovah hath chastened me sore; But he hath not given me over unto death.
verses.Ps.118.19: Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will enter into them, I will give thanks unto Jehovah.
verses.Ps.118.20: This is the gate of Jehovah; The righteous shall enter into it.
verses.Ps.118.21: I will give thanks unto thee; for thou hast answered me, And art become my salvation.
verses.Ps.118.22: The stone which the builders rejected Is become the head of the corner.
verses.Ps.118.23: This is Jehovah’s doing; It is marvellous in our eyes.
verses.Ps.118.24: This is the day which Jehovah hath made; We will rejoice and be glad in it.
verses.Ps.118.25: Save now, we beseech thee, O Jehovah: O Jehovah, we beseech thee, send now prosperity.
verses.Ps.118.26: Blessed be he that cometh in the name of Jehovah: We have blessed you out of the house of Jehovah.
verses.Ps.118.27: Jehovah is God, and he hath given us light: Bind the sacrifice with cords, even unto the horns of the altar.
verses.Ps.118.28: Thou art my God, and I will give thanks unto thee: Thou art my God, I will exalt thee.
verses.Ps.118.29: Oh give thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever.
verses.Ps.119.1: Blessed are they that are perfect in the way, Who walk in the law of Jehovah.
verses.Ps.119.2: Blessed are they that keep his testimonies, That seek him with the whole heart.
verses.Ps.119.3: Yea, they do no unrighteousness; They walk in his ways.
verses.Ps.119.4: Thou hast commanded us thy precepts, That we should observe them diligently.
verses.Ps.119.5: Oh that my ways were established To observe thy statutes!
verses.Ps.119.6: Then shall I not be put to shame, When I have respect unto all thy commandments.
verses.Ps.119.7: I will give thanks unto thee with uprightness of heart, When I learn thy righteous judgments.
verses.Ps.119.8: I will observe thy statutes: Oh forsake me not utterly. ב BETH.
verses.Ps.119.9: Wherewith shall a young man cleanse his way? By taking heed thereto according to thy word.
verses.Ps.119.10: With my whole heart have I sought thee: Oh let me not wander from thy commandments.
verses.Ps.119.11: Thy word have I laid up in my heart, That I might not sin against thee.
verses.Ps.119.12: Blessed art thou, O Jehovah: Teach me thy statutes.
verses.Ps.119.13: With my lips have I declared All the ordinances of thy mouth.
verses.Ps.119.14: I have rejoiced in the way of thy testimonies, As much as in all riches.
verses.Ps.119.15: I will meditate on thy precepts, And have respect unto thy ways.
verses.Ps.119.16: I will delight myself in thy statutes: I will not forget thy word. ג GIMEL.
verses.Ps.119.17: Deal bountifully with thy servant, that I may live; So will I observe thy word.
verses.Ps.119.18: Open thou mine eyes, that I may behold Wondrous things out of thy law.
verses.Ps.119.19: I am a sojourner in the earth: Hide not thy commandments from me.
verses.Ps.119.20: My soul breaketh for the longing That it hath unto thine ordinances at all times.
verses.Ps.119.21: Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed, That do wander from thy commandments.
verses.Ps.119.22: Take away from me reproach and contempt; For I have kept thy testimonies.
verses.Ps.119.23: Princes also sat and talked against me; But thy servant did meditate on thy statutes.
verses.Ps.119.24: Thy testimonies also are my delight And my counsellors. ד DALETH.
verses.Ps.119.25: My soul cleaveth unto the dust: Quicken thou me according to thy word.
verses.Ps.119.26: I declared my ways, and thou answeredst me: Teach me thy statutes.
verses.Ps.119.27: Make me to understand the way of thy precepts: So shall I meditate on thy wondrous works.
verses.Ps.119.28: My soul melteth for heaviness: Strengthen thou me according unto thy word.
verses.Ps.119.29: Remove from me the way of falsehood; And grant me thy law graciously.
verses.Ps.119.30: I have chosen the way of faithfulness: Thine ordinances have I set before me.
verses.Ps.119.31: I cleave unto thy testimonies: O Jehovah, put me not to shame.
verses.Ps.119.32: I will run the way of thy commandments, When thou shalt enlarge my heart. ה HE.
verses.Ps.119.33: Teach me, O Jehovah, the way of thy statutes; And I shall keep it unto the end.
verses.Ps.119.34: Give me understanding, and I shall keep thy law; Yea, I shall observe it with my whole heart.
verses.Ps.119.35: Make me to go in the path of thy commandments; For therein do I delight.
verses.Ps.119.36: Incline my heart unto thy testimonies, And not to covetousness.
verses.Ps.119.37: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity, And quicken me in thy ways.
verses.Ps.119.38: Confirm unto thy servant thy word, Which is in order unto the fear of thee.
verses.Ps.119.39: Turn away my reproach whereof I am afraid; For thine ordinances are good.
verses.Ps.119.40: Behold, I have longed after thy precepts: Quicken me in thy righteousness. ו VAV.
verses.Ps.119.41: Let thy lovingkindnesses also come unto me, O Jehovah, Even thy salvation, according to thy word.
verses.Ps.119.42: So shall I have an answer for him that reproacheth me; For I trust in thy word.
verses.Ps.119.43: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; For I have hoped in thine ordinances.
verses.Ps.119.44: So shall I observe thy law continually For ever and ever.
verses.Ps.119.45: And I shall walk at liberty; For I have sought thy precepts.
verses.Ps.119.46: I will also speak of thy testimonies before kings, And shall not be put to shame.
verses.Ps.119.47: And I will delight myself in thy commandments, Which I have loved.
verses.Ps.119.48: I will lift up my hands also unto thy commandments, which I have loved; And I will meditate on thy statutes. ז ZAYIN.
verses.Ps.119.49: Remember the word unto thy servant, Because thou hast made me to hope.
verses.Ps.119.50: This is my comfort in my affliction; For thy word hath quickened me.
verses.Ps.119.51: The proud have had me greatly in derision: Yet have I not swerved from thy law.
verses.Ps.119.52: I have remembered thine ordinances of old, O Jehovah, And have comforted myself.
verses.Ps.119.53: Hot indignation hath taken hold upon me, Because of the wicked that forsake thy law.
verses.Ps.119.54: Thy statutes have been my songs In the house of my pilgrimage.
verses.Ps.119.55: I have remembered thy name, O Jehovah, in the night, And have observed thy law.
verses.Ps.119.56: This I have had, Because I have kept thy precepts. ח HHETH.
verses.Ps.119.57: Jehovah is my portion: I have said that I would observe thy words.
verses.Ps.119.58: I entreated thy favor with my whole heart: Be merciful unto me according to thy word.
verses.Ps.119.59: I thought on my ways, And turned my feet unto thy testimonies.
verses.Ps.119.60: I made haste, and delayed not, To observe thy commandments.
verses.Ps.119.61: The cords of the wicked have wrapped me round; But I have not forgotten thy law.
verses.Ps.119.62: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee Because of thy righteous ordinances.
verses.Ps.119.63: I am a companion of all them that fear thee, And of them that observe thy precepts.
verses.Ps.119.64: The earth, O Jehovah, is full of thy lovingkindness: Teach me thy statutes. ט TETH.
verses.Ps.119.65: Thou hast dealt well with thy servant, O Jehovah, according unto thy word.
verses.Ps.119.66: Teach me good judgment and knowledge; For I have believed in thy commandments.
verses.Ps.119.67: Before I was afflicted I went astray; But now I observe thy word.
verses.Ps.119.68: Thou art good, and doest good; Teach me thy statutes.
verses.Ps.119.69: The proud have forged a lie against me: With my whole heart will I keep thy precepts.
verses.Ps.119.70: Their heart is as fat as grease; But I delight in thy law.
verses.Ps.119.71: It is good for me that I have been afflicted; That I may learn thy statutes.
verses.Ps.119.72: The law of thy mouth is better unto me Than thousands of gold and silver. י YODH.
verses.Ps.119.73: Thy hands have made me and fashioned me: Give me understanding, that I may learn thy commandments.
verses.Ps.119.74: They that fear thee shall see me and be glad, Because I have hoped in thy word.
verses.Ps.119.75: I know, O Jehovah, that thy judgments are righteous, And that in faithfulness thou hast afflicted me.
verses.Ps.119.76: Let, I pray thee, thy lovingkindness be for my comfort, According to thy word unto thy servant.
verses.Ps.119.77: Let thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live; For thy law is my delight.
verses.Ps.119.78: Let the proud be put to shame; for they have overthrown me wrongfully: But I will meditate on thy precepts.
verses.Ps.119.79: Let those that fear thee turn unto me; And they shall know thy testimonies.
verses.Ps.119.80: Let my heart be perfect in thy statutes, That I be not put to shame. כ KAPH.
verses.Ps.119.81: My soul fainteth for thy salvation; But I hope in thy word.
verses.Ps.119.82: Mine eyes fail for thy word, While I say, When wilt thou comfort me?
verses.Ps.119.83: For I am become like a wine-skin in the smoke; Yet do I not forget thy statutes.
verses.Ps.119.84: How many are the days of thy servant? When wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?
verses.Ps.119.85: The proud have digged pits for me, Who are not according to thy law.
verses.Ps.119.86: All thy commandments are faithful: They persecute me wrongfully; help thou me.
verses.Ps.119.87: They had almost consumed me upon earth; But I forsook not thy precepts.
verses.Ps.119.88: Quicken me after thy lovingkindness; So shall I observe the testimony of thy mouth. ל LAMEDH.
verses.Ps.119.89: For ever, O Jehovah, Thy word is settled in heaven.
verses.Ps.119.90: Thy faithfulness is unto all generations: Thou hast established the earth, and it abideth.
verses.Ps.119.91: They abide this day according to thine ordinances; For all things are thy servants.
verses.Ps.119.92: Unless thy law had been my delight, I should then have perished in mine affliction.
verses.Ps.119.93: I will never forget thy precepts; For with them thou hast quickened me.
verses.Ps.119.94: I am thine, save me; For I have sought thy precepts.
verses.Ps.119.95: The wicked have waited for me, to destroy me; But I will consider thy testimonies.
verses.Ps.119.96: I have seen an end of all perfection; But thy commandment is exceeding broad. מ MEM.
verses.Ps.119.97: Oh how love I thy law! It is my meditation all the day.
verses.Ps.119.98: Thy commandments make me wiser than mine enemies; For they are ever with me.
verses.Ps.119.99: I have more understanding than all my teachers; For thy testimonies are my meditation.
verses.Ps.119.100: I understand more than the aged, Because I have kept thy precepts.
verses.Ps.119.101: I have refrained my feet from every evil way, That I might observe thy word.
verses.Ps.119.102: I have not turned aside from thine ordinances; For thou hast taught me.
verses.Ps.119.103: How sweet are thy words unto my taste! Yea, sweeter than honey to my mouth!
verses.Ps.119.104: Through thy precepts I get understanding: Therefore I hate every false way. נ NUN.
verses.Ps.119.105: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, And light unto my path.
verses.Ps.119.106: I have sworn, and have confirmed it, That I will observe thy righteous ordinances.
verses.Ps.119.107: I am afflicted very much: Quicken me, O Jehovah, according unto thy word.
verses.Ps.119.108: Accept, I beseech thee, the freewill-offerings of my mouth, O Jehovah, And teach me thine ordinances.
verses.Ps.119.109: My soul is continually in my hand; Yet do I not forget thy law.
verses.Ps.119.110: The wicked have laid a snare for me; Yet have I not gone astray from thy precepts.
verses.Ps.119.111: Thy testimonies have I taken as a heritage for ever; For they are the rejoicing of my heart.
verses.Ps.119.112: I have inclined my heart to perform thy statutes For ever, even unto the end. ס SAMEKH.
verses.Ps.119.113: I hate them that are of a double mind; But thy law do I love.
verses.Ps.119.114: Thou art my hiding-place and my shield: I hope in thy word.
verses.Ps.119.115: Depart from me, ye evil-doers, That I may keep the commandments of my God.
verses.Ps.119.116: Uphold me according unto thy word, that I may live; And let me not be ashamed of my hope.
verses.Ps.119.117: Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe, And shall have respect unto thy statutes continually.
verses.Ps.119.118: Thou hast set at nought all them that err from thy statutes; For their deceit is falsehood.
verses.Ps.119.119: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth like dross: Therefore I love thy testimonies.
verses.Ps.119.120: My flesh trembleth for fear of thee; And I am afraid of thy judgments. ע AYIN.
verses.Ps.119.121: I have done justice and righteousness: Leave me not to mine oppressors.
verses.Ps.119.122: Be surety for thy servant for good: Let not the proud oppress me.
verses.Ps.119.123: Mine eyes fail for thy salvation, And for thy righteous word.
verses.Ps.119.124: Deal with thy servant according unto thy lovingkindness, And teach me thy statutes.
verses.Ps.119.125: I am thy servant; give me understanding, That I may know thy testimonies.
verses.Ps.119.126: It is time for Jehovah to work; For they have made void thy law.
verses.Ps.119.127: Therefore I love thy commandments Above gold, yea, above fine gold.
verses.Ps.119.128: Therefore I esteem all thy precepts concerning all things to be right; And I hate every false way. פ PE.
verses.Ps.119.129: Thy testimonies are wonderful; Therefore doth my soul keep them.
verses.Ps.119.130: The opening of thy words giveth light; It giveth understanding unto the simple.
verses.Ps.119.131: I opened wide my mouth, and panted; For I longed for thy commandments.
verses.Ps.119.132: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me, As thou usest to do unto those that love thy name.
verses.Ps.119.133: Establish my footsteps in thy word; And let not any iniquity have dominion over me.
verses.Ps.119.134: Redeem me from the oppression of man: So will I observe thy precepts.
verses.Ps.119.135: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; And teach me thy statutes.
verses.Ps.119.136: Streams of water run down mine eyes, Because they observe not thy law. צ TSADHE.
verses.Ps.119.137: Righteous art thou, O Jehovah, And upright are thy judgments.
verses.Ps.119.138: Thou hast commanded thy testimonies in righteousness And very faithfulness.
verses.Ps.119.139: My zeal hath consumed me, Because mine adversaries have forgotten thy words.
verses.Ps.119.140: Thy word is very pure; Therefore thy servant loveth it.
verses.Ps.119.141: I am small and despised; Yet do I not forget thy precepts.
verses.Ps.119.142: Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, And thy law is truth.
verses.Ps.119.143: Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me; Yet thy commandments are my delight.
verses.Ps.119.144: Thy testimonies are righteous for ever: Give me understanding, and I shall live. ק QOPH.
verses.Ps.119.145: I have called with my whole heart; answer me, O Jehovah: I will keep thy statutes.
verses.Ps.119.146: I have called unto thee; save me, And I shall observe thy testimonies.
verses.Ps.119.147: I anticipated the dawning of the morning, and cried: I hoped in thy words.
verses.Ps.119.148: Mine eyes anticipated the night-watches, That I might meditate on thy word.
verses.Ps.119.149: Hear my voice according unto thy lovingkindness: Quicken me, O Jehovah, according to thine ordinances.
verses.Ps.119.150: They draw nigh that follow after wickedness; They are far from thy law.
verses.Ps.119.151: Thou art nigh, O Jehovah; And all thy commandments are truth.
verses.Ps.119.152: Of old have I known from thy testimonies, That thou hast founded them for ever. ר RESH.
verses.Ps.119.153: Consider mine affliction, and deliver me; For I do not forget thy law.
verses.Ps.119.154: Plead thou my cause, and redeem me: Quicken me according to thy word.
verses.Ps.119.155: Salvation is far from the wicked; For they seek not thy statutes.
verses.Ps.119.156: Great are thy tender mercies, O Jehovah: Quicken me according to thine ordinances.
verses.Ps.119.157: Many are my persecutors and mine adversaries; Yet have I not swerved from thy testimonies.
verses.Ps.119.158: I beheld the treacherous, and was grieved, Because they observe not thy word.
verses.Ps.119.159: Consider how I love thy precepts: Quicken me, O Jehovah, according to thy lovingkindness.
verses.Ps.119.160: The sum of thy word is truth; And every one of thy righteous ordinances endureth for ever. ש SHIN.
verses.Ps.119.161: Princes have persecuted me without a cause; But my heart standeth in awe of thy words.
verses.Ps.119.162: I rejoice at thy word, As one that findeth great spoil.
verses.Ps.119.163: I hate and abhor falsehood; But thy law do I love.
verses.Ps.119.164: Seven times a day do I praise thee, Because of thy righteous ordinances.
verses.Ps.119.165: Great peace have they that love thy law; And they have no occasion of stumbling.
verses.Ps.119.166: I have hoped for thy salvation, O Jehovah, And have done thy commandments.
verses.Ps.119.167: My soul hath observed thy testimonies; And I love them exceedingly.
verses.Ps.119.168: I have observed thy precepts and thy testimonies; For all my ways are before thee. ת TAV.
verses.Ps.119.169: Let my cry come near before thee, O Jehovah: Give me understanding according to thy word.
verses.Ps.119.170: Let my supplication come before thee: Deliver me according to thy word.
verses.Ps.119.171: Let my lips utter praise; For thou teachest me thy statutes.
verses.Ps.119.172: Let my tongue sing of thy word; For all thy commandments are righteousness.
verses.Ps.119.173: Let thy hand be ready to help me; For I have chosen thy precepts.
verses.Ps.119.174: I have longed for thy salvation, O Jehovah; And thy law is my delight.
verses.Ps.119.175: Let my soul live, and it shall praise thee; And let thine ordinances help me.
verses.Ps.119.176: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek thy servant; For I do not forget thy commandments.
verses.Ps.120.1: A Song of Ascents. In my distress I cried unto Jehovah, And he answered me.
verses.Ps.120.2: Deliver my soul, O Jehovah, from lying lips, And from a deceitful tongue.
verses.Ps.120.3: What shall be given unto thee, and what shall be done more unto thee, Thou deceitful tongue?
verses.Ps.120.4: Sharp arrows of the mighty, With coals of juniper.
verses.Ps.120.5: Woe is me, that I sojourn in Meshech, That I dwell among the tents of Kedar!
verses.Ps.120.6: My soul hath long had her dwelling With him that hateth peace.
verses.Ps.120.7: I am for peace: But when I speak, they are for war.
verses.Ps.121.1: A Song of Ascents. I will lift up mine eyes unto the mountains: From whence shall my help come?
verses.Ps.121.2: My help cometh from Jehovah, Who made heaven and earth.
verses.Ps.121.3: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: He that keepeth thee will not slumber.
verses.Ps.121.4: Behold, he that keepeth Israel Will neither slumber nor sleep.
verses.Ps.121.5: Jehovah is thy keeper: Jehovah is thy shade upon thy right hand.
verses.Ps.121.6: The sun shall not smite thee by day, Nor the moon by night.
verses.Ps.121.7: Jehovah will keep thee from all evil; He will keep thy soul.
verses.Ps.121.8: Jehovah will keep thy going out and thy coming in From this time forth and for evermore.
verses.Ps.122.1: A Song of Ascents; of David. I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go unto the house of Jehovah.
verses.Ps.122.2: Our feet are standing Within thy gates, O Jerusalem,
verses.Ps.122.3: Jerusalem, that art builded As a city that is compact together;
verses.Ps.122.4: Whither the tribes go up, even the tribes of Jehovah, For an ordinance for Israel, To give thanks unto the name of Jehovah.
verses.Ps.122.5: For there are set thrones for judgment, The thrones of the house of David.
verses.Ps.122.6: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: They shall prosper that love thee.
verses.Ps.122.7: Peace be within thy walls, And prosperity within thy palaces.
verses.Ps.122.8: For my brethren and companions’ sakes, I will now say, Peace be within thee.
verses.Ps.122.9: For the sake of the house of Jehovah our God I will seek thy good.
verses.Ps.123.1: A Song of Ascents. Unto thee do I lift up mine eyes, O thou that sittest in the heavens.
verses.Ps.123.2: Behold, as the eyes of servants look unto the hand of their master, As the eyes of a maid unto the hand of her mistress; So our eyes look unto Jehovah our God, Until he have mercy upon us.
verses.Ps.123.3: Have mercy upon us, O Jehovah, have mercy upon us; For we are exceedingly filled with contempt.
verses.Ps.123.4: Our soul is exceedingly filled With the scoffing of those that are at ease, And with the contempt of the proud.
verses.Ps.124.1: A Song of Ascents; of David. If it had not been Jehovah who was on our side, Let Israel now say,
verses.Ps.124.2: If it had not been Jehovah who was on our side, When men rose up against us;
verses.Ps.124.3: Then they had swallowed us up alive, When their wrath was kindled against us:
verses.Ps.124.4: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, The stream had gone over our soul;
verses.Ps.124.5: Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.
verses.Ps.124.6: Blessed be Jehovah, Who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.
verses.Ps.124.7: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: The snare is broken, and we are escaped.
verses.Ps.124.8: Our help is in the name of Jehovah, Who made heaven and earth.
verses.Ps.125.1: A Song of Ascents. They that trust in Jehovah Are as mount Zion, which cannot be moved, but abideth for ever.
verses.Ps.125.2: As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, So Jehovah is round about his people From this time forth and for evermore.
verses.Ps.125.3: For the sceptre of wickedness shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; That the righteous put not forth their hands unto iniquity.
verses.Ps.125.4: Do good, O Jehovah, unto those that are good, And to them that are upright in their hearts.
verses.Ps.125.5: But as for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, Jehovah will lead them forth with the workers of iniquity. Peace be upon Israel.
verses.Ps.126.1: A Song of Ascents. When Jehovah brought back those that returned to Zion, We were like unto them that dream.
verses.Ps.126.2: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, And our tongue with singing: Then said they among the nations, Jehovah hath done great things for them.
verses.Ps.126.3: Jehovah hath done great things for us, Whereof we are glad.
verses.Ps.126.4: Turn again our captivity, O Jehovah, As the streams in the South.
verses.Ps.126.5: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.
verses.Ps.126.6: He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing seed for sowing, Shall doubtless come again with joy, bringing his sheaves with him.
verses.Ps.127.1: A Song of Ascents; of Solomon. Except Jehovah build the house, They labor in vain that build it: Except Jehovah keep the city, The watchman waketh but in vain.
verses.Ps.127.2: It is vain for you to rise up early, To take rest late, To eat the bread of toil; For so he giveth unto his beloved sleep.
verses.Ps.127.3: Lo, children are a heritage of Jehovah; And the fruit of the womb is his reward.
verses.Ps.127.4: As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, So are the children of youth.
verses.Ps.127.5: Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them: They shall not be put to shame, When they speak with their enemies in the gate.
verses.Ps.128.1: A Song of Ascents. Blessed is every one that feareth Jehovah, That walketh in his ways.
verses.Ps.128.2: For thou shalt eat the labor of thy hands: Happy shalt thou be, and it shall be well with thee.
verses.Ps.128.3: Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine, In the innermost parts of thy house; Thy children like olive plants, Round about thy table.
verses.Ps.128.4: Behold, thus shall the man be blessed That feareth Jehovah.
verses.Ps.128.5: Jehovah bless thee out of Zion: And see thou the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.
verses.Ps.128.6: Yea, see thou thy children’s children. Peace be upon Israel.
verses.Ps.129.1: A Song of Ascents. Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth up, Let Israel now say,
verses.Ps.129.2: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth up: Yet they have not prevailed against me.
verses.Ps.129.3: The plowers plowed upon my back; They made long their furrows.
verses.Ps.129.4: Jehovah is righteous: He hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.
verses.Ps.129.5: Let them be put to shame and turned backward, All they that hate Zion.
verses.Ps.129.6: Let them be as the grass upon the housetops, Which withereth before it groweth up;
verses.Ps.129.7: Wherewith the reaper filleth not his hand, Nor he that bindeth sheaves, his bosom:
verses.Ps.129.8: Neither do they that go by say, The blessing of Jehovah be upon you; We bless you in the name of Jehovah.
verses.Ps.130.1: A Song of Ascents. Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O Jehovah.
verses.Ps.130.2: Lord, hear my voice: Let thine ears be attentive To the voice of my supplications.
verses.Ps.130.3: If thou, Jehovah, shouldest mark iniquities, O Lord, who could stand?
verses.Ps.130.4: But there is forgiveness with thee, That thou mayest be feared.
verses.Ps.130.5: I wait for Jehovah, my soul doth wait, And in his word do I hope.
verses.Ps.130.6: My soul waiteth for the Lord More than watchmen wait for the morning; Yea, more than watchmen for the morning.
verses.Ps.130.7: O Israel, hope in Jehovah; For with Jehovah there is lovingkindness, And with him is plenteous redemption.
verses.Ps.130.8: And he will redeem Israel From all his iniquities.
verses.Ps.131.1: A Song of Ascents; of David. Jehovah, my heart is not haughty, nor mine eyes lofty; Neither do I exercise myself in great matters, Or in things too wonderful for me.
verses.Ps.131.2: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul; Like a weaned child with his mother, Like a weaned child is my soul within me.
verses.Ps.131.3: O Israel, hope in Jehovah From this time forth and for evermore.
verses.Ps.132.1: A Song of Ascents. Jehovah, remember for David All his affliction;
verses.Ps.132.2: How he sware unto Jehovah, And vowed unto the Mighty One of Jacob:
verses.Ps.132.3: Surely I will not come into the tabernacle of my house, Nor go up into my bed;
verses.Ps.132.4: I will not give sleep to mine eyes, Or slumber to mine eyelids;
verses.Ps.132.5: Until I find out a place for Jehovah, A tabernacle for the Mighty One of Jacob.
verses.Ps.132.6: Lo, we heard of it in Ephrathah: We found it in the field of the wood.
verses.Ps.132.7: We will go into his tabernacles; We will worship at his footstool.
verses.Ps.132.8: Arise, O Jehovah, into thy resting-place; Thou, and the ark of thy strength.
verses.Ps.132.9: Let thy priests be clothed with righteousness; And let thy saints shout for joy.
verses.Ps.132.10: For thy servant David’s sake Turn not away the face of thine anointed.
verses.Ps.132.11: Jehovah hath sworn unto David in truth; He will not turn from it: Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne.
verses.Ps.132.12: If thy children will keep my covenant And my testimony that I shall teach them, Their children also shall sit upon thy throne for evermore.
verses.Ps.132.13: For Jehovah hath chosen Zion; He hath desired it for his habitation.
verses.Ps.132.14: This is my resting-place for ever: Here will I dwell; for I have desired it.
verses.Ps.132.15: I will abundantly bless her provision: I will satisfy her poor with bread.
