verses.Ps.132.16: Her priests also will I clothe with salvation; And her saints shall shout aloud for joy.
verses.Ps.132.17: There will I make the horn of David to bud: I have ordained a lamp for mine anointed.
verses.Ps.132.18: His enemies will I clothe with shame; But upon himself shall his crown flourish.
verses.Ps.133.1: A Song of Ascents; of David. Behold, how good and how pleasant it is For brethren to dwell together in unity!
verses.Ps.133.2: It is like the precious oil upon the head, That ran down upon the beard, Even Aaron’s beard; That came down upon the skirt of his garments;
verses.Ps.133.3: Like the dew of Hermon, That cometh down upon the mountains of Zion: For there Jehovah commanded the blessing, Even life for evermore.
verses.Ps.134.1: A Song of Ascents. Behold, bless ye Jehovah, all ye servants of Jehovah, That by night stand in the house of Jehovah.
verses.Ps.134.2: Lift up your hands to the sanctuary, And bless ye Jehovah.
verses.Ps.134.3: Jehovah bless thee out of Zion; Even he that made heaven and earth.
verses.Ps.135.1: Praise ye Jehovah. Praise ye the name of Jehovah; Praise him, O ye servants of Jehovah,
verses.Ps.135.2: Ye that stand in the house of Jehovah, In the courts of the house of our God.
verses.Ps.135.3: Praise ye Jehovah; for Jehovah is good: Sing praises unto his name; for it is pleasant.
verses.Ps.135.4: For Jehovah hath chosen Jacob unto himself, And Israel for his own possession.
verses.Ps.135.5: For I know that Jehovah is great, And that our Lord is above all gods.
verses.Ps.135.6: Whatsoever Jehovah pleased, that hath he done, In heaven and in earth, in the seas and in all deeps;
verses.Ps.135.7: Who causeth the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth; Who maketh lightnings for the rain; Who bringeth forth the wind out of his treasuries;
verses.Ps.135.8: Who smote the first-born of Egypt, Both of man and beast;
verses.Ps.135.9: Who sent signs and wonders into the midst of thee, O Egypt, Upon Pharaoh, and upon all his servants;
verses.Ps.135.10: Who smote many nations, And slew mighty kings,
verses.Ps.135.11: Sihon king of the Amorites, And Og king of Bashan, And all the kingdoms of Canaan,
verses.Ps.135.12: And gave their land for a heritage, A heritage unto Israel his people.
verses.Ps.135.13: Thy name, O Jehovah, endureth for ever; Thy memorial name, O Jehovah, throughout all generations.
verses.Ps.135.14: For Jehovah will judge his people, And repent himself concerning his servants.
verses.Ps.135.15: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, The work of men’s hands.
verses.Ps.135.16: They have mouths, but they speak not; Eyes have they, but they see not;
verses.Ps.135.17: They have ears, but they hear not; Neither is there any breath in their mouths.
verses.Ps.135.18: They that make them shall be like unto them; Yea, every one that trusteth in them.
verses.Ps.135.19: O house of Israel, bless ye Jehovah: O house of Aaron, bless ye Jehovah:
verses.Ps.135.20: O house of Levi, bless ye Jehovah: Ye that fear Jehovah, bless ye Jehovah.
verses.Ps.135.21: Blessed be Jehovah out of Zion, Who dwelleth at Jerusalem. Praise ye Jehovah.
verses.Ps.136.1: Oh give thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever.
verses.Ps.136.2: Oh give thanks unto the God of gods; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever.
verses.Ps.136.3: Oh give thanks unto the Lord of lords; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever:
verses.Ps.136.4: To him who alone doeth great wonders; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever:
verses.Ps.136.5: To him that by understanding made the heavens; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever:
verses.Ps.136.6: To him that spread forth the earth above the waters; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever:
verses.Ps.136.7: To him that made great lights; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever:
verses.Ps.136.8: The sun to rule by day; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever;
verses.Ps.136.9: The moon and stars to rule by night; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever:
verses.Ps.136.10: To him that smote Egypt in their first-born; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever;
verses.Ps.136.11: And brought out Israel from among them; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever;
verses.Ps.136.12: With a strong hand, and with an outstretched arm; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever:
verses.Ps.136.13: To him that divided the Red Sea in sunder; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever;
verses.Ps.136.14: And made Israel to pass through the midst of it; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever;
verses.Ps.136.15: But overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red Sea; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever:
verses.Ps.136.16: To him that led his people through the wilderness; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever:
verses.Ps.136.17: To him that smote great kings; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever;
verses.Ps.136.18: And slew famous kings; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever:
verses.Ps.136.19: Sihon king of the Amorites; For his lovingkindness endureth forever;
verses.Ps.136.20: And Og king of Bashan; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever;
verses.Ps.136.21: And gave their land for a heritage; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever;
verses.Ps.136.22: Even a heritage unto Israel his servant; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever:
verses.Ps.136.23: Who remembered us in our low estate; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever;
verses.Ps.136.24: And hath delivered us from our adversaries; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever:
verses.Ps.136.25: Who giveth food to all flesh; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever.
verses.Ps.136.26: Oh give thanks unto the God of heaven; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever.
verses.Ps.137.1: By the rivers of Babylon, There we sat down, yea, we wept, When we remembered Zion.
verses.Ps.137.2: Upon the willows in the midst thereof We hanged up our harps.
verses.Ps.137.3: For there they that led us captive required of us songs, And they that wasted us required of us mirth, saying, Sing us one of the songs of Zion.
verses.Ps.137.4: How shall we sing Jehovah’s song In a foreign land?
verses.Ps.137.5: If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, Let my right hand forget her skill.
verses.Ps.137.6: Let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth, If I remember thee not; If I prefer not Jerusalem Above my chief joy.
verses.Ps.137.7: Remember, O Jehovah, against the children of Edom The day of Jerusalem; Who said, Rase it, rase it, Even to the foundation thereof.
verses.Ps.137.8: O daughter of Babylon, that art to be destroyed, Happy shall he be, that rewardeth thee As thou hast served us.
verses.Ps.137.9: Happy shall he be, that taketh and dasheth thy little ones Against the rock.
verses.Ps.138.1: A Psalm of David. I will give thee thanks with my whole heart: Before the gods will I sing praises unto thee.
verses.Ps.138.2: I will worship toward thy holy temple, And give thanks unto thy name for thy lovingkindness and for thy truth: For thou hast magnified thy word above all thy name.
verses.Ps.138.3: In the day that I called thou answeredst me, Thou didst encourage me with strength in my soul.
verses.Ps.138.4: All the kings of the earth shall give thee thanks, O Jehovah, For they have heard the words of thy mouth.
verses.Ps.138.5: Yea, they shall sing of the ways of Jehovah; For great is the glory of Jehovah.
verses.Ps.138.6: For though Jehovah is high, yet hath he respect unto the lowly; But the haughty he knoweth from afar.
verses.Ps.138.7: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, thou wilt revive me; Thou wilt stretch forth thy hand against the wrath of mine enemies, And thy right hand will save me.
verses.Ps.138.8: Jehovah will perfect that which concerneth me: Thy lovingkindness, O Jehovah, endureth for ever; Forsake not the works of thine own hands.
verses.Ps.139.1: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. O Jehovah, thou hast searched me, and known me.
verses.Ps.139.2: Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising; Thou understandest my thought afar off.
verses.Ps.139.3: Thou searchest out my path and my lying down, And art acquainted with all my ways.
verses.Ps.139.4: For there is not a word in my tongue, But, lo, O Jehovah, thou knowest it altogether.
verses.Ps.139.5: Thou hast beset me behind and before, And laid thy hand upon me.
verses.Ps.139.6: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me; It is high, I cannot attain unto it.
verses.Ps.139.7: Whither shall I go from thy Spirit? Or whither shall I flee from thy presence?
verses.Ps.139.8: If I ascend up into heaven, thou art there: If I make my bed in Sheol, behold, thou art there.
verses.Ps.139.9: If I take the wings of the morning, And dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;
verses.Ps.139.10: Even there shall thy hand lead me, And thy right hand shall hold me.
verses.Ps.139.11: If I say, Surely the darkness shall overwhelm me, And the light about me shall be night;
verses.Ps.139.12: Even the darkness hideth not from thee, But the night shineth as the day: The darkness and the light are both alike to thee.
verses.Ps.139.13: For thou didst form my inward parts: Thou didst cover me in my mother’s womb.
verses.Ps.139.14: I will give thanks unto thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: Wonderful are thy works; And that my soul knoweth right well.
verses.Ps.139.15: My frame was not hidden from thee, When I was made in secret, And curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.
verses.Ps.139.16: Thine eyes did see mine unformed substance; And in thy book they were all written, Even the days that were ordained for me, When as yet there was none of them.
verses.Ps.139.17: How precious also are thy thoughts unto me, O God! How great is the sum of them!
verses.Ps.139.18: If I should count them, they are more in number than the sand: When I awake, I am still with thee.
verses.Ps.139.19: Surely thou wilt slay the wicked, O God: Depart from me therefore, ye bloodthirsty men.
verses.Ps.139.20: For they speak against thee wickedly, And thine enemies take thy name in vain.
verses.Ps.139.21: Do not I hate them, O Jehovah, that hate thee? And am not I grieved with those that rise up against thee?
verses.Ps.139.22: I hate them with perfect hatred: They are become mine enemies.
verses.Ps.139.23: Search me, O God, and know my heart: Try me, and know my thoughts;
verses.Ps.139.24: And see if there be any wicked way in me, And lead me in the way everlasting.
verses.Ps.140.1: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. Deliver me, O Jehovah, from the evil man; Preserve me from the violent man:
verses.Ps.140.2: Who devise mischiefs in their heart; Continually do they gather themselves together for war.
verses.Ps.140.3: They have sharpened their tongue like a serpent; Adders’ poison is under their lips. [Selah
verses.Ps.140.4: Keep me, O Jehovah, from the hands of the wicked; Preserve me from the violent man: Who have purposed to thrust aside my steps.
verses.Ps.140.5: The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords; They have spread a net by the wayside; They have set gins for me. [Selah
verses.Ps.140.6: I said unto Jehovah, Thou art my God: Give ear unto the voice of my supplications, O Jehovah.
verses.Ps.140.7: O Jehovah the Lord, the strength of my salvation, Thou hast covered my head in the day of battle.
verses.Ps.140.8: Grant not, O Jehovah, the desires of the wicked; Further not his evil device, lest they exalt themselves. [Selah
verses.Ps.140.9: As for the head of those that compass me about, Let the mischief of their own lips cover them.
verses.Ps.140.10: Let burning coals fall upon them: Let them be cast into the fire, Into deep pits, whence they shall not rise.
verses.Ps.140.11: An evil speaker shall not be established in the earth: Evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow him.
verses.Ps.140.12: I know that Jehovah will maintain the cause of the afflicted, And justice for the needy.
verses.Ps.140.13: Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto thy name: The upright shall dwell in thy presence.
verses.Ps.141.1: A Psalm of David. Jehovah, I have called upon thee; make haste unto me: Give ear unto my voice, when I call unto thee.
verses.Ps.141.2: Let my prayer be set forth as incense before thee; The lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice.
verses.Ps.141.3: Set a watch, O Jehovah, before my mouth; Keep the door of my lips.
verses.Ps.141.4: Incline not my heart to any evil thing, To practise deeds of wickedness With men that work iniquity: And let me not eat of their dainties.
verses.Ps.141.5: Let the righteous smite me, it shall be a kindness; And let him reprove me, it shall be as oil upon the head; Let not my head refuse it: For even in their wickedness shall my prayer continue.
verses.Ps.141.6: Their judges are thrown down by the sides of the rock; And they shall hear my words; for they are sweet.
verses.Ps.141.7: As when one ploweth and cleaveth the earth, Our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol.
verses.Ps.141.8: For mine eyes are unto thee, O Jehovah the Lord: In thee do I take refuge; leave not my soul destitute.
verses.Ps.141.9: Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me, And from the gins of the workers of iniquity.
verses.Ps.141.10: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, Whilst that I withal escape.
verses.Ps.142.1: Maschil of David, when he was in the cave; a Prayer. I cry with my voice unto Jehovah; With my voice unto Jehovah do I make supplication.
verses.Ps.142.2: I pour out my complaint before him; I show before him my trouble.
verses.Ps.142.3: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, Thou knewest my path. In the way wherein I walk Have they hidden a snare for me.
verses.Ps.142.4: Look on my right hand, and see; For there is no man that knoweth me: Refuge hath failed me; No man careth for my soul.
verses.Ps.142.5: I cried unto thee, O Jehovah; I said, Thou art my refuge, My portion in the land of the living.
verses.Ps.142.6: Attend unto my cry; For I am brought very low: Deliver me from my persecutors; For they are stronger than I.
verses.Ps.142.7: Bring my soul out of prison, That I may give thanks unto thy name: The righteous shall compass me about; For thou wilt deal bountifully with me.
verses.Ps.143.1: A Psalm of David. Hear my prayer, O Jehovah; give ear to my supplications: In thy faithfulness answer me, and in thy righteousness.
verses.Ps.143.2: And enter not into judgment with thy servant; For in thy sight no man living is righteous.
verses.Ps.143.3: For the enemy hath persecuted my soul; He hath smitten my life down to the ground: He hath made me to dwell in dark places, as those that have been long dead.
verses.Ps.143.4: Therefore is my spirit overwhelmed within me; My heart within me is desolate.
verses.Ps.143.5: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all thy doings; I muse on the work of thy hands.
verses.Ps.143.6: I spread forth my hands unto thee: My soul thirsteth after thee, as a weary land. [Selah
verses.Ps.143.7: Make haste to answer me, O Jehovah; my spirit faileth: Hide not thy face from me, Lest I become like them that go down into the pit.
verses.Ps.143.8: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; For in thee do I trust: Cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; For I lift up my soul unto thee.
verses.Ps.143.9: Deliver me, O Jehovah, from mine enemies: I flee unto thee to hide me.
verses.Ps.143.10: Teach me to do thy will; For thou art my God: Thy Spirit is good; Lead me in the land of uprightness.
verses.Ps.143.11: Quicken me, O Jehovah, for thy name’s sake: In thy righteousness bring my soul out of trouble.
verses.Ps.143.12: And in thy lovingkindness cut off mine enemies, And destroy all them that afflict my soul; For I am thy servant.
verses.Ps.144.1: A Psalm of David. Blessed be Jehovah my rock, Who teacheth my hands to war, And my fingers to fight:
verses.Ps.144.2: My lovingkindness, and my fortress, My high tower, and my deliverer; My shield, and he in whom I take refuge; Who subdueth my people under me.
verses.Ps.144.3: Jehovah, what is man, that thou takest knowledge of him? Or the son of man, that thou makest account of him?
verses.Ps.144.4: Man is like to vanity: His days are as a shadow that passeth away.
verses.Ps.144.5: Bow thy heavens, O Jehovah, and come down: Touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.
verses.Ps.144.6: Cast forth lightning, and scatter them; Send out thine arrows, and discomfit them.
verses.Ps.144.7: Stretch forth thy hand from above; Rescue me, and deliver me out of great waters, Out of the hand of aliens;
verses.Ps.144.8: Whose mouth speaketh deceit, And whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
verses.Ps.144.9: I will sing a new song unto thee, O God: Upon a psaltery of ten strings will I sing praises unto thee.
verses.Ps.144.10: Thou art he that giveth salvation unto kings; Who rescueth David his servant from the hurtful sword.
verses.Ps.144.11: Rescue me, and deliver me out of the hand of aliens, Whose mouth speaketh deceit, And whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
verses.Ps.144.12: When our sons shall be as plants grown up in their youth, And our daughters as corner-stones hewn after the fashion of a palace;
verses.Ps.144.13: When our garners are full, affording all manner of store, And our sheep bring forth thousands and ten thousands in our fields;
verses.Ps.144.14: When our oxen are well laden; When there is no breaking in, and no going forth, And no outcry in our streets:
verses.Ps.144.15: Happy is the people that is in such a case; Yea, happy is the people whose God is Jehovah.
verses.Ps.145.1: A Psalm of praise; of David. I will extol thee, my God, O King; And I will bless thy name for ever and ever.
verses.Ps.145.2: Every day will I bless thee; And I will praise thy name for ever and ever.
verses.Ps.145.3: Great is Jehovah, and greatly to be praised; And his greatness is unsearchable.
verses.Ps.145.4: One generation shall laud thy works to another, And shall declare thy mighty acts.
verses.Ps.145.5: Of the glorious majesty of thine honor, And of thy wondrous works, will I meditate.
verses.Ps.145.6: And men shall speak of the might of thy terrible acts; And I will declare thy greatness.
verses.Ps.145.7: They shall utter the memory of thy great goodness, And shall sing of thy righteousness.
verses.Ps.145.8: Jehovah is gracious, and merciful; Slow to anger, and of great lovingkindness.
verses.Ps.145.9: Jehovah is good to all; And his tender mercies are over all his works.
verses.Ps.145.10: All thy works shall give thanks unto thee, O Jehovah; And thy saints shall bless thee.
verses.Ps.145.11: They shall speak of the glory of thy kingdom, And talk of thy power;
verses.Ps.145.12: To make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, And the glory of the majesty of his kingdom.
verses.Ps.145.13: Thy kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, And thy dominion endureth throughout all generations.
verses.Ps.145.14: Jehovah upholdeth all that fall, And raiseth up all those that are bowed down.
verses.Ps.145.15: The eyes of all wait for thee; And thou givest them their food in due season.
verses.Ps.145.16: Thou openest thy hand, And satisfiest the desire of every living thing.
verses.Ps.145.17: Jehovah is righteous in all his ways, And gracious in all his works.
verses.Ps.145.18: Jehovah is nigh unto all them that call upon him, To all that call upon him in truth.
verses.Ps.145.19: He will fulfil the desire of them that fear him; He also will hear their cry and will save them.
verses.Ps.145.20: Jehovah preserveth all them that love him; But all the wicked will he destroy.
verses.Ps.145.21: My mouth shall speak the praise of Jehovah; And let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.
verses.Ps.146.1: Praise ye Jehovah. Praise Jehovah, O my soul.
verses.Ps.146.2: While I live will I praise Jehovah: I will sing praises unto my God while I have any being.
verses.Ps.146.3: Put not your trust in princes, Nor in the son of man, in whom there is no help.
verses.Ps.146.4: His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his earth; In that very day his thoughts perish.
verses.Ps.146.5: Happy is he that hath the God of Jacob for his help, Whose hope is in Jehovah his God:
verses.Ps.146.6: Who made heaven and earth, The sea, and all that in them is; Who keepeth truth for ever;
verses.Ps.146.7: Who executeth justice for the oppressed; Who giveth food to the hungry. Jehovah looseth the prisoners;
verses.Ps.146.8: Jehovah openeth the eyes of the blind; Jehovah raiseth up them that are bowed down; Jehovah loveth the righteous;
verses.Ps.146.9: Jehovah preserveth the sojourners; He upholdeth the fatherless and widow; But the way of the wicked he turneth upside down.
verses.Ps.146.10: Jehovah will reign for ever, Thy God, O Zion, unto all generations. Praise ye Jehovah.
verses.Ps.147.1: Praise ye Jehovah; For it is good to sing praises unto our God; For it is pleasant, and praise is comely.
verses.Ps.147.2: Jehovah doth build up Jerusalem; He gathereth together the outcasts of Israel.
verses.Ps.147.3: He healeth the broken in heart, And bindeth up their wounds.
verses.Ps.147.4: He counteth the number of the stars; He calleth them all by their names.
verses.Ps.147.5: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power; His understanding is infinite.
verses.Ps.147.6: Jehovah upholdeth the meek: He bringeth the wicked down to the ground.
verses.Ps.147.7: Sing unto Jehovah with thanksgiving; Sing praises upon the harp unto our God,
verses.Ps.147.8: Who covereth the heavens with clouds, Who prepareth rain for the earth, Who maketh grass to grow upon the mountains.
verses.Ps.147.9: He giveth to the beast his food, And to the young ravens which cry.
verses.Ps.147.10: He delighteth not in the strength of the horse: He taketh no pleasure in the legs of a man.
verses.Ps.147.11: Jehovah taketh pleasure in them that fear him, In those that hope in his lovingkindness.
verses.Ps.147.12: Praise Jehovah, O Jerusalem; Praise thy God, O Zion.
verses.Ps.147.13: For he hath strengthened the bars of thy gates; He hath blessed thy children within thee.
verses.Ps.147.14: He maketh peace in thy borders; He filleth thee with the finest of the wheat.
verses.Ps.147.15: He sendeth out his commandment upon earth; His word runneth very swiftly.
verses.Ps.147.16: He giveth snow like wool; He scattereth the hoar-frost like ashes.
verses.Ps.147.17: He casteth forth his ice like morsels: Who can stand before his cold?
verses.Ps.147.18: He sendeth out his word, and melteth them: He causeth his wind to blow, and the waters flow.
verses.Ps.147.19: He showeth his word unto Jacob, His statutes and his ordinances unto Israel.
verses.Ps.147.20: He hath not dealt so with any nation; And as for his ordinances, they have not known them. Praise ye Jehovah.
verses.Ps.148.1: Praise ye Jehovah. Praise ye Jehovah from the heavens: Praise him in the heights.
verses.Ps.148.2: Praise ye him, all his angels: Praise ye him, all his host.
verses.Ps.148.3: Praise ye him, sun and moon: Praise him, all ye stars of light.
verses.Ps.148.4: Praise him, ye heavens of heavens, And ye waters that are above the heavens.
verses.Ps.148.5: Let them praise the name of Jehovah; For he commanded, and they were created.
verses.Ps.148.6: He hath also established them for ever and ever: He hath made a decree which shall not pass away.
verses.Ps.148.7: Praise Jehovah from the earth, Ye sea-monsters, and all deeps;
verses.Ps.148.8: Fire and hail, snow and vapor; Stormy wind, fulfilling his word;
verses.Ps.148.9: Mountains and all hills; Fruitful trees and all cedars;
verses.Ps.148.10: Beasts and all cattle; Creeping things and flying birds;
verses.Ps.148.11: Kings of the earth and all peoples; Princes and all judges of the earth;
verses.Ps.148.12: Both young men and virgins; Old men and children:
verses.Ps.148.13: Let them praise the name of Jehovah; For his name alone is exalted; His glory is above the earth and the heavens.
verses.Ps.148.14: And he hath lifted up the horn of his people, The praise of all his saints; Even of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Praise ye Jehovah.
verses.Ps.149.1: Praise ye Jehovah. Sing unto Jehovah a new song, And his praise in the assembly of the saints.
verses.Ps.149.2: Let Israel rejoice in him that made him: Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.
verses.Ps.149.3: Let them praise his name in the dance: Let them sing praises unto him with timbrel and harp.
verses.Ps.149.4: For Jehovah taketh pleasure in his people: He will beautify the meek with salvation.
verses.Ps.149.5: Let the saints exult in glory: Let them sing for joy upon their beds.
verses.Ps.149.6: Let the high praises of God be in their mouth, And a two-edged sword in their hand;
verses.Ps.149.7: To execute vengeance upon the nations, And punishments upon the peoples;
verses.Ps.149.8: To bind their kings with chains, And their nobles with fetters of iron;
verses.Ps.149.9: To execute upon them the judgment written: This honor have all his saints. Praise ye Jehovah.
verses.Ps.150.1: Praise ye Jehovah. Praise God in his sanctuary: Praise him in the firmament of his power.
verses.Ps.150.2: Praise him for his mighty acts: Praise him according to his excellent greatness.
verses.Ps.150.3: Praise him with trumpet sound: Praise him with psaltery and harp.
verses.Ps.150.4: Praise him with timbrel and dance: Praise him with stringed instruments and pipe.
verses.Ps.150.5: Praise him with loud cymbals: Praise him with high sounding cymbals.
verses.Ps.150.6: Let everything that hath breath praise Jehovah. Praise ye Jehovah.
verses.Prov.1.1: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel:
verses.Prov.1.2: To know wisdom and instruction; To discern the words of understanding;
verses.Prov.1.3: To receive instruction in wise dealing, In righteousness and justice and equity;
verses.Prov.1.4: To give prudence to the simple, To the young man knowledge and discretion:
verses.Prov.1.5: That the wise man may hear, and increase in learning; And that the man of understanding may attain unto sound counsels:
verses.Prov.1.6: To understand a proverb, and a figure, The words of the wise, and their dark sayings.
verses.Prov.1.7: The fear of Jehovah is the beginning of knowledge; But the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.
verses.Prov.1.8: My son, hear the instruction of thy father, And forsake not the law of thy mother:
verses.Prov.1.9: For they shall be a chaplet of grace unto thy head, And chains about thy neck.
verses.Prov.1.10: My son, if sinners entice thee, Consent thou not.
verses.Prov.1.11: If they say, Come with us, Let us lay wait for blood; Let us lurk privily for the innocent without cause;
verses.Prov.1.12: Let us swallow them up alive as Sheol, And whole, as those that go down into the pit;
verses.Prov.1.13: We shall find all precious substance; We shall fill our houses with spoil;
verses.Prov.1.14: Thou shalt cast thy lot among us; We will all have one purse:
verses.Prov.1.15: My son, walk not thou in the way with them; Refrain thy foot from their path:
verses.Prov.1.16: For their feet run to evil, And they make haste to shed blood.
verses.Prov.1.17: For in vain is the net spread In the sight of any bird:
verses.Prov.1.18: And these lay wait for their own blood; They lurk privily for their own lives.
verses.Prov.1.19: So are the ways of every one that is greedy of gain; It taketh away the life of the owners thereof.
verses.Prov.1.20: Wisdom crieth aloud in the street; She uttereth her voice in the broad places;
verses.Prov.1.21: She crieth in the chief place of concourse; At the entrance of the gates, In the city, she uttereth her words:
verses.Prov.1.22: How long, ye simple ones, will ye love simplicity? And scoffers delight them in scoffing, And fools hate knowledge?
verses.Prov.1.23: Turn you at my reproof: Behold, I will pour out my spirit upon you; I will make known my words unto you.
verses.Prov.1.24: Because I have called, and ye have refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no man hath regarded;
verses.Prov.1.25: But ye have set at nought all my counsel, And would none of my reproof:
verses.Prov.1.26: I also will laugh in the day of your calamity; I will mock when your fear cometh;
verses.Prov.1.27: When your fear cometh as a storm, And your calamity cometh on as a whirlwind; When distress and anguish come upon you.
verses.Prov.1.28: Then will they call upon me, but I will not answer; They will seek me diligently, but they shall not find me:
verses.Prov.1.29: For that they hated knowledge, And did not choose the fear of Jehovah,
verses.Prov.1.30: They would none of my counsel, They despised all my reproof.
verses.Prov.1.31: Therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their own way, And be filled with their own devices.
verses.Prov.1.32: For the backsliding of the simple shall slay them, And the careless ease of fools shall destroy them.
verses.Prov.1.33: But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall dwell securely, And shall be quiet without fear of evil.
verses.Prov.2.1: My son, if thou wilt receive my words, And lay up my commandments with thee;
verses.Prov.2.2: So as to incline thine ear unto wisdom, And apply thy heart to understanding;
verses.Prov.2.3: Yea, if thou cry after discernment, And lift up thy voice for understanding;
verses.Prov.2.4: If thou seek her as silver, And search for her as for hid treasures:
verses.Prov.2.5: Then shalt thou understand the fear of Jehovah, And find the knowledge of God.
verses.Prov.2.6: For Jehovah giveth wisdom; Out of his mouth cometh knowledge and understanding:
verses.Prov.2.7: He layeth up sound wisdom for the upright; He is a shield to them that walk in integrity;
verses.Prov.2.8: That he may guard the paths of justice, And preserve the way of his saints.
verses.Prov.2.9: Then shalt thou understand righteousness and justice, And equity, yea, every good path.
verses.Prov.2.10: For wisdom shall enter into thy heart, And knowledge shall be pleasant unto thy soul;
verses.Prov.2.11: Discretion shall watch over thee; Understanding shall keep thee:
verses.Prov.2.12: To deliver thee from the way of evil, From the men that speak perverse things;
verses.Prov.2.13: Who forsake the paths of uprightness, To walk in the ways of darkness;
verses.Prov.2.14: Who rejoice to do evil, And delight in the perverseness of evil;
verses.Prov.2.15: Who are crooked in their ways, And wayward in their paths:
verses.Prov.2.16: To deliver thee from the strange woman, Even from the foreigner that flattereth with her words;
verses.Prov.2.17: That forsaketh the friend of her youth, And forgetteth the covenant of her God:
verses.Prov.2.18: For her house inclineth unto death, And her paths unto the dead;
verses.Prov.2.19: None that go unto her return again, Neither do they attain unto the paths of life:
verses.Prov.2.20: That thou mayest walk in the way of good men, And keep the paths of the righteous.
verses.Prov.2.21: For the upright shall dwell in the land, And the perfect shall remain in it.
verses.Prov.2.22: But the wicked shall be cut off from the land, And the treacherous shall be rooted out of it.
verses.Prov.3.1: My son, forget not my law; But let thy heart keep my commandments:
verses.Prov.3.2: For length of days, and years of life, And peace, will they add to thee.
verses.Prov.3.3: Let not kindness and truth forsake thee: Bind them about thy neck; Write them upon the tablet of thy heart:
verses.Prov.3.4: So shalt thou find favor and good understanding In the sight of God and man.
verses.Prov.3.5: Trust in Jehovah with all thy heart, And lean not upon thine own understanding:
verses.Prov.3.6: In all thy ways acknowledge him, And he will direct thy paths.
verses.Prov.3.7: Be not wise in thine own eyes; Fear Jehovah, and depart from evil:
verses.Prov.3.8: It will be health to thy navel, And marrow to thy bones.
verses.Prov.3.9: Honor Jehovah with thy substance, And with the first-fruits of all thine increase:
verses.Prov.3.10: So shall thy barns be filled with plenty, And thy vats shall overflow with new wine.
verses.Prov.3.11: My son, despise not the chastening of Jehovah; Neither be weary of his reproof:
verses.Prov.3.12: For whom Jehovah loveth he reproveth, Even as a father the son in whom he delighteth.
verses.Prov.3.13: Happy is the man that findeth wisdom, And the man that getteth understanding.
verses.Prov.3.14: For the gaining of it is better than the gaining of silver, And the profit thereof than fine gold.
verses.Prov.3.15: She is more precious than rubies: And none of the things thou canst desire are to be compared unto her.
verses.Prov.3.16: Length of days is in her right hand; In her left hand are riches and honor.
verses.Prov.3.17: Her ways are ways of pleasantness, And all her paths are peace.
verses.Prov.3.18: She is a tree of life to them that lay hold upon her: And happy is every one that retaineth her.
verses.Prov.3.19: Jehovah by wisdom founded the earth; By understanding he established the heavens.
verses.Prov.3.20: By his knowledge the depths were broken up, And the skies drop down the dew.
verses.Prov.3.21: My son, let them not depart from thine eyes; Keep sound wisdom and discretion:
verses.Prov.3.22: So shall they be life unto thy soul, And grace to thy neck.
verses.Prov.3.23: Then shalt thou walk in thy way securely, And thy foot shall not stumble.
verses.Prov.3.24: When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid: Yea, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be sweet.
verses.Prov.3.25: Be not afraid of sudden fear, Neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it cometh:
verses.Prov.3.26: For Jehovah will be thy confidence, And will keep thy foot from being taken.
verses.Prov.3.27: Withhold not good from them to whom it is due, When it is in the power of thy hand to do it.
verses.Prov.3.28: Say not unto thy neighbor, Go, and come again, And to-morrow I will give; When thou hast it by thee.
verses.Prov.3.29: Devise not evil against thy neighbor, Seeing he dwelleth securely by thee.
verses.Prov.3.30: Strive not with a man without cause, If he have done thee no harm.
verses.Prov.3.31: Envy thou not the man of violence, And choose none of his ways.
verses.Prov.3.32: For the perverse is an abomination to Jehovah; But his friendship is with the upright.
verses.Prov.3.33: The curse of Jehovah is in the house of the wicked; But he blesseth the habitation of the righteous.
verses.Prov.3.34: Surely he scoffeth at the scoffers; But he giveth grace unto the lowly.
verses.Prov.3.35: The wise shall inherit glory; But shame shall be the promotion of fools.
verses.Prov.4.1: Hear, my sons, the instruction of a father, And attend to know understanding:
verses.Prov.4.2: For I give you good doctrine; Forsake ye not my law.
verses.Prov.4.3: For I was a son unto my father, Tender and only beloved in the sight of my mother.
verses.Prov.4.4: And he taught me, and said unto me: Let thy heart retain my words; Keep my commandments, and live;
verses.Prov.4.5: Get wisdom, get understanding; Forget not, neither decline from the words of my mouth;
verses.Prov.4.6: Forsake her not, and she will preserve thee; Love her, and she will keep thee.
verses.Prov.4.7: Wisdom is the principal thing; therefore get wisdom; Yea, with all thy getting get understanding.
verses.Prov.4.8: Exalt her, and she will promote thee; She will bring thee to honor, when thou dost embrace her.
verses.Prov.4.9: She will give to thy head a chaplet of grace; A crown of beauty will she deliver to thee.
verses.Prov.4.10: Hear, O my son, and receive my sayings; And the years of thy life shall be many.
verses.Prov.4.11: I have taught thee in the way of wisdom; I have led thee in paths of uprightness.
verses.Prov.4.12: When thou goest, thy steps shall not be straitened; And if thou runnest, thou shalt not stumble.
verses.Prov.4.13: Take fast hold of instruction; let her not go: Keep her; for she is thy life.
verses.Prov.4.14: Enter not into the path of the wicked, And walk not in the way of evil men.
verses.Prov.4.15: Avoid it, pass not by it; Turn from it, and pass on.
verses.Prov.4.16: For they sleep not, except they do evil; And their sleep is taken away, unless they cause some to fall.
verses.Prov.4.17: For they eat the bread of wickedness, And drink the wine of violence.
verses.Prov.4.18: But the path of the righteous is as the dawning light, That shineth more and more unto the perfect day.
verses.Prov.4.19: The way of the wicked is as darkness: They know not at what they stumble.
verses.Prov.4.20: My son, attend to my words; Incline thine ear unto my sayings.
verses.Prov.4.21: Let them not depart from thine eyes; Keep them in the midst of thy heart.
verses.Prov.4.22: For they are life unto those that find them, And health to all their flesh.
verses.Prov.4.23: Keep thy heart with all diligence; For out of it are the issues of life.
verses.Prov.4.24: Put away from thee a wayward mouth, And perverse lips put far from thee.
verses.Prov.4.25: Let thine eyes look right on, And let thine eyelids look straight before thee.
verses.Prov.4.26: Make level the path of thy feet, And let all thy ways be established.
verses.Prov.4.27: Turn not to the right hand nor to the left: Remove thy foot from evil.
verses.Prov.5.1: My son, attend unto my wisdom; Incline thine ear to my understanding:
verses.Prov.5.2: That thou mayest preserve discretion, And that thy lips may keep knowledge.
verses.Prov.5.3: For the lips of a strange woman drop honey, And her mouth is smoother than oil:
verses.Prov.5.4: But in the end she is bitter as wormwood, Sharp as a two-edged sword.
verses.Prov.5.5: Her feet go down to death; Her steps take hold on Sheol;
verses.Prov.5.6: So that she findeth not the level path of life: Her ways are unstable, and she knoweth it not.
verses.Prov.5.7: Now therefore, my sons, hearken unto me, And depart not from the words of my mouth.
verses.Prov.5.8: Remove thy way far from her, And come not nigh the door of her house;
verses.Prov.5.9: Lest thou give thine honor unto others, And thy years unto the cruel;
verses.Prov.5.10: Lest strangers be filled with thy strength, And thy labors be in the house of an alien,
verses.Prov.5.11: And thou mourn at thy latter end, When thy flesh and thy body are consumed,
verses.Prov.5.12: And say, How have I hated instruction, And my heart despised reproof;
verses.Prov.5.13: Neither have I obeyed the voice of my teachers, Nor inclined mine ear to them that instructed me!
verses.Prov.5.14: I was well-nigh in all evil In the midst of the assembly and congregation.
verses.Prov.5.15: Drink waters out of thine own cistern, And running waters out of thine own well.
verses.Prov.5.16: Should thy springs be dispersed abroad, And streams of water in the streets?
verses.Prov.5.17: Let them be for thyself alone, And not for strangers with thee.
verses.Prov.5.18: Let thy fountain be blessed; And rejoice in the wife of thy youth.
verses.Prov.5.19: As a loving hind and a pleasant doe, Let her breasts satisfy thee at all times; And be thou ravished always with her love.
verses.Prov.5.20: For why shouldest thou, my son, be ravished with a strange woman, And embrace the bosom of a foreigner?
verses.Prov.5.21: For the ways of man are before the eyes of Jehovah; And he maketh level all his paths.
verses.Prov.5.22: His own iniquities shall take the wicked, And he shall be holden with the cords of his sin.
verses.Prov.5.23: He shall die for lack of instruction; And in the greatness of his folly he shall go astray.
verses.Prov.6.1: My son, if thou art become surety for thy neighbor, If thou hast stricken thy hands for a stranger;
verses.Prov.6.2: Thou art snared with the words of thy mouth, Thou art taken with the words of thy mouth.
verses.Prov.6.3: Do this now, my son, and deliver thyself, Seeing thou art come into the hand of thy neighbor: Go, humble thyself, and importune thy neighbor;
verses.Prov.6.4: Give not sleep to thine eyes, Nor slumber to thine eyelids;
verses.Prov.6.5: Deliver thyself as a roe from the hand of the hunter, And as a bird from the hand of the fowler.
verses.Prov.6.6: Go to the ant, thou sluggard; Consider her ways, and be wise:
verses.Prov.6.7: Which having no chief, Overseer, or ruler,
verses.Prov.6.8: Provideth her bread in the summer, And gathereth her food in the harvest.
verses.Prov.6.9: How long wilt thou sleep, O sluggard? When wilt thou arise out of thy sleep?
verses.Prov.6.10: Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, A little folding of the hands to sleep:
verses.Prov.6.11: So shall thy poverty come as a robber, And thy want as an armed man.
verses.Prov.6.12: A worthless person, a man of iniquity, Is he that walketh with a perverse mouth;
verses.Prov.6.13: That winketh with his eyes, that speaketh with his feet, That maketh signs with his fingers;
verses.Prov.6.14: In whose heart is perverseness, Who deviseth evil continually, Who soweth discord.
verses.Prov.6.15: Therefore shall his calamity come suddenly; On a sudden shall he be broken, and that without remedy.
verses.Prov.6.16: There are six things which Jehovah hateth; Yea, seven which are an abomination unto him:
verses.Prov.6.17: Haughty eyes, a lying tongue, And hands that shed innocent blood;
verses.Prov.6.18: A heart that deviseth wicked purposes, Feet that are swift in running to mischief,
verses.Prov.6.19: A false witness that uttereth lies, And he that soweth discord among brethren.
verses.Prov.6.20: My son, keep the commandment of thy father, And forsake not the law of thy mother:
verses.Prov.6.21: Bind them continually upon thy heart; Tie them about thy neck.
verses.Prov.6.22: When thou walkest, it shall lead thee; When thou sleepest, it shall watch over thee; And when thou awakest, it shall talk with thee.
verses.Prov.6.23: For the commandment is a lamp; and the law is light; And reproofs of instruction are the way of life:
verses.Prov.6.24: To keep thee from the evil woman, From the flattery of the foreigner’s tongue.
verses.Prov.6.25: Lust not after her beauty in thy heart; Neither let her take thee with her eyelids.
verses.Prov.6.26: For on account of a harlot a man is brought to a piece of bread; And the adulteress hunteth for the precious life.
verses.Prov.6.27: Can a man take fire in his bosom, And his clothes not be burned?
verses.Prov.6.28: Or can one walk upon hot coals, And his feet not be scorched?
verses.Prov.6.29: So he that goeth in to his neighbor’s wife; Whosoever toucheth her shall not be unpunished.
verses.Prov.6.30: Men do not despise a thief, if he steal To satisfy himself when he is hungry:
verses.Prov.6.31: But if he be found, he shall restore sevenfold; He shall give all the substance of his house.
verses.Prov.6.32: He that committeth adultery with a woman is void of understanding: He doeth it who would destroy his own soul.
verses.Prov.6.33: Wounds and dishonor shall he get; And his reproach shall not be wiped away.
verses.Prov.6.34: For jealousy is the rage of a man; And he will not spare in the day of vengeance.
verses.Prov.6.35: He will not regard any ransom; Neither will he rest content, though thou givest many gifts.
verses.Prov.7.1: My son, keep my words, And lay up my commandments with thee.
verses.Prov.7.2: Keep my commandments and live; And my law as the apple of thine eye.
verses.Prov.7.3: Bind them upon thy fingers; Write them upon the tablet of thy heart.
verses.Prov.7.4: Say unto wisdom, Thou art my sister; And call understanding thy kinswoman:
verses.Prov.7.5: That they may keep thee from the strange woman, From the foreigner that flattereth with her words.
verses.Prov.7.6: For at the window of my house I looked forth through my lattice;
verses.Prov.7.7: And I beheld among the simple ones, I discerned among the youths, A young man void of understanding,
verses.Prov.7.8: Passing through the street near her corner; And he went the way to her house,
verses.Prov.7.9: In the twilight, in the evening of the day, In the middle of the night and in the darkness.
verses.Prov.7.10: And, behold, there met him a woman With the attire of a harlot, and wily of heart.
verses.Prov.7.11: (She is clamorous and wilful; Her feet abide not in her house:
verses.Prov.7.12: Now she is in the streets, now in the broad places, And lieth in wait at every corner.)
verses.Prov.7.13: So she caught him, and kissed him, And with an impudent face she said unto him:
verses.Prov.7.14: Sacrifices of peace-offerings are with me; This day have I paid my vows.
verses.Prov.7.15: Therefore came I forth to meet thee, Diligently to seek thy face, and I have found thee.
verses.Prov.7.16: I have spread my couch with carpets of tapestry, With striped cloths of the yarn of Egypt.
verses.Prov.7.17: I have perfumed my bed With myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
verses.Prov.7.18: Come, let us take our fill of love until the morning; Let us solace ourselves with loves.
verses.Prov.7.19: For the man is not at home; He is gone a long journey:
verses.Prov.7.20: He hath taken a bag of money with him; He will come home at the full moon.
verses.Prov.7.21: With her much fair speech she causeth him to yield; With the flattering of her lips she forceth him along.
verses.Prov.7.22: He goeth after her straightway, As an ox goeth to the slaughter, Or as one in fetters to the correction of the fool;
verses.Prov.7.23: Till an arrow strike through his liver; As a bird hasteth to the snare, And knoweth not that it is for his life.
verses.Prov.7.24: Now therefore, my sons, hearken unto me, And attend to the words of my mouth.
verses.Prov.7.25: Let not thy heart decline to her ways; Go not astray in her paths.
verses.Prov.7.26: For she hath cast down many wounded: Yea, all her slain are a mighty host.
verses.Prov.7.27: Her house is the way to Sheol, Going down to the chambers of death.
verses.Prov.8.1: Doth not wisdom cry, And understanding put forth her voice?
verses.Prov.8.2: On the top of high places by the way, Where the paths meet, she standeth;
verses.Prov.8.3: Beside the gates, at the entry of the city, At the coming in at the doors, she crieth aloud:
verses.Prov.8.4: Unto you, O men, I call; And my voice is to the sons of men.
verses.Prov.8.5: O ye simple, understand prudence; And, ye fools, be of an understanding heart.
verses.Prov.8.6: Hear, for I will speak excellent things; And the opening of my lips shall be right things.
verses.Prov.8.7: For my mouth shall utter truth; And wickedness is an abomination to my lips.
verses.Prov.8.8: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness; There is nothing crooked or perverse in them.
verses.Prov.8.9: They are all plain to him that understandeth, And right to them that find knowledge.
verses.Prov.8.10: Receive my instruction, and not silver; And knowledge rather than choice gold.
verses.Prov.8.11: For wisdom is better than rubies; And all the things that may be desired are not to be compared unto it.
verses.Prov.8.12: I wisdom have made prudence my dwelling, And find out knowledge and discretion.
verses.Prov.8.13: The fear of Jehovah is to hate evil: Pride, and arrogancy, and the evil way, And the perverse mouth, do I hate.
verses.Prov.8.14: Counsel is mine, and sound knowledge: I am understanding; I have might.
verses.Prov.8.15: By me kings reign, And princes decree justice.
verses.Prov.8.16: By me princes rule, And nobles, even all the judges of the earth.
verses.Prov.8.17: I love them that love me; And those that seek me diligently shall find me.
verses.Prov.8.18: Riches and honor are with me; Yea, durable wealth and righteousness.
verses.Prov.8.19: My fruit is better than gold, yea, than fine gold; And my revenue than choice silver.
verses.Prov.8.20: I walk in the way of righteousness, In the midst of the paths of justice;
verses.Prov.8.21: That I may cause those that love me to inherit substance, And that I may fill their treasuries.
verses.Prov.8.22: Jehovah possessed me in the beginning of his way, Before his works of old.
verses.Prov.8.23: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, Before the earth was.
verses.Prov.8.24: When there were no depths, I was brought forth, When there were no fountains abounding with water.
verses.Prov.8.25: Before the mountains were settled, Before the hills was I brought forth;
verses.Prov.8.26: While as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, Nor the beginning of the dust of the world.
verses.Prov.8.27: When he established the heavens, I was there: When he set a circle upon the face of the deep,
verses.Prov.8.28: When he made firm the skies above, When the fountains of the deep became strong,
verses.Prov.8.29: When he gave to the sea its bound, That the waters should not transgress his commandment, When he marked out the foundations of the earth;
verses.Prov.8.30: Then I was by him, as a master workman; And I was daily his delight, Rejoicing always before him,
verses.Prov.8.31: Rejoicing in his habitable earth; And my delight was with the sons of men.
verses.Prov.8.32: Now therefore, my sons, hearken unto me; For blessed are they that keep my ways.
verses.Prov.8.33: Hear instruction, and be wise, And refuse it not.
verses.Prov.8.34: Blessed is the man that heareth me, Watching daily at my gates, Waiting at the posts of my doors.
verses.Prov.8.35: For whoso findeth me findeth life, And shall obtain favor of Jehovah.
verses.Prov.8.36: But he that sinneth against me wrongeth his own soul: All they that hate me love death.
verses.Prov.9.1: Wisdom hath builded her house; She hath hewn out her seven pillars:
verses.Prov.9.2: She hath killed her beasts; she hath mingled her wine; She hath also furnished her table:
verses.Prov.9.3: She hath sent forth her maidens; She crieth upon the highest places of the city:
verses.Prov.9.4: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: As for him that is void of understanding, she saith to him,
verses.Prov.9.5: Come, eat ye of my bread, And drink of the wine which I have mingled.
verses.Prov.9.6: Leave off, ye simple ones, and live; And walk in the way of understanding.
verses.Prov.9.7: He that correcteth a scoffer getteth to himself reviling; And he that reproveth a wicked man getteth himself a blot.
verses.Prov.9.8: Reprove not a scoffer, lest he hate thee: Reprove a wise man, and he will love thee.
verses.Prov.9.9: Give instruction to a wise man, and he will be yet wiser: Teach a righteous man, and he will increase in learning.
verses.Prov.9.10: The fear of Jehovah is the beginning of wisdom; And the knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.
verses.Prov.9.11: For by me thy days shall be multiplied, And the years of thy life shall be increased.
verses.Prov.9.12: If thou art wise, thou art wise for thyself; And if thou scoffest, thou alone shalt bear it.
verses.Prov.9.13: The foolish woman is clamorous; She is simple, and knoweth nothing.
verses.Prov.9.14: And she sitteth at the door of her house, On a seat in the high places of the city,
verses.Prov.9.15: To call to them that pass by, Who go right on their ways:
verses.Prov.9.16: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither; And as for him that is void of understanding, she saith to him,
verses.Prov.9.17: Stolen waters are sweet, And bread eaten in secret is pleasant.
verses.Prov.9.18: But he knoweth not that the dead are there; That her guests are in the depths of Sheol.
verses.Prov.10.1: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son maketh a glad father; But a foolish son is the heaviness of his mother.
verses.Prov.10.2: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing; But righteousness delivereth from death.
verses.Prov.10.3: Jehovah will not suffer the soul of the righteous to famish; But he thrusteth away the desire of the wicked.
verses.Prov.10.4: He becometh poor that worketh with a slack hand; But the hand of the diligent maketh rich.
verses.Prov.10.5: He that gathereth in summer is a wise son; But he that sleepeth in harvest is a son that causeth shame.
verses.Prov.10.6: Blessings are upon the head of the righteous; But violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.
verses.Prov.10.7: The memory of the righteous is blessed; But the name of the wicked shall rot.
verses.Prov.10.8: The wise in heart will receive commandments; But a prating fool shall fall.
verses.Prov.10.9: He that walketh uprightly walketh surely; But he that perverteth his ways shall be known.
verses.Prov.10.10: He that winketh with the eye causeth sorrow; But a prating fool shall fall.
verses.Prov.10.11: The mouth of the righteous is a fountain of life; But violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.
verses.Prov.10.12: Hatred stirreth up strifes; But love covereth all transgressions.
verses.Prov.10.13: In the lips of him that hath discernment wisdom is found; But a rod is for the back of him that is void of understanding.
verses.Prov.10.14: Wise men lay up knowledge; But the mouth of the foolish is a present destruction.
verses.Prov.10.15: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city: The destruction of the poor is their poverty.
verses.Prov.10.16: The labor of the righteous tendeth to life; The increase of the wicked, to sin.
verses.Prov.10.17: He is in the way of life that heedeth correction; But he that forsaketh reproof erreth.
verses.Prov.10.18: He that hideth hatred is of lying lips; And he that uttereth a slander is a fool.
verses.Prov.10.19: In the multitude of words there wanteth not transgression; But he that refraineth his lips doeth wisely.
verses.Prov.10.20: The tongue of the righteous is as choice silver: The heart of the wicked is little worth.
verses.Prov.10.21: The lips of the righteous feed many; But the foolish die for lack of understanding.
verses.Prov.10.22: The blessing of Jehovah, it maketh rich; And he addeth no sorrow therewith.
verses.Prov.10.23: It is as sport to a fool to do wickedness; And so is wisdom to a man of understanding.
verses.Prov.10.24: The fear of the wicked, it shall come upon him; And the desire of the righteous shall be granted.
verses.Prov.10.25: When the whirlwind passeth, the wicked is no more; But the righteous is an everlasting foundation.
verses.Prov.10.26: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, So is the sluggard to them that send him.
verses.Prov.10.27: The fear of Jehovah prolongeth days; But the years of the wicked shall be shortened.
verses.Prov.10.28: The hope of the righteous shall be gladness; But the expectation of the wicked shall perish.
verses.Prov.10.29: The way of Jehovah is a stronghold to the upright; But it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.
verses.Prov.10.30: The righteous shall never be removed; But the wicked shall not dwell in the land.
verses.Prov.10.31: The mouth of the righteous bringeth forth wisdom; But the perverse tongue shall be cut off.
verses.Prov.10.32: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable; But the mouth of the wicked speaketh perverseness.
verses.Prov.11.1: A false balance is an abomination to Jehovah; But a just weight is his delight.
verses.Prov.11.2: When pride cometh, then cometh shame; But with the lowly is wisdom.
verses.Prov.11.3: The integrity of the upright shall guide them; But the perverseness of the treacherous shall destroy them.
verses.Prov.11.4: Riches profit not in the day of wrath; But righteousness delivereth from death.
verses.Prov.11.5: The righteousness of the perfect shall direct his way; But the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.
verses.Prov.11.6: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them; But the treacherous shall be taken in their own iniquity.
verses.Prov.11.7: When a wicked man dieth, his expectation shall perish; And the hope of iniquity perisheth.
verses.Prov.11.8: The righteous is delivered out of trouble; And the wicked cometh in his stead.
verses.Prov.11.9: With his mouth the godless man destroyeth his neighbor; But through knowledge shall the righteous be delivered.
verses.Prov.11.10: When it goeth well with the righteous, the city rejoiceth; And when the wicked perish, there is shouting.
verses.Prov.11.11: By the blessing of the upright the city is exalted; But it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.
verses.Prov.11.12: He that despiseth his neighbor is void of wisdom; But a man of understanding holdeth his peace.
verses.Prov.11.13: He that goeth about as a tale-bearer revealeth secrets; But he that is of a faithful spirit concealeth a matter.
verses.Prov.11.14: Where no wise guidance is, the people falleth; But in the multitude of counsellors there is safety.
verses.Prov.11.15: He that is surety for a stranger shall smart for it; But he that hateth suretyship is secure.
verses.Prov.11.16: A gracious woman obtaineth honor; And violent men obtain riches.
verses.Prov.11.17: The merciful man doeth good to his own soul; But he that is cruel troubleth his own flesh.
verses.Prov.11.18: The wicked earneth deceitful wages; But he that soweth righteousness hath a sure reward.
verses.Prov.11.19: He that is stedfast in righteousness shall attain unto life; And he that pursueth evil doeth it to his own death.
verses.Prov.11.20: They that are perverse in heart are an abomination to Jehovah; But such as are perfect in their way are his delight.
verses.Prov.11.21: Though hand join in hand, the evil man shall not be unpunished; But the seed of the righteous shall be delivered.
verses.Prov.11.22: As a ring of gold in a swine’s snout, So is a fair woman that is without discretion.
verses.Prov.11.23: The desire of the righteous is only good; But the expectation of the wicked is wrath.
verses.Prov.11.24: There is that scattereth, and increaseth yet more; And there is that withholdeth more than is meet, but it tendeth only to want.
verses.Prov.11.25: The liberal soul shall be made fat; And he that watereth shall be watered also himself.
verses.Prov.11.26: He that withholdeth grain, the people shall curse him; But blessing shall be upon the head of him that selleth it.
verses.Prov.11.27: He that diligently seeketh good seeketh favor; But he that searcheth after evil, it shall come unto him.
verses.Prov.11.28: He that trusteth in his riches shall fall; But the righteous shall flourish as the green leaf.
verses.Prov.11.29: He that troubleth his own house shall inherit the wind; And the foolish shall be servant to the wise of heart.
verses.Prov.11.30: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life; And he that is wise winneth souls.
verses.Prov.11.31: Behold, the righteous shall be recompensed in the earth; How much more the wicked and the sinner!
verses.Prov.12.1: Whoso loveth correction loveth knowledge; But he that hateth reproof is brutish.
verses.Prov.12.2: A good man shall obtain favor of Jehovah; But a man of wicked devices will he condemn.
verses.Prov.12.3: A man shall not be established by wickedness; But the root of the righteous shall not be moved.
verses.Prov.12.4: A worthy woman is the crown of her husband; But she that maketh ashamed is as rottenness in his bones.
verses.Prov.12.5: The thoughts of the righteous are just; But the counsels of the wicked are deceit.
verses.Prov.12.6: The words of the wicked are of lying in wait for blood; But the mouth of the upright shall deliver them.
verses.Prov.12.7: The wicked are overthrown, and are not; But the house of the righteous shall stand.
verses.Prov.12.8: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom; But he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised.
verses.Prov.12.9: Better is he that is lightly esteemed, and hath a servant, Than he that honoreth himself, and lacketh bread.
verses.Prov.12.10: A righteous man regardeth the life of his beast; But the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.
verses.Prov.12.11: He that tilleth his land shall have plenty of bread; But he that followeth after vain persons is void of understanding.
verses.Prov.12.12: The wicked desireth the net of evil men; But the root of the righteous yieldeth fruit.
verses.Prov.12.13: In the transgression of the lips is a snare to the evil man; But the righteous shall come out of trouble.
verses.Prov.12.14: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth; And the doings of a man’s hands shall be rendered unto him.
verses.Prov.12.15: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes; But he that is wise hearkeneth unto counsel.
verses.Prov.12.16: A fool’s vexation is presently known; But a prudent man concealeth shame.
verses.Prov.12.17: He that uttereth truth showeth forth righteousness; But a false witness, deceit.
verses.Prov.12.18: There is that speaketh rashly like the piercings of a sword; But the tongue of the wise is health.
verses.Prov.12.19: The lip of truth shall be established for ever; But a lying tongue is but for a moment.
verses.Prov.12.20: Deceit is in the heart of them that devise evil; But to the counsellors of peace is joy.
verses.Prov.12.21: There shall no mischief happen to the righteous; But the wicked shall be filled with evil.
verses.Prov.12.22: Lying lips are an abomination to Jehovah; But they that deal truly are his delight.
verses.Prov.12.23: A prudent man concealeth knowledge; But the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness.
verses.Prov.12.24: The hand of the diligent shall bear rule; But the slothful shall be put under taskwork.
verses.Prov.12.25: Heaviness in the heart of a man maketh it stoop; But a good word maketh it glad.
verses.Prov.12.26: The righteous is a guide to his neighbor; But the way of the wicked causeth them to err.
verses.Prov.12.27: The slothful man roasteth not that which he took in hunting; But the precious substance of men is to the diligent.
verses.Prov.12.28: In the way of righteousness is life; And in the pathway thereof there is no death.
verses.Prov.13.1: A wise son heareth his father’s instruction; But a scoffer heareth not rebuke.
verses.Prov.13.2: A man shall eat good by the fruit of his mouth; But the soul of the treacherous shall eat violence.
verses.Prov.13.3: He that guardeth his mouth keepeth his life; But he that openeth wide his lips shall have destruction.
verses.Prov.13.4: The soul of the sluggard desireth, and hath nothing; But the soul of the diligent shall be made fat.
verses.Prov.13.5: A righteous man hateth lying; But a wicked man is loathsome, and cometh to shame.
verses.Prov.13.6: Righteousness guardeth him that is upright in the way; But wickedness overthroweth the sinner.
verses.Prov.13.7: There is that maketh himself rich, yet hath nothing: There is that maketh himself poor, yet hath great wealth.
verses.Prov.13.8: The ransom of a man’s life is his riches; But the poor heareth no threatening.
verses.Prov.13.9: The light of the righteous rejoiceth; But the lamp of the wicked shall be put out.
verses.Prov.13.10: By pride cometh only contention; But with the well-advised is wisdom.
verses.Prov.13.11: Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished; But he that gathereth by labor shall have increase.
verses.Prov.13.12: Hope deferred maketh the heart sick; But when the desire cometh, it is a tree of life.
verses.Prov.13.13: Whoso despiseth the word bringeth destruction on himself; But he that feareth the commandment shall be rewarded.
verses.Prov.13.14: The law of the wise is a fountain of life, That one may depart from the snares of death.
verses.Prov.13.15: Good understanding giveth favor; But the way of the transgressor is hard.
verses.Prov.13.16: Every prudent man worketh with knowledge; But a fool flaunteth his folly.
verses.Prov.13.17: A wicked messenger falleth into evil; But a faithful ambassador is health.
verses.Prov.13.18: Poverty and shame shall be to him that refuseth correction; But he that regardeth reproof shall be honored.
verses.Prov.13.19: The desire accomplished is sweet to the soul; But it is an abomination to fools to depart from evil.
verses.Prov.13.20: Walk with wise men, and thou shalt be wise; But the companion of fools shall smart for it.
verses.Prov.13.21: Evil pursueth sinners; But the righteous shall be recompensed with good.
verses.Prov.13.22: A good man leaveth an inheritance to his children’s children; And the wealth of the sinner is laid up for the righteous.
verses.Prov.13.23: Much food is in the tillage of the poor; But there is that is destroyed by reason of injustice.
verses.Prov.13.24: He that spareth his rod hateth his son; But he that loveth him chasteneth him betimes.
verses.Prov.13.25: The righteous eateth to the satisfying of his soul; But the belly of the wicked shall want.
verses.Prov.14.1: Every wise woman buildeth her house; But the foolish plucketh it down with her own hands.
verses.Prov.14.2: He that walketh in his uprightness feareth Jehovah; But he that is perverse in his ways despiseth him.
verses.Prov.14.3: In the mouth of the foolish is a rod for his pride; But the lips of the wise shall preserve them.
verses.Prov.14.4: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean; But much increase is by the strength of the ox.
verses.Prov.14.5: A faithful witness will not lie; But a false witness uttereth lies.
verses.Prov.14.6: A scoffer seeketh wisdom, and findeth it not; But knowledge is easy unto him that hath understanding.
verses.Prov.14.7: Go into the presence of a foolish man, And thou shalt not perceive in him the lips of knowledge.
verses.Prov.14.8: The wisdom of the prudent is to understand his way; But the folly of fools is deceit.
verses.Prov.14.9: A trespass-offering mocketh fools; But among the upright there is good will.
verses.Prov.14.10: The heart knoweth its own bitterness; And a stranger doth not intermeddle with its joy.
verses.Prov.14.11: The house of the wicked shall be overthrown; But the tent of the upright shall flourish.
verses.Prov.14.12: There is a way which seemeth right unto a man; But the end thereof are the ways of death.
verses.Prov.14.13: Even in laughter the heart is sorrowful; And the end of mirth is heaviness.
verses.Prov.14.14: The backslider in heart shall be filled with his own ways; And a good man shall be satisfied from himself.
verses.Prov.14.15: The simple believeth every word; But the prudent man looketh well to his going.
verses.Prov.14.16: A wise man feareth, and departeth from evil; But the fool beareth himself insolently, and is confident.
verses.Prov.14.17: He that is soon angry will deal foolishly; And a man of wicked devices is hated.
verses.Prov.14.18: The simple inherit folly; But the prudent are crowned with knowledge.
verses.Prov.14.19: The evil bow down before the good; And the wicked, at the gates of the righteous.
verses.Prov.14.20: The poor is hated even of his own neighbor; But the rich hath many friends.
verses.Prov.14.21: He that despiseth his neighbor sinneth; But he that hath pity on the poor, happy is he.
verses.Prov.14.22: Do they not err that devise evil? But mercy and truth shall be to them that devise good.
verses.Prov.14.23: In all labor there is profit; But the talk of the lips tendeth only to penury.
verses.Prov.14.24: The crown of the wise is their riches; But the folly of fools is only folly.
verses.Prov.14.25: A true witness delivereth souls; But he that uttereth lies causeth deceit.
verses.Prov.14.26: In the fear of Jehovah is strong confidence; And his children shall have a place of refuge.
verses.Prov.14.27: The fear of Jehovah is a fountain of life, That one may depart from the snares of death.
verses.Prov.14.28: In the multitude of people is the king’s glory; But in the want of people is the destruction of the prince.
verses.Prov.14.29: He that is slow to anger is of great understanding; But he that is hasty of spirit exalteth folly.
verses.Prov.14.30: A tranquil heart is the life of the flesh; But envy is the rottenness of the bones.
verses.Prov.14.31: He that oppresseth the poor reproacheth his Maker; But he that hath mercy on the needy honoreth him.
verses.Prov.14.32: The wicked is thrust down in his evil-doing; But the righteous hath a refuge in his death.
verses.Prov.14.33: Wisdom resteth in the heart of him that hath understanding; But that which is in the inward part of fools is made known.
verses.Prov.14.34: Righteousness exalteth a nation; But sin is a reproach to any people.
verses.Prov.14.35: The king’s favor is toward a servant that dealeth wisely; But his wrath will be against him that causeth shame.
verses.Prov.15.1: A soft answer turneth away wrath; But a grievous word stirreth up anger.
verses.Prov.15.2: The tongue of the wise uttereth knowledge aright; But the mouth of fools poureth out folly.
verses.Prov.15.3: The eyes of Jehovah are in every place, Keeping watch upon the evil and the good.
verses.Prov.15.4: A gentle tongue is a tree of life; But perverseness therein is a breaking of the spirit.
verses.Prov.15.5: A fool despiseth his father’s correction; But he that regardeth reproof getteth prudence.
verses.Prov.15.6: In the house of the righteous is much treasure; But in the revenues of the wicked is trouble.
verses.Prov.15.7: The lips of the wise disperse knowledge; But the heart of the foolish doeth not so.
verses.Prov.15.8: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to Jehovah; But the prayer of the upright is his delight.
verses.Prov.15.9: The way of the wicked is an abomination to Jehovah; But he loveth him that followeth after righteousness.
verses.Prov.15.10: There is grievous correction for him that forsaketh the way; And he that hateth reproof shall die.
verses.Prov.15.11: Sheol and Abaddon are before Jehovah; How much more then the hearts of the children of men!
verses.Prov.15.12: A scoffer loveth not to be reproved; He will not go unto the wise.
verses.Prov.15.13: A glad heart maketh a cheerful countenance; But by sorrow of heart the spirit is broken.
verses.Prov.15.14: The heart of him that hath understanding seeketh knowledge; But the mouth of fools feedeth on folly.
verses.Prov.15.15: All the days of the afflicted are evil; But he that is of a cheerful heart hath a continual feast.
verses.Prov.15.16: Better is little, with the fear of Jehovah, Than great treasure and trouble therewith.
verses.Prov.15.17: Better is a dinner of herbs, where love is, Than a stalled ox and hatred therewith.
verses.Prov.15.18: A wrathful man stirreth up contention; But he that is slow to anger appeaseth strife.
verses.Prov.15.19: The way of the sluggard is as a hedge of thorns; But the path of the upright is made a highway.
verses.Prov.15.20: A wise son maketh a glad father; But a foolish man despiseth his mother.
verses.Prov.15.21: Folly is joy to him that is void of wisdom; But a man of understanding maketh straight his going.
verses.Prov.15.22: Where there is no counsel, purposes are disappointed; But in the multitude of counsellors they are established.
verses.Prov.15.23: A man hath joy in the answer of his mouth; And a word in due season, how good is it!
verses.Prov.15.24: To the wise the way of life goeth upward, That he may depart from Sheol beneath.
verses.Prov.15.25: Jehovah will root up the house of the proud; But he will establish the border of the widow.
verses.Prov.15.26: Evil devices are an abomination to Jehovah; But pleasant words are pure.
verses.Prov.15.27: He that is greedy of gain troubleth his own house; But he that hateth bribes shall live.
verses.Prov.15.28: The heart of the righteous studieth to answer; But the mouth of the wicked poureth out evil things.
verses.Prov.15.29: Jehovah is far from the wicked; But he heareth the prayer of the righteous.
verses.Prov.15.30: The light of the eyes rejoiceth the heart; And good tidings make the bones fat.
verses.Prov.15.31: The ear that hearkeneth to the reproof of life Shall abide among the wise.
verses.Prov.15.32: He that refuseth correction despiseth his own soul; But he that hearkeneth to reproof getteth understanding.
verses.Prov.15.33: The fear of Jehovah is the instruction of wisdom; And before honor goeth humility.
verses.Prov.16.1: The plans of the heart belong to man; But the answer of the tongue is from Jehovah.
verses.Prov.16.2: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes; But Jehovah weigheth the spirits.
verses.Prov.16.3: Commit thy works unto Jehovah, And thy purposes shall be established.
verses.Prov.16.4: Jehovah hath made everything for its own end; Yea, even the wicked for the day of evil.
verses.Prov.16.5: Every one that is proud in heart is an abomination to Jehovah: Though hand join in hand, he shall not be unpunished.
verses.Prov.16.6: By mercy and truth iniquity is atoned for; And by the fear of Jehovah men depart from evil.
verses.Prov.16.7: When a man’s ways please Jehovah, He maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him.
verses.Prov.16.8: Better is a little, with righteousness, Than great revenues with injustice.
verses.Prov.16.9: A man’s heart deviseth his way; But Jehovah directeth his steps.
verses.Prov.16.10: A divine sentence is in the lips of the king; His mouth shall not transgress in judgment.
verses.Prov.16.11: A just balance and scales are Jehovah’s; All the weights of the bag are his work.
verses.Prov.16.12: It is an abomination to kings to commit wickedness; For the throne is established by righteousness.
verses.Prov.16.13: Righteous lips are the delight of kings; And they love him that speaketh right.
verses.Prov.16.14: The wrath of a king is as messengers of death; But a wise man will pacify it.
verses.Prov.16.15: In the light of the king’s countenance is life; And his favor is as a cloud of the latter rain.
verses.Prov.16.16: How much better is it to get wisdom than gold! Yea, to get understanding is rather to be chosen than silver.
verses.Prov.16.17: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil: He that keepeth his way preserveth his soul.
verses.Prov.16.18: Pride goeth before destruction, And a haughty spirit before a fall.
verses.Prov.16.19: Better it is to be of a lowly spirit with the poor, Than to divide the spoil with the proud.
verses.Prov.16.20: He that giveth heed unto the word shall find good; And whoso trusteth in Jehovah, happy is he.
verses.Prov.16.21: The wise in heart shall be called prudent; And the sweetness of the lips increaseth learning.
verses.Prov.16.22: Understanding is a well-spring of life unto him that hath it; But the correction of fools is their folly.
verses.Prov.16.23: The heart of the wise instructeth his mouth, And addeth learning to his lips.
verses.Prov.16.24: Pleasant words are as a honeycomb, Sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
verses.Prov.16.25: There is a way which seemeth right unto a man, But the end thereof are the ways of death.
verses.Prov.16.26: The appetite of the laboring man laboreth for him; For his mouth urgeth him thereto.
verses.Prov.16.27: A worthless man deviseth mischief; And in his lips there is as a scorching fire.
verses.Prov.16.28: A perverse man scattereth abroad strife; And a whisperer separateth chief friends.
verses.Prov.16.29: A man of violence enticeth his neighbor, And leadeth him in a way that is not good.
verses.Prov.16.30: He that shutteth his eyes, it is to devise perverse things: He that compresseth his lips bringeth evil to pass.
verses.Prov.16.31: The hoary head is a crown of glory; It shall be found in the way of righteousness.
verses.Prov.16.32: He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty; And he that ruleth his spirit, than he that taketh a city.
verses.Prov.16.33: The lot is cast into the lap; But the whole disposing thereof is of Jehovah.
verses.Prov.17.1: Better is a dry morsel, and quietness therewith, Than a house full of feasting with strife.
verses.Prov.17.2: A servant that dealeth wisely shall have rule over a son that causeth shame, And shall have part in the inheritance among the brethren.
verses.Prov.17.3: The refining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold; But Jehovah trieth the hearts.
verses.Prov.17.4: An evil-doer giveth heed to wicked lips; And a liar giveth ear to a mischievous tongue.
verses.Prov.17.5: Whoso mocketh the poor reproacheth his Maker; And he that is glad at calamity shall not be unpunished.
verses.Prov.17.6: Children’s children are the crown of old men; And the glory of children are their fathers.
verses.Prov.17.7: Excellent speech becometh not a fool; Much less do lying lips a prince.
verses.Prov.17.8: A bribe is as a precious stone in the eyes of him that hath it; Whithersoever it turneth, it prospereth.
verses.Prov.17.9: He that covereth a transgression seeketh love; But he that harpeth on a matter separateth chief friends.
verses.Prov.17.10: A rebuke entereth deeper into one that hath understanding Than a hundred stripes into a fool.
verses.Prov.17.11: An evil man seeketh only rebellion; Therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.
verses.Prov.17.12: Let a bear robbed of her whelps meet a man, Rather than a fool in his folly.
verses.Prov.17.13: Whoso rewardeth evil for good, Evil shall not depart from his house.
verses.Prov.17.14: The beginning of strife is as when one letteth out water: Therefore leave off contention, before there is quarrelling.
verses.Prov.17.15: He that justifieth the wicked, and he that condemneth the righteous, Both of them alike are an abomination to Jehovah.
verses.Prov.17.16: Wherefore is there a price in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom, Seeing he hath no understanding?
verses.Prov.17.17: A friend loveth at all times; And a brother is born for adversity.
verses.Prov.17.18: A man void of understanding striketh hands, And becometh surety in the presence of his neighbor.
verses.Prov.17.19: He loveth transgression that loveth strife: He that raiseth high his gate seeketh destruction.
verses.Prov.17.20: He that hath a wayward heart findeth no good; And he that hath a perverse tongue falleth into mischief.
verses.Prov.17.21: He that begetteth a fool doeth it to his sorrow; And the father of a fool hath no joy.
verses.Prov.17.22: A cheerful heart is a good medicine; But a broken spirit drieth up the bones.
verses.Prov.17.23: A wicked man receiveth a bribe out of the bosom, To pervert the ways of justice.
verses.Prov.17.24: Wisdom is before the face of him that hath understanding; But the eyes of a fool are in the ends of the earth.
verses.Prov.17.25: A foolish son is a grief to his father, And bitterness to her that bare him.
verses.Prov.17.26: Also to punish the righteous is not good, Nor to smite the noble for their uprightness.
verses.Prov.17.27: He that spareth his words hath knowledge; And he that is of a cool spirit is a man of understanding.
verses.Prov.17.28: Even a fool, when he holdeth his peace, is counted wise; When he shutteth his lips, he is esteemed as prudent.
verses.Prov.18.1: He that separateth himself seeketh his own desire, And rageth against all sound wisdom.
verses.Prov.18.2: A fool hath no delight in understanding, But only that his heart may reveal itself.
verses.Prov.18.3: When the wicked cometh, there cometh also contempt, And with ignominy cometh reproach.
verses.Prov.18.4: The words of a man’s mouth are as deep waters; The wellspring of wisdom is as a flowing brook.
verses.Prov.18.5: To respect the person of the wicked is not good, Nor to turn aside the righteous in judgment.
verses.Prov.18.6: A fool’s lips enter into contention, And his mouth calleth for stripes.
verses.Prov.18.7: A fool’s mouth is his destruction, And his lips are the snare of his soul.
verses.Prov.18.8: The words of a whisperer are as dainty morsels, And they go down into the innermost parts.
verses.Prov.18.9: He also that is slack in his work Is brother to him that is a destroyer.
verses.Prov.18.10: The name of Jehovah is a strong tower; The righteous runneth into it, and is safe.
verses.Prov.18.11: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city, And as a high wall in his own imagination.
verses.Prov.18.12: Before destruction the heart of man is haughty; And before honor goeth humility.
verses.Prov.18.13: He that giveth answer before he heareth, It is folly and shame unto him.
verses.Prov.18.14: The spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity; But a broken spirit who can bear?
verses.Prov.18.15: The heart of the prudent getteth knowledge; And the ear of the wise seeketh knowledge.
verses.Prov.18.16: A man’s gift maketh room for him, And bringeth him before great men.
verses.Prov.18.17: He that pleadeth his cause first seemeth just; But his neighbor cometh and searcheth him out.
verses.Prov.18.18: The lot causeth contentions to cease, And parteth between the mighty.
