verses.Heb.11.9: By faith he became a sojourner in the land of promise, as in a land not his own, dwelling in tents, with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise:
verses.Heb.11.10: for he looked for the city which hath the foundations, whose builder and maker is God.
verses.Heb.11.11: By faith even Sarah herself received power to conceive seed when she was past age, since she counted him faithful who had promised:
verses.Heb.11.12: wherefore also there sprang of one, and him as good as dead, so many as the stars of heaven in multitude, and as the sand, which is by the sea-shore, innumerable.
verses.Heb.11.13: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them and greeted them from afar, and having confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.
verses.Heb.11.14: For they that say such things make it manifest that they are seeking after a country of their own.
verses.Heb.11.15: And if indeed they had been mindful of that country from which they went out, they would have had opportunity to return.
verses.Heb.11.16: But now they desire a better country, that is, a heavenly: wherefore God is not ashamed of them, to be called their God; for he hath prepared for them a city.
verses.Heb.11.17: By faith Abraham, being tried, offered up Isaac: yea, he that had gladly received the promises was offering up his only begotten son;
verses.Heb.11.18: even he to whom it was said, In Isaac shall thy seed be called:
verses.Heb.11.19: accounting that God is able to raise up, even from the dead; from whence he did also in a figure receive him back.
verses.Heb.11.20: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau, even concerning things to come.
verses.Heb.11.21: By faith Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of the sons of Joseph; and worshipped, leaning upon the top of his staff.
verses.Heb.11.22: By faith Joseph, when his end was nigh, made mention of the departure of the children of Israel; and gave commandment concerning his bones.
verses.Heb.11.23: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hid three months by his parents, because they saw he was a goodly child; and they were not afraid of the king’s commandment.
verses.Heb.11.24: By faith Moses, when he was grown up, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter;
verses.Heb.11.25: choosing rather to share ill treatment with the people of God, than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season;
verses.Heb.11.26: accounting the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures of Egypt: for he looked unto the recompense of reward.
verses.Heb.11.27: By faith he forsook Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king: for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.
verses.Heb.11.28: By faith he kept the passover, and the sprinkling of the blood, that the destroyer of the firstborn should not touch them.
verses.Heb.11.29: By faith they passed through the Red sea as by dry land: which the Egyptians assaying to do were swallowed up.
verses.Heb.11.30: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down, after they had been compassed about for seven days.
verses.Heb.11.31: By faith Rahab the harlot perished not with them that were disobedient, having received the spies with peace.
verses.Heb.11.32: And what shall I more say? for the time will fail me if I tell of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah; of David and Samuel and the prophets:
verses.Heb.11.33: who through faith subdued kingdoms, wrought righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,
verses.Heb.11.34: quenched the power of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, from weakness were made strong, waxed mighty in war, turned to flight armies of aliens.
verses.Heb.11.35: Women received their dead by a resurrection: and others were tortured, not accepting their deliverance; that they might obtain a better resurrection:
verses.Heb.11.36: and others had trial of mockings and scourgings, yea, moreover of bonds and imprisonment:
verses.Heb.11.37: they were stoned, they were sawn asunder, they were tempted, they were slain with the sword: they went about in sheepskins, in goatskins; being destitute, afflicted, ill-treated
verses.Heb.11.38: (of whom the world was not worthy), wandering in deserts and mountains and caves, and the holes of the earth.
verses.Heb.11.39: And these all, having had witness borne to them through their faith, received not the promise,
verses.Heb.11.40: God having provided some better thing concerning us, that apart from us they should not be made perfect.
verses.Heb.12.1: Therefore let us also, seeing we are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,
verses.Heb.12.2: looking unto Jesus the author and perfecter of our faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising shame, and hath sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.
verses.Heb.12.3: For consider him that hath endured such gainsaying of sinners against himself, that ye wax not weary, fainting in your souls.
verses.Heb.12.4: Ye have not yet resisted unto blood, striving against sin:
verses.Heb.12.5: and ye have forgotten the exhortation which reasoneth with you as with sons, My son, regard not lightly the chastening of the Lord, Nor faint when thou art reproved of him;
verses.Heb.12.6: For whom the Lord loveth he chasteneth, And scourgeth every son whom he receiveth.
verses.Heb.12.7: It is for chastening that ye endure; God dealeth with you as with sons; for what son is there whom his father chasteneth not?
verses.Heb.12.8: But if ye are without chastening, whereof all have been made partakers, then are ye bastards, and not sons.
verses.Heb.12.9: Furthermore, we had the fathers of our flesh to chasten us, and we gave them reverence: shall we not much rather be in subjection unto the Father of spirits, and live?
verses.Heb.12.10: For they indeed for a few days chastened us as seemed good to them; but he for our profit, that we may be partakers of his holiness.
verses.Heb.12.11: All chastening seemeth for the present to be not joyous but grievous; yet afterward it yieldeth peaceable fruit unto them that have been exercised thereby, even the fruit of righteousness.
verses.Heb.12.12: Wherefore lift up the hands that hang down, and the palsied knees;
verses.Heb.12.13: and make straight paths for your feet, that that which is lame be not turned out of the way, but rather be healed.
verses.Heb.12.14: Follow after peace with all men, and the sanctification without which no man shall see the Lord:
verses.Heb.12.15: looking carefully lest there be any man that falleth short of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you, and thereby the many be defiled;
verses.Heb.12.16: lest there be any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau, who for one mess of meat sold his own birthright.
verses.Heb.12.17: For ye know that even when he afterward desired to inherit the blessing, he was rejected; for he found no place for a change of mind in his father, though he sought it diligently with tears.
verses.Heb.12.18: For ye are not come unto a mount that might be touched, and that burned with fire, and unto blackness, and darkness, and tempest,
verses.Heb.12.19: and the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which voice they that heard entreated that no word more should be spoken unto them;
verses.Heb.12.20: for they could not endure that which was enjoined, If even a beast touch the mountain, it shall be stoned;
verses.Heb.12.21: and so fearful was the appearance, that Moses said, I exceedingly fear and quake:
verses.Heb.12.22: but ye are come unto mount Zion, and unto the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to innumerable hosts of angels,
verses.Heb.12.23: to the general assembly and church of the firstborn who are enrolled in heaven, and to God the Judge of all, and to the spirits of just men made perfect,
verses.Heb.12.24: and to Jesus the mediator of a new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling that speaketh better than that of Abel.
verses.Heb.12.25: See that ye refuse not him that speaketh. For if they escaped not when they refused him that warned them on earth, much more shall not we escape who turn away from him that warneth from heaven:
verses.Heb.12.26: whose voice then shook the earth: but now he hath promised, saying, Yet once more will I make to tremble not the earth only, but also the heaven.
verses.Heb.12.27: And this word, Yet once more, signifieth the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that have been made, that those things which are not shaken may remain.
verses.Heb.12.28: Wherefore, receiving a kingdom that cannot be shaken, let us have grace, whereby we may offer service well-pleasing to God with reverence and awe:
verses.Heb.12.29: for our God is a consuming fire.
verses.Heb.13.1: Let love of the brethren continue.
verses.Heb.13.2: Forget not to show love unto strangers: for thereby some have entertained angels unawares.
verses.Heb.13.3: Remember them that are in bonds, as bound with them; them that are ill-treated, as being yourselves also in the body.
verses.Heb.13.4: Let marriage be had in honor among all, and let the bed be undefiled: for fornicators and adulterers God will judge.
verses.Heb.13.5: Be ye free from the love of money; content with such things as ye have: for himself hath said, I will in no wise fail thee, neither will I in any wise forsake thee.
verses.Heb.13.6: So that with good courage we say, The Lord is my helper; I will not fear: What shall man do unto me?
verses.Heb.13.7: Remember them that had the rule over you, men that spake unto you the word of God; and considering the issue of their life, imitate their faith.
verses.Heb.13.8: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and to-day, yea and for ever.
verses.Heb.13.9: Be not carried away by divers and strange teachings: for it is good that the heart be established by grace; not by meats, wherein they that occupied themselves were not profited.
verses.Heb.13.10: We have an altar, whereof they have no right to eat that serve the tabernacle.
verses.Heb.13.11: For the bodies of those beasts whose blood is brought into the holy place by the high priest as an offering for sin, are burned without the camp.
verses.Heb.13.12: Wherefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people through his own blood, suffered without the gate.
verses.Heb.13.13: Let us therefore go forth unto him without the camp, bearing his reproach.
verses.Heb.13.14: For we have not here an abiding city, but we seek after the city which is to come.
verses.Heb.13.15: Through him then let us offer up a sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of lips which make confession to his name.
verses.Heb.13.16: But to do good and to communicate forget not: for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.
verses.Heb.13.17: Obey them that have the rule over you, and submit to them: for they watch in behalf of your souls, as they that shall give account; that they may do this with joy, and not with grief: for this were unprofitable for you.
verses.Heb.13.18: Pray for us: for we are persuaded that we have a good conscience, desiring to live honorably in all things.
verses.Heb.13.19: And I exhort you the more exceedingly to do this, that I may be restored to you the sooner.
verses.Heb.13.20: Now the God of peace, who brought again from the dead the great shepherd of the sheep with the blood of an eternal covenant, even our Lord Jesus,
verses.Heb.13.21: make you perfect in every good thing to do his will, working in us that which is well-pleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ; to whom be the glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.Heb.13.22: But I exhort you, brethren, bear with the word of exhortation: for I have written unto you in few words.
verses.Heb.13.23: Know ye that our brother Timothy hath been set at liberty; with whom, if he come shortly, I will see you.
verses.Heb.13.24: Salute all them that have the rule over you, and all the saints. They of Italy salute you.
verses.Heb.13.25: Grace be with you all. Amen.
verses.Jas.1.1: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are of the Dispersion, greeting.
verses.Jas.1.2: Count it all joy, my brethren, when ye fall into manifold temptations;
verses.Jas.1.3: knowing that the proving of your faith worketh patience.
verses.Jas.1.4: And let patience have its perfect work, that ye may be perfect and entire, lacking in nothing.
verses.Jas.1.5: But if any of you lacketh wisdom, let him ask of God, who giveth to all liberally and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
verses.Jas.1.6: But let him ask in faith, nothing doubting: for he that doubteth is like the surge of the sea driven by the wind and tossed.
verses.Jas.1.7: For let not that man think that he shall receive anything of the Lord;
verses.Jas.1.8: a doubleminded man, unstable in all his ways.
verses.Jas.1.9: But let the brother of low degree glory in his high estate:
verses.Jas.1.10: and the rich, in that he is made low: because as the flower of the grass he shall pass away.
verses.Jas.1.11: For the sun ariseth with the scorching wind, and withereth the grass; and the flower thereof falleth, and the grace of the fashion of it perisheth: so also shall the rich man fade away in his goings.
verses.Jas.1.12: Blessed is the man that endureth temptation; for when he hath been approved, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord promised to them that love him.
verses.Jas.1.13: Let no man say when he is tempted, I am tempted of God; for God cannot be tempted with evil, and he himself tempteth no man:
verses.Jas.1.14: but each man is tempted, when he is drawn away by his own lust, and enticed.
verses.Jas.1.15: Then the lust, when it hath conceived, beareth sin: and the sin, when it is fullgrown, bringeth forth death.
verses.Jas.1.16: Be not deceived, my beloved brethren.
verses.Jas.1.17: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation, neither shadow that is cast by turning.
verses.Jas.1.18: Of his own will he brought us forth by the word of truth, that we should be a kind of firstfruits of his creatures.
verses.Jas.1.19: Ye know this, my beloved brethren. But let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath:
verses.Jas.1.20: for the wrath of man worketh not the righteousness of God.
verses.Jas.1.21: Wherefore putting away all filthiness and overflowing of wickedness, receive with meekness the implanted word, which is able to save your souls.
verses.Jas.1.22: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deluding your own selves.
verses.Jas.1.23: For if any one is a hearer of the word and not a doer, he is like unto a man beholding his natural face in a mirror:
verses.Jas.1.24: for he beholdeth himself, and goeth away, and straightway forgetteth what manner of man he was.
verses.Jas.1.25: But he that looketh into the perfect law, the law of liberty, and so continueth, being not a hearer that forgetteth but a doer that worketh, this man shall be blessed in his doing.
verses.Jas.1.26: If any man thinketh himself to be religious, while he bridleth not his tongue but deceiveth his heart, this man’s religion is vain.
verses.Jas.1.27: Pure religion and undefiled before our God and Father is this, to visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep oneself unspotted from the world.
verses.Jas.2.1: My brethren, hold not the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Lord of glory, with respect of persons.
verses.Jas.2.2: For if there come into your synagogue a man with a gold ring, in fine clothing, and there come in also a poor man in vile clothing;
verses.Jas.2.3: and ye have regard to him that weareth the fine clothing, and say, Sit thou here in a good place; and ye say to the poor man, Stand thou there, or sit under my footstool;
verses.Jas.2.4: do ye not make distinctions among yourselves, and become judges with evil thoughts?
verses.Jas.2.5: Hearken, my beloved brethren; did not God choose them that are poor as to the world to be rich in faith, and heirs of the kingdom which he promised to them that love him?
verses.Jas.2.6: But ye have dishonored the poor man. Do not the rich oppress you, and themselves drag you before the judgment-seats?
verses.Jas.2.7: Do not they blaspheme the honorable name by which ye are called?
verses.Jas.2.8: Howbeit if ye fulfil the royal law, according to the scripture, Thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself, ye do well:
verses.Jas.2.9: but if ye have respect of persons, ye commit sin, being convicted by the law as transgressors.
verses.Jas.2.10: For whosoever shall keep the whole law, and yet stumble in one point, he is become guilty of all.
verses.Jas.2.11: For he that said, Do not commit adultery, said also, Do not kill. Now if thou dost not commit adultery, but killest, thou art become a transgressor of the law.
verses.Jas.2.12: So speak ye, and so do, as men that are to be judged by a law of liberty.
verses.Jas.2.13: For judgment is without mercy to him that hath showed no mercy: mercy glorieth against judgment.
verses.Jas.2.14: What doth it profit, my brethren, if a man say he hath faith, but have not works? can that faith save him?
verses.Jas.2.15: If a brother or sister be naked and in lack of daily food,
verses.Jas.2.16: and one of you say unto them, Go in peace, be ye warmed and filled; and yet ye give them not the things needful to the body; what doth it profit?
verses.Jas.2.17: Even so faith, if it have not works, is dead in itself.
verses.Jas.2.18: Yea, a man will say, Thou hast faith, and I have works: show me thy faith apart from thy works, and I by my works will show thee my faith.
verses.Jas.2.19: Thou believest that God is one; thou doest well: the demons also believe, and shudder.
verses.Jas.2.20: But wilt thou know, O vain man, that faith apart from works is barren?
verses.Jas.2.21: Was not Abraham our father justified by works, in that he offered up Isaac his son upon the altar?
verses.Jas.2.22: Thou seest that faith wrought with his works, and by works was faith made perfect;
verses.Jas.2.23: and the scripture was fulfilled which saith, And Abraham believed God, and it was reckoned unto him for righteousness; and he was called the friend of God.
verses.Jas.2.24: Ye see that by works a man is justified, and not only by faith.
verses.Jas.2.25: And in like manner was not also Rahab the harlot justified by works, in that she received the messengers, and sent them out another way?
verses.Jas.2.26: For as the body apart from the spirit is dead, even so faith apart from works is dead.
verses.Jas.3.1: Be not many of you teachers, my brethren, knowing that we shall receive heavier judgment.
verses.Jas.3.2: For in many things we all stumble. If any stumbleth not in word, the same is a perfect man, able to bridle the whole body also.
verses.Jas.3.3: Now if we put the horses’ bridles into their mouths that they may obey us, we turn about their whole body also.
verses.Jas.3.4: Behold, the ships also, though they are so great and are driven by rough winds, are yet turned about by a very small rudder, whither the impulse of the steersman willeth.
verses.Jas.3.5: So the tongue also is a little member, and boasteth great things. Behold, how much wood is kindled by how small a fire!
verses.Jas.3.6: And the tongue is a fire: the world of iniquity among our members is the tongue, which defileth the whole body, and setteth on fire the wheel of nature, and is set on fire by hell.
verses.Jas.3.7: For every kind of beasts and birds, of creeping things and things in the sea, is tamed, and hath been tamed by mankind:
verses.Jas.3.8: but the tongue can no man tame; it is a restless evil, it is full of deadly poison.
verses.Jas.3.9: Therewith bless we the Lord and Father; and therewith curse we men, who are made after the likeness of God:
verses.Jas.3.10: out of the same mouth cometh forth blessing and cursing. My brethren, these things ought not so to be.
verses.Jas.3.11: Doth the fountain send forth from the same opening sweet water and bitter?
verses.Jas.3.12: can a fig tree, my brethren, yield olives, or a vine figs? neither can salt water yield sweet.
verses.Jas.3.13: Who is wise and understanding among you? let him show by his good life his works in meekness of wisdom.
verses.Jas.3.14: But if ye have bitter jealousy and faction in your heart, glory not and lie not against the truth.
verses.Jas.3.15: This wisdom is not a wisdom that cometh down from above, but is earthly, sensual, devilish.
verses.Jas.3.16: For where jealousy and faction are, there is confusion and every vile deed.
verses.Jas.3.17: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, easy to be entreated, full of mercy and good fruits, without variance, without hypocrisy.
verses.Jas.3.18: And the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace for them that make peace.
verses.Jas.4.1: Whence come wars and whence come fightings among you? come they not hence, even of your pleasures that war in your members?
verses.Jas.4.2: Ye lust, and have not: ye kill, and covet, and cannot obtain: ye fight and war; ye have not, because ye ask not.
verses.Jas.4.3: Ye ask, and receive not, because ye ask amiss, that ye may spend it in your pleasures.
verses.Jas.4.4: Ye adulteresses, know ye not that the friendship of the world is enmity with God? Whosoever therefore would be a friend of the world maketh himself an enemy of God.
verses.Jas.4.5: Or think ye that the scripture speaketh in vain? Doth the spirit which he made to dwell in us long unto envying?
verses.Jas.4.6: But he giveth more grace. Wherefore the scripture saith, God resisteth the proud, but giveth grace to the humble.
verses.Jas.4.7: Be subject therefore unto God; but resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
verses.Jas.4.8: Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse your hands, ye sinners; and purify your hearts, ye doubleminded.
verses.Jas.4.9: Be afflicted, and mourn, and weep: let your laughter be turned to mourning, and your joy to heaviness.
verses.Jas.4.10: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he shall exalt you.
verses.Jas.4.11: Speak not one against another, brethren. He that speaketh against a brother, or judgeth his brother, speaketh against the law, and judgeth the law: but if thou judgest the law, thou art not a doer of the law, but a judge.
verses.Jas.4.12: One only is the lawgiver and judge, even he who is able to save and to destroy: but who art thou that judgest thy neighbor?
verses.Jas.4.13: Come now, ye that say, To-day or to-morrow we will go into this city, and spend a year there, and trade, and get gain:
verses.Jas.4.14: whereas ye know not what shall be on the morrow. What is your life? For ye are a vapor that appeareth for a little time, and then vanisheth away.
verses.Jas.4.15: For that ye ought to say, If the Lord will, we shall both live, and do this or that.
verses.Jas.4.16: But now ye glory in your vauntings: all such glorying is evil.
verses.Jas.4.17: To him therefore that knoweth to do good, and doeth it not, to him it is sin.
verses.Jas.5.1: Come now, ye rich, weep and howl for your miseries that are coming upon you.
verses.Jas.5.2: Your riches are corrupted, and your garments are moth-eaten.
verses.Jas.5.3: Your gold and your silver are rusted; and their rust shall be for a testimony against you, and shall eat your flesh as fire. Ye have laid up your treasure in the last days.
verses.Jas.5.4: Behold, the hire of the laborers who mowed your fields, which is of you kept back by fraud, crieth out: and the cries of them that reaped have entered into the ears of the Lord of Sabaoth.
verses.Jas.5.5: Ye have lived delicately on the earth, and taken your pleasure; ye have nourished your hearts in a day of slaughter.
verses.Jas.5.6: Ye have condemned, ye have killed the righteous one; he doth not resist you.
verses.Jas.5.7: Be patient therefore, brethren, until the coming of the Lord. Behold, the husbandman waiteth for the precious fruit of the earth, being patient over it, until it receive the early and latter rain.
verses.Jas.5.8: Be ye also patient; establish your hearts: for the coming of the Lord is at hand.
verses.Jas.5.9: Murmur not, brethren, one against another, that ye be not judged: behold, the judge standeth before the doors.
verses.Jas.5.10: Take, brethren, for an example of suffering and of patience, the prophets who spake in the name of the Lord.
verses.Jas.5.11: Behold, we call them blessed that endured: ye have heard of the patience of Job, and have seen the end of the Lord, how that the Lord is full of pity, and merciful.
verses.Jas.5.12: But above all things, my brethren, swear not, neither by the heaven, nor by the earth, nor by any other oath: but let your yea be yea, and your nay, nay; that ye fall not under judgment.
verses.Jas.5.13: Is any among you suffering? let him pray. Is any cheerful? let him sing praise.
verses.Jas.5.14: Is any among you sick? let him call for the elders of the church; and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord:
verses.Jas.5.15: and the prayer of faith shall save him that is sick, and the Lord shall raise him up; and if he have committed sins, it shall be forgiven him.
verses.Jas.5.16: Confess therefore your sins one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The supplication of a righteous man availeth much in its working.
verses.Jas.5.17: Elijah was a man of like passions with us, and he prayed fervently that it might not rain; and it rained not on the earth for three years and six months.
verses.Jas.5.18: And he prayed again; and the heaven gave rain, and the earth brought forth her fruit.
verses.Jas.5.19: My brethren, if any among you err from the truth, and one convert him;
verses.Jas.5.20: let him know, that he who converteth a sinner from the error of his way shall save a soul from death, and shall cover a multitude of sins.
verses.1Pet.1.1: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the elect who are sojourners of the Dispersion in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,
verses.1Pet.1.2: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, in sanctification of the Spirit, unto obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace be multiplied.
verses.1Pet.1.3: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy begat us again unto a living hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
verses.1Pet.1.4: unto an inheritance incorruptible, and undefiled, and that fadeth not away, reserved in heaven for you,
verses.1Pet.1.5: who by the power of God are guarded through faith unto a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
verses.1Pet.1.6: Wherein ye greatly rejoice, though now for a little while, if need be, ye have been put to grief in manifold trials,
verses.1Pet.1.7: that the proof of your faith, being more precious than gold that perisheth though it is proved by fire, may be found unto praise and glory and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ:
verses.1Pet.1.8: whom not having seen ye love; on whom, though now ye see him not, yet believing, ye rejoice greatly with joy unspeakable and full of glory:
verses.1Pet.1.9: receiving the end of your faith, even the salvation of your souls.
verses.1Pet.1.10: Concerning which salvation the prophets sought and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace that should come unto you:
verses.1Pet.1.11: searching what time or what manner of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them did point unto, when it testified beforehand the sufferings of Christ, and the glories that should follow them.
verses.1Pet.1.12: To whom it was revealed, that not unto themselves, but unto you, did they minister these things, which now have been announced unto you through them that preached the gospel unto you by the Holy Spirit sent forth from heaven; which things angels desire to look into.
verses.1Pet.1.13: Wherefore girding up the loins of your mind, be sober and set your hope perfectly on the grace that is to be brought unto you at the revelation of Jesus Christ;
verses.1Pet.1.14: as children of obedience, not fashioning yourselves according to your former lusts in the time of your ignorance:
verses.1Pet.1.15: but like as he who called you is holy, be ye yourselves also holy in all manner of living;
verses.1Pet.1.16: because it is written, Ye shall be holy; for I am holy.
verses.1Pet.1.17: And if ye call on him as Father, who without respect of persons judgeth according to each man’s work, pass the time of your sojourning in fear:
verses.1Pet.1.18: knowing that ye were redeemed, not with corruptible things, with silver or gold, from your vain manner of life handed down from your fathers;
verses.1Pet.1.19: but with precious blood, as of a lamb without blemish and without spot, even the blood of Christ:
verses.1Pet.1.20: who was foreknown indeed before the foundation of the world, but was manifested at the end of the times for your sake,
verses.1Pet.1.21: who through him are believers in God, that raised him from the dead, and gave him glory; so that your faith and hope might be in God.
verses.1Pet.1.22: Seeing ye have purified your souls in your obedience to the truth unto unfeigned love of the brethren, love one another from the heart fervently:
verses.1Pet.1.23: having been begotten again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, through the word of God, which liveth and abideth.
verses.1Pet.1.24: For, All flesh is as grass, And all the glory thereof as the flower of grass. The grass withereth, and the flower falleth:
verses.1Pet.1.25: But the word of the Lord abideth for ever. And this is the word of good tidings which was preached unto you.
verses.1Pet.2.1: Putting away therefore all wickedness, and all guile, and hypocrisies, and envies, and all evil speakings,
verses.1Pet.2.2: as newborn babes, long for the spiritual milk which is without guile, that ye may grow thereby unto salvation;
verses.1Pet.2.3: if ye have tasted that the Lord is gracious:
verses.1Pet.2.4: unto whom coming, a living stone, rejected indeed of men, but with God elect, precious,
verses.1Pet.2.5: ye also, as living stones, are built up a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.
verses.1Pet.2.6: Because it is contained in scripture, Behold, I lay in Zion a chief corner stone, elect, precious: And he that believeth on him shall not be put to shame.
verses.1Pet.2.7: For you therefore that believe is the preciousness: but for such as disbelieve, The stone which the builders rejected, The same was made the head of the corner;
verses.1Pet.2.8: and, A stone of stumbling, and a rock of offence; for they stumble at the word, being disobedient: whereunto also they were appointed.
verses.1Pet.2.9: But ye are an elect race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that ye may show forth the excellencies of him who called you out of darkness into his marvellous light:
verses.1Pet.2.10: who in time past were no people, but now are the people of God: who had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.
verses.1Pet.2.11: Beloved, I beseech you as sojourners and pilgrims, to abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul;
verses.1Pet.2.12: having your behavior seemly among the Gentiles; that, wherein they speak against you as evil-doers, they may by your good works, which they behold, glorify God in the day of visitation.
verses.1Pet.2.13: Be subject to every ordinance of man for the Lord’s sake: whether to the king, as supreme;
verses.1Pet.2.14: or unto governors, as sent by him for vengeance on evil-doers and for praise to them that do well.
verses.1Pet.2.15: For so is the will of God, that by well-doing ye should put to silence the ignorance of foolish men:
verses.1Pet.2.16: as free, and not using your freedom for a cloak of wickedness, but as bondservants of God.
verses.1Pet.2.17: Honor all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.
verses.1Pet.2.18: Servants, be in subjection to your masters with all fear; not only to the good and gentle, but also to the froward.
verses.1Pet.2.19: For this is acceptable, if for conscience toward God a man endureth griefs, suffering wrongfully.
verses.1Pet.2.20: For what glory is it, if, when ye sin, and are buffeted for it, ye shall take it patiently? but if, when ye do well, and suffer for it, ye shall take it patiently, this is acceptable with God.
verses.1Pet.2.21: For hereunto were ye called: because Christ also suffered for you, leaving you an example, that ye should follow his steps:
verses.1Pet.2.22: who did no sin, neither was guile found in his mouth:
verses.1Pet.2.23: who, when he was reviled, reviled not again; when he suffered, threatened not; but committed himself to him that judgeth righteously:
verses.1Pet.2.24: who his own self bare our sins in his body upon the tree, that we, having died unto sins, might live unto righteousness; by whose stripes ye were healed.
verses.1Pet.2.25: For ye were going astray like sheep; but are now returned unto the Shepherd and Bishop of your souls.
verses.1Pet.3.1: In like manner, ye wives, be in subjection to your own husbands; that, even if any obey not the word, they may without the word be gained by the behavior of their wives;
verses.1Pet.3.2: beholding your chaste behavior coupled with fear.
verses.1Pet.3.3: Whose adorning let it not be the outward adorning of braiding the hair, and of wearing jewels of gold, or of putting on apparel;
verses.1Pet.3.4: but let it be the hidden man of the heart, in the incorruptible apparel of a meek and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price.
verses.1Pet.3.5: For after this manner aforetime the holy women also, who hoped in God, adorned themselves, being in subjection to their own husbands:
verses.1Pet.3.6: as Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord: whose children ye now are, if ye do well, and are not put in fear by any terror.
verses.1Pet.3.7: Ye husbands, in like manner, dwell with your wives according to knowledge, giving honor unto the woman, as unto the weaker vessel, as being also joint-heirs of the grace of life; to the end that your prayers be not hindered.
verses.1Pet.3.8: Finally, be ye all likeminded, compassionate, loving as brethren, tenderhearted, humbleminded:
verses.1Pet.3.9: not rendering evil for evil, or reviling for reviling; but contrariwise blessing; for hereunto were ye called, that ye should inherit a blessing.
verses.1Pet.3.10: For, He that would love life, And see good days, Let him refrain his tongue from evil, And his lips that they speak no guile:
verses.1Pet.3.11: And let him turn away from evil, and do good; Let him seek peace, and pursue it.
verses.1Pet.3.12: For the eyes of the Lord are upon the righteous, And his ears unto their supplication: But the face of the Lord is upon them that do evil.
verses.1Pet.3.13: And who is he that will harm you, if ye be zealous of that which is good?
verses.1Pet.3.14: But even if ye should suffer for righteousness’ sake, blessed are ye: and fear not their fear, neither be troubled;
verses.1Pet.3.15: but sanctify in your hearts Christ as Lord: being ready always to give answer to every man that asketh you a reason concerning the hope that is in you, yet with meekness and fear:
verses.1Pet.3.16: having a good conscience; that, wherein ye are spoken against, they may be put to shame who revile your good manner of life in Christ.
verses.1Pet.3.17: For it is better, if the will of God should so will, that ye suffer for well-doing than for evil-doing.
verses.1Pet.3.18: Because Christ also suffered for sins once, the righteous for the unrighteous, that he might bring us to God; being put to death in the flesh, but made alive in the spirit;
verses.1Pet.3.19: in which also he went and preached unto the spirits in prison,
verses.1Pet.3.20: that aforetime were disobedient, when the longsuffering of God waited in the days of Noah, while the ark was a preparing, wherein few, that is, eight souls, were saved through water:
verses.1Pet.3.21: which also after a true likeness doth now save you, even baptism, not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the interrogation of a good conscience toward God, through the resurrection of Jesus Christ;
verses.1Pet.3.22: who is on the right hand of God, having gone into heaven; angels and authorities and powers being made subject unto him.
verses.1Pet.4.1: Forasmuch then as Christ suffered in the flesh, arm ye yourselves also with the same mind; for he that hath suffered in the flesh hath ceased from sin;
verses.1Pet.4.2: that ye no longer should live the rest of your time in the flesh to the lusts of men, but to the will of God.
verses.1Pet.4.3: For the time past may suffice to have wrought the desire of the Gentiles, and to have walked in lasciviousness, lusts, winebibbings, revellings, carousings, and abominable idolatries:
verses.1Pet.4.4: wherein they think it strange that ye run not with them into the same excess of riot, speaking evil of you:
verses.1Pet.4.5: who shall give account to him that is ready to judge the living and the dead.
verses.1Pet.4.6: For unto this end was the gospel preached even to the dead, that they might be judged indeed according to men in the flesh, but live according to God in the spirit.
verses.1Pet.4.7: But the end of all things is at hand: be ye therefore of sound mind, and be sober unto prayer:
verses.1Pet.4.8: above all things being fervent in your love among yourselves; for love covereth a multitude of sins:
verses.1Pet.4.9: using hospitality one to another without murmuring:
verses.1Pet.4.10: according as each hath received a gift, ministering it among yourselves, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God;
verses.1Pet.4.11: if any man speaketh, speaking as it were oracles of God; if any man ministereth, ministering as of the strength which God supplieth: that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, whose is the glory and the dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.1Pet.4.12: Beloved, think it not strange concerning the fiery trial among you, which cometh upon you to prove you, as though a strange thing happened unto you:
verses.1Pet.4.13: but insomuch as ye are partakers of Christ’s sufferings, rejoice; that at the revelation of his glory also ye may rejoice with exceeding joy.
verses.1Pet.4.14: If ye are reproached for the name of Christ, blessed are ye; because the Spirit of glory and the Spirit of God resteth upon you.
verses.1Pet.4.15: For let none of you suffer as a murderer, or a thief, or an evil-doer, or as a meddler in other men’s matters:
verses.1Pet.4.16: but if a man suffer as a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God in this name.
verses.1Pet.4.17: For the time is come for judgment to begin at the house of God: and if it begin first at us, what shall be the end of them that obey not the gospel of God?
verses.1Pet.4.18: And if the righteous is scarcely saved, where shall the ungodly and sinner appear?
verses.1Pet.4.19: Wherefore let them also that suffer according to the will of God commit their souls in well-doing unto a faithful Creator.
verses.1Pet.5.1: The elders therefore among you I exhort, who am a fellow-elder, and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, who am also a partaker of the glory that shall be revealed:
verses.1Pet.5.2: Tend the flock of God which is among you, exercising the oversight, not of constraint, but willingly, according to the will of God; nor yet for filthy lucre, but of a ready mind;
verses.1Pet.5.3: neither as lording it over the charge allotted to you, but making yourselves ensamples to the flock.
verses.1Pet.5.4: And when the chief Shepherd shall be manifested, ye shall receive the crown of glory that fadeth not away.
verses.1Pet.5.5: Likewise, ye younger, be subject unto the elder. Yea, all of you gird yourselves with humility, to serve one another: for God resisteth the proud, but giveth grace to the humble.
verses.1Pet.5.6: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time;
verses.1Pet.5.7: casting all your anxiety upon him, because he careth for you.
verses.1Pet.5.8: Be sober, be watchful: your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:
verses.1Pet.5.9: whom withstand stedfast in your faith, knowing that the same sufferings are accomplished in your brethren who are in the world.
verses.1Pet.5.10: And the God of all grace, who called you unto his eternal glory in Christ, after that ye have suffered a little while, shall himself perfect, establish, strengthen you.
verses.1Pet.5.11: To him be the dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.1Pet.5.12: By Silvanus, our faithful brother, as I account him, I have written unto you briefly, exhorting, and testifying that this is the true grace of God: stand ye fast therein.
verses.1Pet.5.13: She that is in Babylon, elect together with you, saluteth you; and so doth Mark my son.
verses.1Pet.5.14: Salute one another with a kiss of love. Peace be unto you all that are in Christ.
verses.2Pet.1.1: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, to them that have obtained a like precious faith with us in the righteousness of our God and the Saviour Jesus Christ:
verses.2Pet.1.2: Grace to you and peace be multiplied in the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord;
verses.2Pet.1.3: seeing that his divine power hath granted unto us all things that pertain unto life and godliness, through the knowledge of him that called us by his own glory and virtue;
verses.2Pet.1.4: whereby he hath granted unto us his precious and exceeding great promises; that through these ye may become partakers of the divine nature, having escaped from the corruption that is in the world by lust.
verses.2Pet.1.5: Yea, and for this very cause adding on your part all diligence, in your faith supply virtue; and in your virtue knowledge;
verses.2Pet.1.6: and in your knowledge self-control; and in your self-control patience; and in your patience godliness;
verses.2Pet.1.7: and in your godliness brotherly kindness; and in your brotherly kindness love.
verses.2Pet.1.8: For if these things are yours and abound, they make you to be not idle nor unfruitful unto the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.2Pet.1.9: For he that lacketh these things is blind, seeing only what is near, having forgotten the cleansing from his old sins.
verses.2Pet.1.10: Wherefore, brethren, give the more diligence to make your calling and election sure: for if ye do these things, ye shall never stumble:
verses.2Pet.1.11: for thus shall be richly supplied unto you the entrance into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ.
verses.2Pet.1.12: Wherefore I shall be ready always to put you in remembrance of these things, though ye know them, and are established in the truth which is with you.
verses.2Pet.1.13: And I think it right, as long as I am in this tabernacle, to stir you up by putting you in remembrance;
verses.2Pet.1.14: knowing that the putting off of my tabernacle cometh swiftly, even as our Lord Jesus Christ signified unto me.
verses.2Pet.1.15: Yea, I will give diligence that at every time ye may be able after my decease to call these things to remembrance.
verses.2Pet.1.16: For we did not follow cunningly devised fables, when we made known unto you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but we were eyewitnesses of his majesty.
verses.2Pet.1.17: For he received from God the Father honor and glory, when there was borne such a voice to him by the Majestic Glory, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased:
verses.2Pet.1.18: and this voice we ourselves heard borne out of heaven, when we were with him in the holy mount.
verses.2Pet.1.19: And we have the word of prophecy made more sure; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day-star arise in your hearts:
verses.2Pet.1.20: knowing this first, that no prophecy of scripture is of private interpretation.
verses.2Pet.1.21: For no prophecy ever came by the will of man: but men spake from God, being moved by the Holy Spirit.
verses.2Pet.2.1: But there arose false prophets also among the people, as among you also there shall be false teachers, who shall privily bring in destructive heresies, denying even the Master that bought them, bringing upon themselves swift destruction.
verses.2Pet.2.2: And many shall follow their lascivious doings; by reason of whom the way of the truth shall be evil spoken of.
verses.2Pet.2.3: And in covetousness shall they with feigned words make merchandise of you: whose sentence now from of old lingereth not, and their destruction slumbereth not.
verses.2Pet.2.4: For if God spared not angels when they sinned, but cast them down to hell, and committed them to pits of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment;
verses.2Pet.2.5: and spared not the ancient world, but preserved Noah with seven others, a preacher of righteousness, when he brought a flood upon the world of the ungodly;
verses.2Pet.2.6: and turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah into ashes condemned them with an overthrow, having made them an example unto those that should live ungodly;
verses.2Pet.2.7: and delivered righteous Lot, sore distressed by the lascivious life of the wicked
verses.2Pet.2.8: (for that righteous man dwelling among them, in seeing and hearing, vexed his righteous soul from day to day with their lawless deeds):
verses.2Pet.2.9: the Lord knoweth how to deliver the godly out of temptation, and to keep the unrighteous under punishment unto the day of judgment;
verses.2Pet.2.10: but chiefly them that walk after the flesh in the lust of defilement, and despise dominion. Daring, self-willed, they tremble not to rail at dignities:
verses.2Pet.2.11: whereas angels, though greater in might and power, bring not a railing judgment against them before the Lord.
verses.2Pet.2.12: But these, as creatures without reason, born mere animals to be taken and destroyed, railing in matters whereof they are ignorant, shall in their destroying surely be destroyed,
verses.2Pet.2.13: suffering wrong as the hire of wrong-doing; men that count it pleasure to revel in the day-time, spots and blemishes, revelling in their deceivings while they feast with you;
verses.2Pet.2.14: having eyes full of adultery, and that cannot cease from sin; enticing unstedfast souls; having a heart exercised in covetousness; children of cursing;
verses.2Pet.2.15: forsaking the right way, they went astray, having followed the way of Balaam the son of Beor, who loved the hire of wrong-doing;
verses.2Pet.2.16: but he was rebuked for his own transgression: a dumb ass spake with man’s voice and stayed the madness of the prophet.
verses.2Pet.2.17: These are springs without water, and mists driven by a storm; for whom the blackness of darkness hath been reserved.
verses.2Pet.2.18: For, uttering great swelling words of vanity, they entice in the lusts of the flesh, by lasciviousness, those who are just escaping from them that live in error;
verses.2Pet.2.19: promising them liberty, while they themselves are bondservants of corruption; for of whom a man is overcome, of the same is he also brought into bondage.
verses.2Pet.2.20: For if, after they have escaped the defilements of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ, they are again entangled therein and overcome, the last state is become worse with them than the first.
verses.2Pet.2.21: For it were better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than, after knowing it, to turn back from the holy commandment delivered unto them.
verses.2Pet.2.22: It has happened unto them according to the true proverb, The dog turning to his own vomit again, and the sow that had washed to wallowing in the mire.
verses.2Pet.3.1: This is now, beloved, the second epistle that I write unto you; and in both of them I stir up your sincere mind by putting you in remembrance;
verses.2Pet.3.2: that ye should remember the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets, and the commandment of the Lord and Saviour through your apostles:
verses.2Pet.3.3: knowing this first, that in the last days mockers shall come with mockery, walking after their own lusts,
verses.2Pet.3.4: and saying, Where is the promise of his coming? for, from the day that the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.
verses.2Pet.3.5: For this they wilfully forget, that there were heavens from of old, and an earth compacted out of water and amidst water, by the word of God;
verses.2Pet.3.6: by which means the world that then was, being overflowed with water, perished:
verses.2Pet.3.7: but the heavens that now are, and the earth, by the same word have been stored up for fire, being reserved against the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men.
verses.2Pet.3.8: But forget not this one thing, beloved, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.
verses.2Pet.3.9: The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some count slackness; but is longsuffering to you-ward, not wishing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.
verses.2Pet.3.10: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief; in the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements shall be dissolved with fervent heat, and the earth and the works that are therein shall be burned up.
verses.2Pet.3.11: Seeing that these things are thus all to be dissolved, what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy living and godliness,
verses.2Pet.3.12: looking for and earnestly desiring the coming of the day of God, by reason of which the heavens being on fire shall be dissolved, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat?
verses.2Pet.3.13: But, according to his promise, we look for new heavens and a new earth, wherein dwelleth righteousness.
verses.2Pet.3.14: Wherefore, beloved, seeing that ye look for these things, give diligence that ye may be found in peace, without spot and blameless in his sight.
verses.2Pet.3.15: And account that the longsuffering of our Lord is salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also, according to the wisdom given to him, wrote unto you;
verses.2Pet.3.16: as also in all his epistles, speaking in them of these things; wherein are some things hard to be understood, which the ignorant and unstedfast wrest, as they do also the other scriptures, unto their own destruction.
verses.2Pet.3.17: Ye therefore, beloved, knowing these things beforehand, beware lest, being carried away with the error of the wicked, ye fall from your own stedfastness.
verses.2Pet.3.18: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. To him be the glory both now and for ever. Amen.
verses.1John.1.1: That which was from the beginning, that which we have heard, that which we have seen with our eyes, that which we beheld, and our hands handled, concerning the Word of life
verses.1John.1.2: (and the life was manifested, and we have seen, and bear witness, and declare unto you the life, the eternal life, which was with the Father, and was manifested unto us);
verses.1John.1.3: that which we have seen and heard declare we unto you also, that ye also may have fellowship with us: yea, and our fellowship is with the Father, and with his Son Jesus Christ:
verses.1John.1.4: and these things we write, that our joy may be made full.
verses.1John.1.5: And this is the message which we have heard from him and announce unto you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.
verses.1John.1.6: If we say that we have fellowship with him and walk in the darkness, we lie, and do not the truth:
verses.1John.1.7: but if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Jesus his Son cleanseth us from all sin.
verses.1John.1.8: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
verses.1John.1.9: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
verses.1John.1.10: If we say that we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.
verses.1John.2.1: My little children, these things write I unto you that ye may not sin. And if any man sin, we have an Advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous:
verses.1John.2.2: and he is the propitiation for our sins; and not for ours only, but also for the whole world.
verses.1John.2.3: And hereby we know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.
verses.1John.2.4: He that saith, I know him, and keepeth not his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him;
verses.1John.2.5: but whoso keepeth his word, in him verily hath the love of God been perfected. Hereby we know that we are in him:
verses.1John.2.6: he that saith he abideth in him ought himself also to walk even as he walked.
verses.1John.2.7: Beloved, no new commandment write I unto you, but an old commandment which ye had from the beginning: the old commandment is the word which ye heard.
verses.1John.2.8: Again, a new commandment write I unto you, which thing is true in him and in you; because the darkness is passing away, and the true light already shineth.
verses.1John.2.9: He that saith he is in the light and hateth his brother, is in the darkness even until now.
verses.1John.2.10: He that loveth his brother abideth in the light, and there is no occasion of stumbling in him.
verses.1John.2.11: But he that hateth his brother is in the darkness, and walketh in the darkness, and knoweth not whither he goeth, because the darkness hath blinded his eyes.
verses.1John.2.12: I write unto you, my little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake.
verses.1John.2.13: I write unto you, fathers, because ye know him who is from the beginning. I write unto you, young men, because ye have overcome the evil one. I have written unto you, little children, because ye know the Father.
verses.1John.2.14: I have written unto you, fathers, because ye know him who is from the beginning. I have written unto you, young men, because ye are strong, and the word of God abideth in you, and ye have overcome the evil one.
verses.1John.2.15: Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
verses.1John.2.16: For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh and the lust of the eyes and the vainglory of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world.
verses.1John.2.17: And the world passeth away, and the lust thereof: but he that doeth the will of God abideth for ever.
verses.1John.2.18: Little children, it is the last hour: and as ye heard that antichrist cometh, even now have there arisen many antichrists; whereby we know that it is the last hour.
verses.1John.2.19: They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would have continued with us: but they went out, that they might be made manifest that they all are not of us.
verses.1John.2.20: And ye have an anointing from the Holy One, and ye know all things.
verses.1John.2.21: I have not written unto you because ye know not the truth, but because ye know it, and because no lie is of the truth.
verses.1John.2.22: Who is the liar but he that denieth that Jesus is the Christ? This is the antichrist, even he that denieth the Father and the Son.
verses.1John.2.23: Whosoever denieth the Son, the same hath not the Father: he that confesseth the Son hath the Father also.
verses.1John.2.24: As for you, let that abide in you which ye heard from the beginning. If that which ye heard from the beginning abide in you, ye also shall abide in the Son, and in the Father.
verses.1John.2.25: And this is the promise which he promised us, even the life eternal.
verses.1John.2.26: These things have I written unto you concerning them that would lead you astray.
verses.1John.2.27: And as for you, the anointing which ye received of him abideth in you, and ye need not that any one teach you; but as his anointing teacheth you concerning all things, and is true, and is no lie, and even as it taught you, ye abide in him.
verses.1John.2.28: And now, my little children, abide in him; that, if he shall be manifested, we may have boldness, and not be ashamed before him at his coming.
verses.1John.2.29: If ye know that he is righteous, ye know that every one also that doeth righteousness is begotten of him.
verses.1John.3.1: Behold what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called children of God; and such we are. For this cause the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.
verses.1John.3.2: Beloved, now are we children of God, and it is not yet made manifest what we shall be. We know that, if he shall be manifested, we shall be like him; for we shall see him even as he is.
verses.1John.3.3: And every one that hath this hope set on him purifieth himself, even as he is pure.
verses.1John.3.4: Every one that doeth sin doeth also lawlessness; and sin is lawlessness.
verses.1John.3.5: And ye know that he was manifested to take away sins; and in him is no sin.
verses.1John.3.6: Whosoever abideth in him sinneth not: whosoever sinneth hath not seen him, neither knoweth him.
verses.1John.3.7: My little children, let no man lead you astray: he that doeth righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous:
verses.1John.3.8: he that doeth sin is of the devil; for the devil sinneth from the beginning. To this end was the Son of God manifested, that he might destroy the works of the devil.
verses.1John.3.9: Whosoever is begotten of God doeth no sin, because his seed abideth in him: and he cannot sin, because he is begotten of God.
verses.1John.3.10: In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil: whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God, neither he that loveth not his brother.
verses.1John.3.11: For this is the message which ye heard from the beginning, that we should love one another:
verses.1John.3.12: not as Cain was of the evil one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his works were evil, and his brother’s righteous.
verses.1John.3.13: Marvel not, brethren, if the world hateth you.
verses.1John.3.14: We know that we have passed out of death into life, because we love the brethren. He that loveth not abideth in death.
verses.1John.3.15: Whosoever hateth his brother is a murderer: and ye know that no murderer hath eternal life abiding in him.
verses.1John.3.16: Hereby know we love, because he laid down his life for us: and we ought to lay down our lives for the brethren.
verses.1John.3.17: But whoso hath the world’s goods, and beholdeth his brother in need, and shutteth up his compassion from him, how doth the love of God abide in him?
verses.1John.3.18: My little children, let us not love in word, neither with the tongue; but in deed and truth.
verses.1John.3.19: Hereby shall we know that we are of the truth, and shall assure our heart before him:
verses.1John.3.20: because if our heart condemn us, God is greater than our heart, and knoweth all things.
verses.1John.3.21: Beloved, if our heart condemn us not, we have boldness toward God;
verses.1John.3.22: and whatsoever we ask we receive of him, because we keep his commandments and do the things that are pleasing in his sight.
verses.1John.3.23: And this is his commandment, that we should believe in the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and love one another, even as he gave us commandment.
verses.1John.3.24: And he that keepeth his commandments abideth in him, and he in him. And hereby we know that he abideth in us, by the Spirit which he gave us.
verses.1John.4.1: Beloved, believe not every spirit, but prove the spirits, whether they are of God; because many false prophets are gone out into the world.
verses.1John.4.2: Hereby know ye the Spirit of God: every spirit that confesseth that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is of God:
verses.1John.4.3: and every spirit that confesseth not Jesus is not of God: and this is the spirit of the antichrist, whereof ye have heard that it cometh; and now it is in the world already.
verses.1John.4.4: Ye are of God, my little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you than he that is in the world.
verses.1John.4.5: They are of the world: therefore speak they as of the world, and the world heareth them.
verses.1John.4.6: We are of God: he that knoweth God heareth us; he who is not of God heareth us not. By this we know the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.
verses.1John.4.7: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is begotten of God, and knoweth God.
verses.1John.4.8: He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.
verses.1John.4.9: Herein was the love of God manifested in us, that God hath sent his only begotten Son into the world that we might live through him.
verses.1John.4.10: Herein is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son to be the propitiation for our sins.
verses.1John.4.11: Beloved, if God so loved us, we also ought to love one another.
verses.1John.4.12: No man hath beheld God at any time: if we love one another, God abideth in us, and his love is perfected in us:
verses.1John.4.13: hereby we know that we abide in him and he in us, because he hath given us of his Spirit.
verses.1John.4.14: And we have beheld and bear witness that the Father hath sent the Son to be the Saviour of the world.
verses.1John.4.15: Whosoever shall confess that Jesus is the Son of God, God abideth in him, and he in God.
verses.1John.4.16: And we know and have believed the love which God hath in us. God is love; and he that abideth in love abideth in God, and God abideth in him.
verses.1John.4.17: Herein is love made perfect with us, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment; because as he is, even so are we in this world.
verses.1John.4.18: There is no fear in love: but perfect love casteth out fear, because fear hath punishment; and he that feareth is not made perfect in love.
verses.1John.4.19: We love, because he first loved us.
verses.1John.4.20: If a man say, I love God, and hateth his brother, he is a liar: for he that loveth not his brother whom he hath seen, cannot love God whom he hath not seen.
verses.1John.4.21: And this commandment have we from him, that he who loveth God love his brother also.
verses.1John.5.1: Whosoever believeth that Jesus is the Christ is begotten of God: and whosoever loveth him that begat loveth him also that is begotten of him.
verses.1John.5.2: Hereby we know that we love the children of God, when we love God and do his commandments.
verses.1John.5.3: For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments: and his commandments are not grievous.
verses.1John.5.4: For whatsoever is begotten of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that hath overcome the world, even our faith.
verses.1John.5.5: And who is he that overcometh the world, but he that believeth that Jesus is the Son of God?
verses.1John.5.6: This is he that came by water and blood, even Jesus Christ; not with the water only, but with the water and with the blood.
verses.1John.5.7: And it is the Spirit that beareth witness, because the Spirit is the truth.
verses.1John.5.8: For there are three who bear witness, the Spirit, and the water, and the blood: and the three agree in one.
verses.1John.5.9: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater: for the witness of God is this, that he hath borne witness concerning his Son.
verses.1John.5.10: He that believeth on the Son of God hath the witness in him: he that believeth not God hath made him a liar; because he hath not believed in the witness that God hath borne concerning his Son.
verses.1John.5.11: And the witness is this, that God gave unto us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
verses.1John.5.12: He that hath the Son hath the life; he that hath not the Son of God hath not the life.
verses.1John.5.13: These things have I written unto you, that ye may know that ye have eternal life, even unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God.
verses.1John.5.14: And this is the boldness which we have toward him, that, if we ask anything according to his will, he heareth us:
verses.1John.5.15: and if we know that he heareth us whatsoever we ask, we know that we have the petitions which we have asked of him.
verses.1John.5.16: If any man see his brother sinning a sin not unto death, he shall ask, and God will give him life for them that sin not unto death. There is a sin unto death: not concerning this do I say that he should make request.
verses.1John.5.17: All unrighteousness is sin: and there is a sin not unto death.
verses.1John.5.18: We know that whosoever is begotten of God sinneth not; but he that was begotten of God keepeth himself, and the evil one toucheth him not.
verses.1John.5.19: We know that we are of God, and the whole world lieth in the evil one.
verses.1John.5.20: And we know that the Son of God is come, and hath given us an understanding, that we know him that is true, and we are in him that is true, even in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and eternal life.
verses.1John.5.21: My little children, guard yourselves from idols.
verses.2John.1.1: The elder unto the elect lady and her children, whom I love in truth; and not I only, but also all they that know the truth;
verses.2John.1.2: for the truth’s sake which abideth in us, and it shall be with us for ever:
verses.2John.1.3: Grace, mercy, peace shall be with us, from God the Father, and from Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
verses.2John.1.4: I rejoice greatly that I have found certain of thy children walking in truth, even as we received commandment from the Father.
verses.2John.1.5: And now I beseech thee, lady, not as though I wrote to thee a new commandment, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.
verses.2John.1.6: And this is love, that we should walk after his commandments. This is the commandment, even as ye heard from the beginning, that ye should walk in it.
verses.2John.1.7: For many deceivers are gone forth into the world, even they that confess not that Jesus Christ cometh in the flesh. This is the deceiver and the antichrist.
verses.2John.1.8: Look to yourselves, that ye lose not the things which we have wrought, but that ye receive a full reward.
verses.2John.1.9: Whosoever goeth onward and abideth not in the teaching of Christ, hath not God: he that abideth in the teaching, the same hath both the Father and the Son.
verses.2John.1.10: If any one cometh unto you, and bringeth not this teaching, receive him not into your house, and give him no greeting:
verses.2John.1.11: for he that giveth him greeting partaketh in his evil works.
verses.2John.1.12: Having many things to write unto you, I would not write them with paper and ink: but I hope to come unto you, and to speak face to face, that your joy may be made full.
verses.2John.1.13: The children of thine elect sister salute thee.
verses.3John.1.1: The elder unto Gaius the beloved, whom I love in truth.
verses.3John.1.2: Beloved, I pray that in all things thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth.
verses.3John.1.3: For I rejoiced greatly, when brethren came and bare witness unto thy truth, even as thou walkest in truth.
verses.3John.1.4: Greater joy have I none than this, to hear of my children walking in the truth.
verses.3John.1.5: Beloved, thou doest a faithful work in whatsoever thou doest toward them that are brethren and strangers withal;
verses.3John.1.6: who bare witness to thy love before the church: whom thou wilt do well to set forward on their journey worthily of God:
verses.3John.1.7: because that for the sake of the Name they went forth, taking nothing of the Gentiles.
verses.3John.1.8: We therefore ought to welcome such, that we may be fellow-workers for the truth.
verses.3John.1.9: I wrote somewhat unto the church: but Diotrephes, who loveth to have the preeminence among them, receiveth us not.
verses.3John.1.10: Therefore, if I come, I will bring to remembrance his works which he doeth, prating against us with wicked words: and not content therewith, neither doth he himself receive the brethren, and them that would he forbiddeth and casteth them out of the church.
verses.3John.1.11: Beloved, imitate not that which is evil, but that which is good. He that doeth good is of God: he that doeth evil hath not seen God.
verses.3John.1.12: Demetrius hath the witness of all men, and of the truth itself: yea, we also bear witness; and thou knowest that our witness is true.
verses.3John.1.13: I had many things to write unto thee, but I am unwilling to write them to thee with ink and pen:
verses.3John.1.14: but I hope shortly to see thee, and we shall speak face to face. Peace be unto thee. The friends salute thee. Salute the friends by name.
verses.Jude.1.1: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to them that are called, beloved in God the Father, and kept for Jesus Christ:
verses.Jude.1.2: Mercy unto you and peace and love be multiplied.
verses.Jude.1.3: Beloved, while I was giving all diligence to write unto you of our common salvation, I was constrained to write unto you exhorting you to contend earnestly for the faith which was once for all delivered unto the saints.
verses.Jude.1.4: For there are certain men crept in privily, even they who were of old written of beforehand unto this condemnation, ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into lasciviousness, and denying our only Master and Lord, Jesus Christ.
verses.Jude.1.5: Now I desire to put you in remembrance, though ye know all things once for all, that the Lord, having saved a people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed them that believed not.
verses.Jude.1.6: And angels that kept not their own principality, but left their proper habitation, he hath kept in everlasting bonds under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.
verses.Jude.1.7: Even as Sodom and Gomorrah, and the cities about them, having in like manner with these given themselves over to fornication and gone after strange flesh, are set forth as an example, suffering the punishment of eternal fire.
verses.Jude.1.8: Yet in like manner these also in their dreamings defile the flesh, and set at nought dominion, and rail at dignities.
verses.Jude.1.9: But Michael the archangel, when contending with the devil he disputed about the body of Moses, durst not bring against him a railing judgment, but said, The Lord rebuke thee.
verses.Jude.1.10: But these rail at whatsoever things they know not: and what they understand naturally, like the creatures without reason, in these things are they destroyed.
verses.Jude.1.11: Woe unto them! for they went in the way of Cain, and ran riotously in the error of Balaam for hire, and perished in the gainsaying of Korah.
verses.Jude.1.12: These are they who are hidden rocks in your love-feasts when they feast with you, shepherds that without fear feed themselves; clouds without water, carried along by winds; autumn trees without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots;
verses.Jude.1.13: wild waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, for whom the blackness of darkness hath been reserved for ever.
verses.Jude.1.14: And to these also Enoch, the seventh from Adam, prophesied, saying, Behold, the Lord came with ten thousands of his holy ones,
verses.Jude.1.15: to execute judgment upon all, and to convict all the ungodly of all their works of ungodliness which they have ungodly wrought, and of all the hard things which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.
verses.Jude.1.16: These are murmurers, complainers, walking after their lusts (and their mouth speaketh great swelling words), showing respect of persons for the sake of advantage.
verses.Jude.1.17: But ye, beloved, remember ye the words which have been spoken before by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ;
verses.Jude.1.18: that they said to you, In the last time there shall be mockers, walking after their own ungodly lusts.
verses.Jude.1.19: These are they who make separations, sensual, having not the Spirit.
verses.Jude.1.20: But ye, beloved, building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Spirit,
verses.Jude.1.21: keep yourselves in the love of God, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ unto eternal life.
verses.Jude.1.22: And on some have mercy, who are in doubt;
verses.Jude.1.23: and some save, snatching them out of the fire; and on some have mercy with fear; hating even the garment spotted by the flesh.
verses.Jude.1.24: Now unto him that is able to guard you from stumbling, and to set you before the presence of his glory without blemish in exceeding joy,
verses.Jude.1.25: to the only God our Saviour, through Jesus Christ our Lord, be glory, majesty, dominion and power, before all time, and now, and for evermore. Amen.
verses.Rev.1.1: The Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave him to show unto his servants, even the things which must shortly come to pass: and he sent and signified it by his angel unto his servant John;
verses.Rev.1.2: who bare witness of the word of God, and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, even of all things that he saw.
verses.Rev.1.3: Blessed is he that readeth, and they that hear the words of the prophecy, and keep the things that are written therein: for the time is at hand.
verses.Rev.1.4: John to the seven churches that are in Asia: Grace to you and peace, from him who is and who was and who is to come; and from the seven Spirits that are before his throne;
verses.Rev.1.5: and from Jesus Christ, who is the faithful witness, the firstborn of the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. Unto him that loveth us, and loosed us from our sins by his blood;
verses.Rev.1.6: and he made us to be a kingdom, to be priests unto his God and Father; to him be the glory and the dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.Rev.1.7: Behold, he cometh with the clouds; and every eye shall see him, and they that pierced him; and all the tribes of the earth shall mourn over him. Even so, Amen.
verses.Rev.1.8: I am the Alpha and the Omega, saith the Lord God, who is and who was and who is to come, the Almighty.
verses.Rev.1.9: I John, your brother and partaker with you in the tribulation and kingdom and patience which are in Jesus, was in the isle that is called Patmos, for the word of God and the testimony of Jesus.
verses.Rev.1.10: I was in the Spirit on the Lord’s day, and I heard behind me a great voice, as of a trumpet
verses.Rev.1.11: saying, What thou seest, write in a book and send it to the seven churches: unto Ephesus, and unto Smyrna, and unto Pergamum, and unto Thyatira, and unto Sardis, and unto Philadelphia, and unto Laodicea.
verses.Rev.1.12: And I turned to see the voice that spake with me. And having turned I saw seven golden candlesticks;
verses.Rev.1.13: and in the midst of the candlesticks one like unto a son of man, clothed with a garment down to the foot, and girt about at the breasts with a golden girdle.
verses.Rev.1.14: And his head and his hair were white as white wool, white as snow; and his eyes were as a flame of fire;
verses.Rev.1.15: and his feet like unto burnished brass, as if it had been refined in a furnace; and his voice as the voice of many waters.
verses.Rev.1.16: And he had in his right hand seven stars: and out of his mouth proceeded a sharp two-edged sword: and his countenance was as the sun shineth in his strength.
verses.Rev.1.17: And when I saw him, I fell at his feet as one dead. And he laid his right hand upon me, saying, Fear not; I am the first and the last,
verses.Rev.1.18: and the Living one; and I was dead, and behold, I am alive for evermore, and I have the keys of death and of Hades.
verses.Rev.1.19: Write therefore the things which thou sawest, and the things which are, and the things which shall come to pass hereafter;
verses.Rev.1.20: the mystery of the seven stars which thou sawest in my right hand, and the seven golden candlesticks. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches: and the seven candlesticks are seven churches.
verses.Rev.2.1: To the angel of the church in Ephesus write: These things saith he that holdeth the seven stars in his right hand, he that walketh in the midst of the seven golden candlesticks:
verses.Rev.2.2: I know thy works, and thy toil and patience, and that thou canst not bear evil men, and didst try them that call themselves apostles, and they are not, and didst find them false;
verses.Rev.2.3: and thou hast patience and didst bear for my name’s sake, and hast not grown weary.
verses.Rev.2.4: But I have this against thee, that thou didst leave thy first love.
verses.Rev.2.5: Remember therefore whence thou art fallen, and repent and do the first works; or else I come to thee, and will move thy candlestick out of its place, except thou repent.
verses.Rev.2.6: But this thou hast, that thou hatest the works of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.
verses.Rev.2.7: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith to the churches. To him that overcometh, to him will I give to eat of the tree of life, which is in the Paradise of God.
verses.Rev.2.8: And to the angel of the church in Smyrna write: These things saith the first and the last, who was dead, and lived again:
verses.Rev.2.9: I know thy tribulation, and thy poverty (but thou art rich), and the blasphemy of them that say they are Jews, and they are not, but are a synagogue of Satan.
verses.Rev.2.10: Fear not the things which thou art about to suffer: behold, the devil is about to cast some of you into prison, that ye may be tried; and ye shall have tribulation ten days. Be thou faithful unto death, and I will give thee the crown of life.
verses.Rev.2.11: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith to the churches. He that overcometh shall not be hurt of the second death.
verses.Rev.2.12: And to the angel of the church in Pergamum write: These things saith he that hath the sharp two-edged sword:
verses.Rev.2.13: I know where thou dwellest, even where Satan’s throne is; and thou holdest fast my name, and didst not deny my faith, even in the days of Antipas my witness, my faithful one, who was killed among you, where Satan dwelleth.
verses.Rev.2.14: But I have a few things against thee, because thou hast there some that hold the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to cast a stumblingblock before the children of Israel, to eat things sacrificed to idols, and to commit fornication.
verses.Rev.2.15: So hast thou also some that hold the teaching of the Nicolaitans in like manner.
verses.Rev.2.16: Repent therefore; or else I come to thee quickly, and I will make war against them with the sword of my mouth.
verses.Rev.2.17: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith to the churches. To him that overcometh, to him will I give of the hidden manna, and I will give him a white stone, and upon the stone a new name written, which no one knoweth but he that receiveth it.
verses.Rev.2.18: And to the angel of the church in Thyatira write: These things saith the Son of God, who hath his eyes like a flame of fire, and his feet are like unto burnished brass:
verses.Rev.2.19: I know thy works, and thy love and faith and ministry and patience, and that thy last works are more than the first.
verses.Rev.2.20: But I have this against thee, that thou sufferest the woman Jezebel, who calleth herself a prophetess; and she teacheth and seduceth my servants to commit fornication, and to eat things sacrificed to idols.
