verses.John.6.11: Jesus took the loaves, and having given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to those who were sitting down, likewise also of the fish as much as they desired.
verses.John.6.12: When they were filled, he said to his disciples, “Gather up the broken pieces which are left over, that nothing be lost.”
verses.John.6.13: So they gathered them up, and filled twelve baskets with broken pieces from the five barley loaves, which were left over by those who had eaten.
verses.John.6.14: When therefore the people saw the sign which Jesus did, they said, “This is truly the prophet who comes into the world.”
verses.John.6.15: Jesus therefore, perceiving that they were about to come and take him by force to make him king, withdrew again to the mountain by himself.
verses.John.6.16: When evening came, his disciples went down to the sea.
verses.John.6.17: They entered into the boat, and were going over the sea to Capernaum. It was now dark, and Jesus had not come to them.
verses.John.6.18: The sea was tossed by a great wind blowing.
verses.John.6.19: When therefore they had rowed about twenty-five or thirty stadia, they saw Jesus walking on the sea and drawing near to the boat; and they were afraid.
verses.John.6.20: But he said to them, “It is I. Don’t be afraid.”
verses.John.6.21: They were willing therefore to receive him into the boat. Immediately the boat was at the land where they were going.
verses.John.6.22: On the next day, the multitude that stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was no other boat there, except the one in which his disciples had embarked, and that Jesus hadn’t entered with his disciples into the boat, but his disciples had gone away alone.
verses.John.6.23: However, boats from Tiberias came near to the place where they ate the bread after the Lord had given thanks.
verses.John.6.24: When the multitude therefore saw that Jesus wasn’t there, nor his disciples, they themselves got into the boats and came to Capernaum, seeking Jesus.
verses.John.6.25: When they found him on the other side of the sea, they asked him, “Rabbi, when did you come here?”
verses.John.6.26: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, you seek me, not because you saw signs, but because you ate of the loaves and were filled.
verses.John.6.27: Don’t work for the food which perishes, but for the food which remains to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give to you. For God the Father has sealed him.”
verses.John.6.28: They said therefore to him, “What must we do, that we may work the works of God?”
verses.John.6.29: Jesus answered them, “This is the work of God, that you believe in him whom he has sent.”
verses.John.6.30: They said therefore to him, “What then do you do for a sign, that we may see and believe you? What work do you do?
verses.John.6.31: Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness. As it is written, ‘He gave them bread out of heaven to eat.’”
verses.John.6.32: Jesus therefore said to them, “Most certainly, I tell you, it wasn’t Moses who gave you the bread out of heaven, but my Father gives you the true bread out of heaven.
verses.John.6.33: For the bread of God is that which comes down out of heaven and gives life to the world.”
verses.John.6.34: They said therefore to him, “Lord, always give us this bread.”
verses.John.6.35: Jesus said to them, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will not be hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.
verses.John.6.36: But I told you that you have seen me, and yet you don’t believe.
verses.John.6.37: All those whom the Father gives me will come to me. He who comes to me I will in no way throw out.
verses.John.6.38: For I have come down from heaven, not to do my own will, but the will of him who sent me.
verses.John.6.39: This is the will of my Father who sent me, that of all he has given to me I should lose nothing, but should raise him up at the last day.
verses.John.6.40: This is the will of the one who sent me, that everyone who sees the Son and believes in him should have eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.”
verses.John.6.41: The Jews therefore murmured concerning him, because he said, “I am the bread which came down out of heaven.”
verses.John.6.42: They said, “Isn’t this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How then does he say, ‘I have come down out of heaven’?”
verses.John.6.43: Therefore Jesus answered them, “Don’t murmur among yourselves.
verses.John.6.44: No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him; and I will raise him up in the last day.
verses.John.6.45: It is written in the prophets, ‘They will all be taught by God.’ Therefore everyone who hears from the Father and has learned, comes to me.
verses.John.6.46: Not that anyone has seen the Father, except he who is from God. He has seen the Father.
verses.John.6.47: Most certainly, I tell you, he who believes in me has eternal life.
verses.John.6.48: I am the bread of life.
verses.John.6.49: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness and they died.
verses.John.6.50: This is the bread which comes down out of heaven, that anyone may eat of it and not die.
verses.John.6.51: I am the living bread which came down out of heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. Yes, the bread which I will give for the life of the world is my flesh.”
verses.John.6.52: The Jews therefore contended with one another, saying, “How can this man give us his flesh to eat?”
verses.John.6.53: Jesus therefore said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you don’t have life in yourselves.
verses.John.6.54: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.
verses.John.6.55: For my flesh is food indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.
verses.John.6.56: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood lives in me, and I in him.
verses.John.6.57: As the living Father sent me, and I live because of the Father, so he who feeds on me will also live because of me.
verses.John.6.58: This is the bread which came down out of heaven—not as our fathers ate the manna and died. He who eats this bread will live forever.”
verses.John.6.59: He said these things in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.
verses.John.6.60: Therefore many of his disciples, when they heard this, said, “This is a hard saying! Who can listen to it?”
verses.John.6.61: But Jesus knowing in himself that his disciples murmured at this, said to them, “Does this cause you to stumble?
verses.John.6.62: Then what if you would see the Son of Man ascending to where he was before?
verses.John.6.63: It is the spirit who gives life. The flesh profits nothing. The words that I speak to you are spirit, and are life.
verses.John.6.64: But there are some of you who don’t believe.” For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were who didn’t believe, and who it was who would betray him.
verses.John.6.65: He said, “For this cause I have said to you that no one can come to me, unless it is given to him by my Father.”
verses.John.6.66: At this, many of his disciples went back and walked no more with him.
verses.John.6.67: Jesus said therefore to the twelve, “You don’t also want to go away, do you?”
verses.John.6.68: Simon Peter answered him, “Lord, to whom would we go? You have the words of eternal life.
verses.John.6.69: We have come to believe and know that you are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”
verses.John.6.70: Jesus answered them, “Didn’t I choose you, the twelve, and one of you is a devil?”
verses.John.6.71: Now he spoke of Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, for it was he who would betray him, being one of the twelve.
verses.John.4.1: Therefore when the Lord knew that the Pharisees had heard that Jesus was making and baptizing more disciples than John
verses.John.4.2: (although Jesus himself didn’t baptize, but his disciples),
verses.John.4.3: he left Judea and departed into Galilee.
verses.John.4.4: He needed to pass through Samaria.
verses.John.4.5: So he came to a city of Samaria called Sychar, near the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.
verses.John.4.6: Jacob’s well was there. Jesus therefore, being tired from his journey, sat down by the well. It was about the sixth hour.
verses.John.4.7: A woman of Samaria came to draw water. Jesus said to her, “Give me a drink.”
verses.John.4.8: For his disciples had gone away into the city to buy food.
verses.John.4.9: The Samaritan woman therefore said to him, “How is it that you, being a Jew, ask for a drink from me, a Samaritan woman?” (For Jews have no dealings with Samaritans.)
verses.John.4.10: Jesus answered her, “If you knew the gift of God, and who it is who says to you, ‘Give me a drink,’ you would have asked him, and he would have given you living water.”
verses.John.4.11: The woman said to him, “Sir, you have nothing to draw with, and the well is deep. So where do you get that living water?
verses.John.4.12: Are you greater than our father Jacob, who gave us the well and drank from it himself, as did his children and his livestock?”
verses.John.4.13: Jesus answered her, “Everyone who drinks of this water will thirst again,
verses.John.4.14: but whoever drinks of the water that I will give him will never thirst again; but the water that I will give him will become in him a well of water springing up to eternal life.”
verses.John.4.15: The woman said to him, “Sir, give me this water, so that I don’t get thirsty, neither come all the way here to draw.”
verses.John.4.16: Jesus said to her, “Go, call your husband, and come here.”
verses.John.4.17: The woman answered, “I have no husband.” Jesus said to her, “You said well, ‘I have no husband,’
verses.John.4.18: for you have had five husbands; and he whom you now have is not your husband. This you have said truly.”
verses.John.4.19: The woman said to him, “Sir, I perceive that you are a prophet.
verses.John.4.20: Our fathers worshiped in this mountain, and you Jews say that in Jerusalem is the place where people ought to worship.”
verses.John.4.21: Jesus said to her, “Woman, believe me, the hour is coming when neither in this mountain nor in Jerusalem will you worship the Father.
verses.John.4.22: You worship that which you don’t know. We worship that which we know; for salvation is from the Jews.
verses.John.4.23: But the hour comes, and now is, when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, for the Father seeks such to be his worshipers.
verses.John.4.24: God is spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth.”
verses.John.4.25: The woman said to him, “I know that Messiah is coming, he who is called Christ. When he has come, he will declare to us all things.”
verses.John.4.26: Jesus said to her, “I am he, the one who speaks to you.”
verses.John.4.27: Just then, his disciples came. They marveled that he was speaking with a woman; yet no one said, “What are you looking for?” or, “Why do you speak with her?”
verses.John.4.28: So the woman left her water pot, went away into the city, and said to the people,
verses.John.4.29: “Come, see a man who told me everything that I have done. Can this be the Christ?”
verses.John.4.30: They went out of the city, and were coming to him.
verses.John.4.31: In the meanwhile, the disciples urged him, saying, “Rabbi, eat.”
verses.John.4.32: But he said to them, “I have food to eat that you don’t know about.”
verses.John.4.33: The disciples therefore said to one another, “Has anyone brought him something to eat?”
verses.John.4.34: Jesus said to them, “My food is to do the will of him who sent me and to accomplish his work.
verses.John.4.35: Don’t you say, ‘There are yet four months until the harvest’? Behold, I tell you, lift up your eyes and look at the fields, that they are white for harvest already.
verses.John.4.36: He who reaps receives wages and gathers fruit to eternal life, that both he who sows and he who reaps may rejoice together.
verses.John.4.37: For in this the saying is true, ‘One sows, and another reaps.’
verses.John.4.38: I sent you to reap that for which you haven’t labored. Others have labored, and you have entered into their labor.”
verses.John.4.39: From that city many of the Samaritans believed in him because of the word of the woman, who testified, “He told me everything that I have done.”
verses.John.4.40: So when the Samaritans came to him, they begged him to stay with them. He stayed there two days.
verses.John.4.41: Many more believed because of his word.
verses.John.4.42: They said to the woman, “Now we believe, not because of your speaking; for we have heard for ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Savior of the world.”
verses.John.4.43: After the two days he went out from there and went into Galilee.
verses.John.4.44: For Jesus himself testified that a prophet has no honor in his own country.
verses.John.4.45: So when he came into Galilee, the Galileans received him, having seen all the things that he did in Jerusalem at the feast, for they also went to the feast.
verses.John.4.46: Jesus came therefore again to Cana of Galilee, where he made the water into wine. There was a certain nobleman whose son was sick at Capernaum.
verses.John.4.47: When he heard that Jesus had come out of Judea into Galilee, he went to him and begged him that he would come down and heal his son, for he was at the point of death.
verses.John.4.48: Jesus therefore said to him, “Unless you people see signs and wonders, you will in no way believe.”
verses.John.4.49: The nobleman said to him, “Sir, come down before my child dies.”
verses.John.4.50: Jesus said to him, “Go your way. Your son lives.” The man believed the word that Jesus spoke to him, and he went his way.
verses.John.4.51: As he was going down, his servants met him and reported, saying “Your child lives!”
verses.John.4.52: So he inquired of them the hour when he began to get better. They said therefore to him, “Yesterday at the seventh hour, the fever left him.”
verses.John.4.53: So the father knew that it was at that hour in which Jesus said to him, “Your son lives.” He believed, as did his whole house.
verses.John.4.54: This is again the second sign that Jesus did, having come out of Judea into Galilee.
verses.John.12.1: Then, six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, where Lazarus was, who had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.
verses.John.12.2: So they made him a supper there. Martha served, but Lazarus was one of those who sat at the table with him.
verses.John.12.3: Therefore Mary took a pound of ointment of pure nard, very precious, and anointed Jesus’ feet and wiped his feet with her hair. The house was filled with the fragrance of the ointment.
verses.John.12.4: Then Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, one of his disciples, who would betray him, said,
verses.John.12.5: “Why wasn’t this ointment sold for three hundred denarii and given to the poor?”
verses.John.12.6: Now he said this, not because he cared for the poor, but because he was a thief, and having the money box, used to steal what was put into it.
verses.John.12.7: But Jesus said, “Leave her alone. She has kept this for the day of my burial.
verses.John.12.8: For you always have the poor with you, but you don’t always have me.”
verses.John.12.9: A large crowd therefore of the Jews learned that he was there; and they came, not for Jesus’ sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.
verses.John.12.10: But the chief priests conspired to put Lazarus to death also,
verses.John.12.11: because on account of him many of the Jews went away and believed in Jesus.
verses.John.12.12: On the next day a great multitude had come to the feast. When they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,
verses.John.12.13: they took the branches of the palm trees and went out to meet him, and cried out, “Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord, the King of Israel!”
verses.John.12.14: Jesus, having found a young donkey, sat on it. As it is written,
verses.John.12.15: “Don’t be afraid, daughter of Zion. Behold, your King comes, sitting on a donkey’s colt.”
verses.John.12.16: His disciples didn’t understand these things at first, but when Jesus was glorified, then they remembered that these things were written about him, and that they had done these things to him.
verses.John.12.17: The multitude therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of the tomb and raised him from the dead was testifying about it.
verses.John.12.18: For this cause also the multitude went and met him, because they heard that he had done this sign.
verses.John.12.19: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, “See how you accomplish nothing. Behold, the world has gone after him.”
verses.John.12.20: Now there were certain Greeks among those who went up to worship at the feast.
verses.John.12.21: Therefore, these came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida of Galilee, and asked him, saying, “Sir, we want to see Jesus.”
verses.John.12.22: Philip came and told Andrew, and in turn, Andrew came with Philip, and they told Jesus.
verses.John.12.23: Jesus answered them, “The time has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.
verses.John.12.24: Most certainly I tell you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains by itself alone. But if it dies, it bears much fruit.
verses.John.12.25: He who loves his life will lose it. He who hates his life in this world will keep it to eternal life.
verses.John.12.26: If anyone serves me, let him follow me. Where I am, there my servant will also be. If anyone serves me, the Father will honor him.
verses.John.12.27: “Now my soul is troubled. What shall I say? ‘Father, save me from this time’? But I came to this time for this cause.
verses.John.12.28: Father, glorify your name!” Then a voice came out of the sky, saying, “I have both glorified it and will glorify it again.”
verses.John.12.29: Therefore the multitude who stood by and heard it said that it had thundered. Others said, “An angel has spoken to him.”
verses.John.12.30: Jesus answered, “This voice hasn’t come for my sake, but for your sakes.
verses.John.12.31: Now is the judgment of this world. Now the prince of this world will be cast out.
verses.John.12.32: And I, if I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself.”
verses.John.12.33: But he said this, signifying by what kind of death he should die.
verses.John.12.34: The multitude answered him, “We have heard out of the law that the Christ remains forever. How do you say, ‘The Son of Man must be lifted up’? Who is this Son of Man?”
verses.John.12.35: Jesus therefore said to them, “Yet a little while the light is with you. Walk while you have the light, that darkness doesn’t overtake you. He who walks in the darkness doesn’t know where he is going.
verses.John.12.36: While you have the light, believe in the light, that you may become children of light.” Jesus said these things, and he departed and hid himself from them.
verses.John.12.37: But though he had done so many signs before them, yet they didn’t believe in him,
verses.John.12.38:
that the word of Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spoke:
“Lord, who has believed our report?
To whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?”
verses.John.12.39: For this cause they couldn’t believe, for Isaiah said again:
verses.John.12.40:
“He has blinded their eyes and he hardened their heart,
lest they should see with their eyes,
and perceive with their heart,
and would turn,
and I would heal them.”
verses.John.12.41: Isaiah said these things when he saw his glory, and spoke of him.
verses.John.12.42: Nevertheless, even many of the rulers believed in him, but because of the Pharisees they didn’t confess it, so that they wouldn’t be put out of the synagogue,
verses.John.12.43: for they loved men’s praise more than God’s praise.
verses.John.12.44: Jesus cried out and said, “Whoever believes in me, believes not in me, but in him who sent me.
verses.John.12.45: He who sees me sees him who sent me.
verses.John.12.46: I have come as a light into the world, that whoever believes in me may not remain in the darkness.
verses.John.12.47: If anyone listens to my sayings and doesn’t believe, I don’t judge him. For I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.
verses.John.12.48: He who rejects me, and doesn’t receive my sayings, has one who judges him. The word that I spoke will judge him in the last day.
verses.John.12.49: For I spoke not from myself, but the Father who sent me gave me a commandment, what I should say and what I should speak.
verses.John.12.50: I know that his commandment is eternal life. The things therefore which I speak, even as the Father has said to me, so I speak.”
verses.John.3.1: Now there was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews.
verses.John.3.2: He came to Jesus by night and said to him, “Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher come from God, for no one can do these signs that you do, unless God is with him.”
verses.John.3.3: Jesus answered him, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born anew, he can’t see God’s Kingdom.”
verses.John.3.4: Nicodemus said to him, “How can a man be born when he is old? Can he enter a second time into his mother’s womb and be born?”
verses.John.3.5: Jesus answered, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born of water and Spirit, he can’t enter into God’s Kingdom.
verses.John.3.6: That which is born of the flesh is flesh. That which is born of the Spirit is spirit.
verses.John.3.7: Don’t marvel that I said to you, ‘You must all be born anew.’
verses.John.3.8: The wind blows where it wants to, and you hear its sound, but don’t know where it comes from and where it is going. So is everyone who is born of the Spirit.”
verses.John.3.9: Nicodemus answered him, “How can these things be?”
verses.John.3.10: Jesus answered him, “Are you the teacher of Israel, and don’t understand these things?
verses.John.3.11: Most certainly I tell you, we speak that which we know and testify of that which we have seen, and you don’t receive our witness.
verses.John.3.12: If I told you earthly things and you don’t believe, how will you believe if I tell you heavenly things?
verses.John.3.13: No one has ascended into heaven but he who descended out of heaven, the Son of Man, who is in heaven.
verses.John.3.14: As Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of Man be lifted up,
verses.John.3.15: that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
verses.John.3.16: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only born Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
verses.John.3.17: For God didn’t send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world should be saved through him.
verses.John.3.18: He who believes in him is not judged. He who doesn’t believe has been judged already, because he has not believed in the name of the only born Son of God.
verses.John.3.19: This is the judgment, that the light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light, for their works were evil.
verses.John.3.20: For everyone who does evil hates the light and doesn’t come to the light, lest his works would be exposed.
verses.John.3.21: But he who does the truth comes to the light, that his works may be revealed, that they have been done in God.”
verses.John.3.22: After these things, Jesus came with his disciples into the land of Judea. He stayed there with them and baptized.
verses.John.3.23: John also was baptizing in Enon near Salim, because there was much water there. They came and were baptized;
verses.John.3.24: for John was not yet thrown into prison.
verses.John.3.25: Therefore a dispute arose on the part of John’s disciples with some Jews about purification.
verses.John.3.26: They came to John and said to him, “Rabbi, he who was with you beyond the Jordan, to whom you have testified, behold, he baptizes, and everyone is coming to him.”
verses.John.3.27: John answered, “A man can receive nothing unless it has been given him from heaven.
verses.John.3.28: You yourselves testify that I said, ‘I am not the Christ,’ but, ‘I have been sent before him.’
verses.John.3.29: He who has the bride is the bridegroom; but the friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him, rejoices greatly because of the bridegroom’s voice. Therefore my joy is made full.
verses.John.3.30: He must increase, but I must decrease.
verses.John.3.31: “He who comes from above is above all. He who is from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks of the earth. He who comes from heaven is above all.
verses.John.3.32: What he has seen and heard, of that he testifies; and no one receives his witness.
verses.John.3.33: He who has received his witness has set his seal to this, that God is true.
verses.John.3.34: For he whom God has sent speaks the words of God; for God gives the Spirit without measure.
verses.John.3.35: The Father loves the Son, and has given all things into his hand.
verses.John.3.36: One who believes in the Son has eternal life, but one who disobeys the Son won’t see life, but the wrath of God remains on him.”
verses.John.7.1: After these things, Jesus was walking in Galilee, for he wouldn’t walk in Judea, because the Jews sought to kill him.
verses.John.7.2: Now the feast of the Jews, the Feast of Booths, was at hand.
verses.John.7.3: His brothers therefore said to him, “Depart from here and go into Judea, that your disciples also may see your works which you do.
verses.John.7.4: For no one does anything in secret while he seeks to be known openly. If you do these things, reveal yourself to the world.”
verses.John.7.5: For even his brothers didn’t believe in him.
verses.John.7.6: Jesus therefore said to them, “My time has not yet come, but your time is always ready.
verses.John.7.7: The world can’t hate you, but it hates me, because I testify about it, that its works are evil.
verses.John.7.8: You go up to the feast. I am not yet going up to this feast, because my time is not yet fulfilled.”
verses.John.7.9: Having said these things to them, he stayed in Galilee.
verses.John.7.10: But when his brothers had gone up to the feast, then he also went up, not publicly, but as it were in secret.
verses.John.7.11: The Jews therefore sought him at the feast, and said, “Where is he?”
verses.John.7.12: There was much murmuring among the multitudes concerning him. Some said, “He is a good man.” Others said, “Not so, but he leads the multitude astray.”
verses.John.7.13: Yet no one spoke openly of him for fear of the Jews.
verses.John.7.14: But when it was now the middle of the feast, Jesus went up into the temple and taught.
verses.John.7.15: The Jews therefore marveled, saying, “How does this man know letters, having never been educated?”
verses.John.7.16: Jesus therefore answered them, “My teaching is not mine, but his who sent me.
verses.John.7.17: If anyone desires to do his will, he will know about the teaching, whether it is from God or if I am speaking from myself.
verses.John.7.18: He who speaks from himself seeks his own glory, but he who seeks the glory of him who sent him is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.
verses.John.7.19: Didn’t Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keeps the law? Why do you seek to kill me?”
verses.John.7.20: The multitude answered, “You have a demon! Who seeks to kill you?”
verses.John.7.21: Jesus answered them, “I did one work and you all marvel because of it.
verses.John.7.22: Moses has given you circumcision (not that it is of Moses, but of the fathers), and on the Sabbath you circumcise a boy.
verses.John.7.23: If a boy receives circumcision on the Sabbath, that the law of Moses may not be broken, are you angry with me because I made a man completely healthy on the Sabbath?
verses.John.7.24: Don’t judge according to appearance, but judge righteous judgment.”
verses.John.7.25: Therefore some of them of Jerusalem said, “Isn’t this he whom they seek to kill?
verses.John.7.26: Behold, he speaks openly, and they say nothing to him. Can it be that the rulers indeed know that this is truly the Christ?
verses.John.7.27: However, we know where this man comes from, but when the Christ comes, no one will know where he comes from.”
verses.John.7.28: Jesus therefore cried out in the temple, teaching and saying, “You both know me, and know where I am from. I have not come of myself, but he who sent me is true, whom you don’t know.
verses.John.7.29: I know him, because I am from him, and he sent me.”
verses.John.7.30: They sought therefore to take him; but no one laid a hand on him, because his hour had not yet come.
verses.John.7.31: But of the multitude, many believed in him. They said, “When the Christ comes, he won’t do more signs than those which this man has done, will he?”
verses.John.7.32: The Pharisees heard the multitude murmuring these things concerning him, and the chief priests and the Pharisees sent officers to arrest him.
verses.John.7.33: Then Jesus said, “I will be with you a little while longer, then I go to him who sent me.
verses.John.7.34: You will seek me and won’t find me. You can’t come where I am.”
verses.John.7.35: The Jews therefore said among themselves, “Where will this man go that we won’t find him? Will he go to the Dispersion among the Greeks and teach the Greeks?
verses.John.7.36: What is this word that he said, ‘You will seek me, and won’t find me;’ and ‘Where I am, you can’t come’?”
verses.John.7.37: Now on the last and greatest day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried out, “If anyone is thirsty, let him come to me and drink!
verses.John.7.38: He who believes in me, as the Scripture has said, from within him will flow rivers of living water.”
verses.John.7.39: But he said this about the Spirit, which those believing in him were to receive. For the Holy Spirit was not yet given, because Jesus wasn’t yet glorified.
verses.John.7.40: Many of the multitude therefore, when they heard these words, said, “This is truly the prophet.”
verses.John.7.41: Others said, “This is the Christ.” But some said, “What, does the Christ come out of Galilee?
verses.John.7.42: Hasn’t the Scripture said that the Christ comes of the offspring of David, and from Bethlehem, the village where David was?”
verses.John.7.43: So a division arose in the multitude because of him.
verses.John.7.44: Some of them would have arrested him, but no one laid hands on him.
verses.John.7.45: The officers therefore came to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said to them, “Why didn’t you bring him?”
verses.John.7.46: The officers answered, “No man ever spoke like this man!”
verses.John.7.47: The Pharisees therefore answered them, “You aren’t also led astray, are you?
verses.John.7.48: Have any of the rulers or any of the Pharisees believed in him?
verses.John.7.49: But this multitude that doesn’t know the law is cursed.”
verses.John.7.50: Nicodemus (he who came to him by night, being one of them) said to them,
verses.John.7.51: “Does our law judge a man unless it first hears from him personally and knows what he does?”
verses.John.7.52: They answered him, “Are you also from Galilee? Search and see that no prophet has arisen out of Galilee.”
verses.John.7.53: Everyone went to his own house,
verses.John.15.1: “I am the true vine, and my Father is the farmer.
verses.John.15.2: Every branch in me that doesn’t bear fruit, he takes away. Every branch that bears fruit, he prunes, that it may bear more fruit.
verses.John.15.3: You are already pruned clean because of the word which I have spoken to you.
verses.John.15.4: Remain in me, and I in you. As the branch can’t bear fruit by itself unless it remains in the vine, so neither can you, unless you remain in me.
verses.John.15.5: I am the vine. You are the branches. He who remains in me and I in him bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.
verses.John.15.6: If a man doesn’t remain in me, he is thrown out as a branch and is withered; and they gather them, throw them into the fire, and they are burned.
verses.John.15.7: If you remain in me, and my words remain in you, you will ask whatever you desire, and it will be done for you.
verses.John.15.8: “In this my Father is glorified, that you bear much fruit; and so you will be my disciples.
verses.John.15.9: Even as the Father has loved me, I also have loved you. Remain in my love.
verses.John.15.10: If you keep my commandments, you will remain in my love, even as I have kept my Father’s commandments and remain in his love.
verses.John.15.11: I have spoken these things to you, that my joy may remain in you, and that your joy may be made full.
verses.John.15.12: “This is my commandment, that you love one another, even as I have loved you.
verses.John.15.13: Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.
verses.John.15.14: You are my friends if you do whatever I command you.
verses.John.15.15: No longer do I call you servants, for the servant doesn’t know what his lord does. But I have called you friends, for everything that I heard from my Father, I have made known to you.
verses.John.15.16: You didn’t choose me, but I chose you and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should remain; that whatever you will ask of the Father in my name, he may give it to you.
verses.John.15.17: “I command these things to you, that you may love one another.
verses.John.15.18: If the world hates you, you know that it has hated me before it hated you.
verses.John.15.19: If you were of the world, the world would love its own. But because you are not of the world, since I chose you out of the world, therefore the world hates you.
verses.John.15.20: Remember the word that I said to you: ‘A servant is not greater than his lord.’ If they persecuted me, they will also persecute you. If they kept my word, they will also keep yours.
verses.John.15.21: But they will do all these things to you for my name’s sake, because they don’t know him who sent me.
verses.John.15.22: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have had sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.
verses.John.15.23: He who hates me, hates my Father also.
verses.John.15.24: If I hadn’t done among them the works which no one else did, they wouldn’t have had sin. But now they have seen and also hated both me and my Father.
verses.John.15.25: But this happened so that the word may be fulfilled which was written in their law, ‘They hated me without a cause.’
verses.John.15.26: “When the Counselor has come, whom I will send to you from the Father, the Spirit of truth, who proceeds from the Father, he will testify about me.
verses.John.15.27: You will also testify, because you have been with me from the beginning.
verses.John.21.1: After these things, Jesus revealed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias. He revealed himself this way.
verses.John.21.2: Simon Peter, Thomas called Didymus, Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two others of his disciples were together.
verses.John.21.3: Simon Peter said to them, “I’m going fishing.” They told him, “We are also coming with you.” They immediately went out and entered into the boat. That night, they caught nothing.
verses.John.21.4: But when day had already come, Jesus stood on the beach; yet the disciples didn’t know that it was Jesus.
verses.John.21.5: Jesus therefore said to them, “Children, have you anything to eat?” They answered him, “No.”
verses.John.21.6: He said to them, “Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some.” They cast it therefore, and now they weren’t able to draw it in for the multitude of fish.
verses.John.21.7: That disciple therefore whom Jesus loved said to Peter, “It’s the Lord!” So when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he wrapped his coat around himself (for he was naked), and threw himself into the sea.
verses.John.21.8: But the other disciples came in the little boat (for they were not far from the land, but about two hundred cubits away), dragging the net full of fish.
verses.John.21.9: So when they got out on the land, they saw a fire of coals there, with fish and bread laid on it.
verses.John.21.10: Jesus said to them, “Bring some of the fish which you have just caught.”
verses.John.21.11: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land, full of one hundred fifty-three great fish. Even though there were so many, the net wasn’t torn.
verses.John.21.12: Jesus said to them, “Come and eat breakfast!” None of the disciples dared inquire of him, “Who are you?” knowing that it was the Lord.
verses.John.21.13: Then Jesus came and took the bread, gave it to them, and the fish likewise.
verses.John.21.14: This is now the third time that Jesus was revealed to his disciples after he had risen from the dead.
verses.John.21.15: So when they had eaten their breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me more than these?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Feed my lambs.”
verses.John.21.16: He said to him again a second time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Tend my sheep.”
verses.John.21.17: He said to him the third time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you have affection for me?” Peter was grieved because he asked him the third time, “Do you have affection for me?” He said to him, “Lord, you know everything. You know that I have affection for you.” Jesus said to him, “Feed my sheep.
verses.John.21.18: Most certainly I tell you, when you were young, you dressed yourself and walked where you wanted to. But when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and another will dress you and carry you where you don’t want to go.”
verses.John.21.19: Now he said this, signifying by what kind of death he would glorify God. When he had said this, he said to him, “Follow me.”
verses.John.21.20: Then Peter, turning around, saw a disciple following. This was the disciple whom Jesus loved, the one who had also leaned on Jesus’ chest at the supper and asked, “Lord, who is going to betray you?”
verses.John.21.21: Peter, seeing him, said to Jesus, “Lord, what about this man?”
verses.John.21.22: Jesus said to him, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you? You follow me.”
verses.John.21.23: This saying therefore went out among the brothers that this disciple wouldn’t die. Yet Jesus didn’t say to him that he wouldn’t die, but, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you?”
verses.John.21.24: This is the disciple who testifies about these things, and wrote these things. We know that his witness is true.
verses.John.21.25: There are also many other things which Jesus did, which if they would all be written, I suppose that even the world itself wouldn’t have room for the books that would be written.
verses.John.17.1: Jesus said these things, then lifting up his eyes to heaven, he said, “Father, the time has come. Glorify your Son, that your Son may also glorify you;
verses.John.17.2: even as you gave him authority over all flesh, so he will give eternal life to all whom you have given him.
verses.John.17.3: This is eternal life, that they should know you, the only true God, and him whom you sent, Jesus Christ.
verses.John.17.4: I glorified you on the earth. I have accomplished the work which you have given me to do.
verses.John.17.5: Now, Father, glorify me with your own self with the glory which I had with you before the world existed.
verses.John.17.6: “I revealed your name to the people whom you have given me out of the world. They were yours, and you have given them to me. They have kept your word.
verses.John.17.7: Now they have known that all things whatever you have given me are from you,
verses.John.17.8: for the words which you have given me I have given to them; and they received them, and knew for sure that I came from you. They have believed that you sent me.
verses.John.17.9: I pray for them. I don’t pray for the world, but for those whom you have given me, for they are yours.
verses.John.17.10: All things that are mine are yours, and yours are mine, and I am glorified in them.
verses.John.17.11: I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I am coming to you. Holy Father, keep them through your name which you have given me, that they may be one, even as we are.
verses.John.17.12: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in your name. I have kept those whom you have given me. None of them is lost except the son of destruction, that the Scripture might be fulfilled.
verses.John.17.13: But now I come to you, and I say these things in the world, that they may have my joy made full in themselves.
verses.John.17.14: I have given them your word. The world hated them because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
verses.John.17.15: I pray not that you would take them from the world, but that you would keep them from the evil one.
verses.John.17.16: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
verses.John.17.17: Sanctify them in your truth. Your word is truth.
verses.John.17.18: As you sent me into the world, even so I have sent them into the world.
verses.John.17.19: For their sakes I sanctify myself, that they themselves also may be sanctified in truth.
verses.John.17.20: “Not for these only do I pray, but for those also who will believe in me through their word,
verses.John.17.21: that they may all be one; even as you, Father, are in me, and I in you, that they also may be one in us; that the world may believe that you sent me.
verses.John.17.22: The glory which you have given me, I have given to them, that they may be one, even as we are one,
verses.John.17.23: I in them, and you in me, that they may be perfected into one, that the world may know that you sent me and loved them, even as you loved me.
verses.John.17.24: Father, I desire that they also whom you have given me be with me where I am, that they may see my glory which you have given me, for you loved me before the foundation of the world.
verses.John.17.25: Righteous Father, the world hasn’t known you, but I knew you; and these knew that you sent me.
verses.John.17.26: I made known to them your name, and will make it known; that the love with which you loved me may be in them, and I in them.”
verses.John.19.1: So Pilate then took Jesus and flogged him.
verses.John.19.2: The soldiers twisted thorns into a crown and put it on his head, and dressed him in a purple garment.
verses.John.19.3: They kept saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!” and they kept slapping him.
verses.John.19.4: Then Pilate went out again, and said to them, “Behold, I bring him out to you, that you may know that I find no basis for a charge against him.”
verses.John.19.5: Jesus therefore came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple garment. Pilate said to them, “Behold, the man!”
verses.John.19.6: When therefore the chief priests and the officers saw him, they shouted, saying, “Crucify! Crucify!” Pilate said to them, “Take him yourselves and crucify him, for I find no basis for a charge against him.”
verses.John.19.7: The Jews answered him, “We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.”
verses.John.19.8: When therefore Pilate heard this saying, he was more afraid.
verses.John.19.9: He entered into the Praetorium again, and said to Jesus, “Where are you from?” But Jesus gave him no answer.
verses.John.19.10: Pilate therefore said to him, “Aren’t you speaking to me? Don’t you know that I have power to release you and have power to crucify you?”
verses.John.19.11: Jesus answered, “You would have no power at all against me, unless it were given to you from above. Therefore he who delivered me to you has greater sin.”
verses.John.19.12: At this, Pilate was seeking to release him, but the Jews cried out, saying, “If you release this man, you aren’t Caesar’s friend! Everyone who makes himself a king speaks against Caesar!”
verses.John.19.13: When Pilate therefore heard these words, he brought Jesus out and sat down on the judgment seat at a place called “The Pavement”, but in Hebrew, “Gabbatha.”
verses.John.19.14: Now it was the Preparation Day of the Passover, at about the sixth hour. He said to the Jews, “Behold, your King!”
verses.John.19.15: They cried out, “Away with him! Away with him! Crucify him!” Pilate said to them, “Shall I crucify your King?” The chief priests answered, “We have no king but Caesar!”
verses.John.19.16: So then he delivered him to them to be crucified. So they took Jesus and led him away.
verses.John.19.17: He went out, bearing his cross, to the place called “The Place of a Skull”, which is called in Hebrew, “Golgotha”,
verses.John.19.18: where they crucified him, and with him two others, on either side one, and Jesus in the middle.
verses.John.19.19: Pilate wrote a title also, and put it on the cross. There was written, “JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.”
verses.John.19.20: Therefore many of the Jews read this title, for the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city; and it was written in Hebrew, in Latin, and in Greek.
verses.John.19.21: The chief priests of the Jews therefore said to Pilate, “Don’t write, ‘The King of the Jews,’ but, ‘he said, “I am King of the Jews.”’”
verses.John.19.22: Pilate answered, “What I have written, I have written.”
verses.John.19.23: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also the tunic. Now the tunic was without seam, woven from the top throughout.
verses.John.19.24:
Then they said to one another, “Let’s not tear it, but cast lots for it to decide whose it will be,” that the Scripture might be fulfilled, which says,
“They parted my garments among them.
They cast lots for my clothing.” Therefore the soldiers did these things.
verses.John.19.25: But standing by Jesus’ cross were his mother, his mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.
verses.John.19.26: Therefore when Jesus saw his mother, and the disciple whom he loved standing there, he said to his mother, “Woman, behold, your son!”
verses.John.19.27: Then he said to the disciple, “Behold, your mother!” From that hour, the disciple took her to his own home.
verses.John.19.28: After this, Jesus, seeing that all things were now finished, that the Scripture might be fulfilled, said, “I am thirsty!”
verses.John.19.29: Now a vessel full of vinegar was set there; so they put a sponge full of the vinegar on hyssop, and held it at his mouth.
verses.John.19.30: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, “It is finished!” Then he bowed his head and gave up his spirit.
verses.John.19.31: Therefore the Jews, because it was the Preparation Day, so that the bodies wouldn’t remain on the cross on the Sabbath (for that Sabbath was a special one), asked of Pilate that their legs might be broken and that they might be taken away.
verses.John.19.32: Therefore the soldiers came and broke the legs of the first and of the other who was crucified with him;
verses.John.19.33: but when they came to Jesus and saw that he was already dead, they didn’t break his legs.
verses.John.19.34: However, one of the soldiers pierced his side with a spear, and immediately blood and water came out.
verses.John.19.35: He who has seen has testified, and his testimony is true. He knows that he tells the truth, that you may believe.
verses.John.19.36: For these things happened that the Scripture might be fulfilled, “A bone of him will not be broken.”
verses.John.19.37: Again another Scripture says, “They will look on him whom they pierced.”
verses.John.19.38: After these things, Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, asked of Pilate that he might take away Jesus’ body. Pilate gave him permission. He came therefore and took away his body.
verses.John.19.39: Nicodemus, who at first came to Jesus by night, also came bringing a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about a hundred Roman pounds.
verses.John.19.40: So they took Jesus’ body, and bound it in linen cloths with the spices, as the custom of the Jews is to bury.
verses.John.19.41: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden. In the garden was a new tomb in which no man had ever yet been laid.
verses.John.19.42: Then, because of the Jews’ Preparation Day (for the tomb was near at hand), they laid Jesus there.
verses.John.18.1: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went out with his disciples over the brook Kidron, where there was a garden, into which he and his disciples entered.
verses.John.18.2: Now Judas, who betrayed him, also knew the place, for Jesus often met there with his disciples.
verses.John.18.3: Judas then, having taken a detachment of soldiers and officers from the chief priests and the Pharisees, came there with lanterns, torches, and weapons.
verses.John.18.4: Jesus therefore, knowing all the things that were happening to him, went out and said to them, “Who are you looking for?”
verses.John.18.5: They answered him, “Jesus of Nazareth.” Jesus said to them, “I am he.” Judas also, who betrayed him, was standing with them.
verses.John.18.6: When therefore he said to them, “I am he,” they went backward and fell to the ground.
verses.John.18.7: Again therefore he asked them, “Who are you looking for?” They said, “Jesus of Nazareth.”
verses.John.18.8: Jesus answered, “I told you that I am he. If therefore you seek me, let these go their way,”
verses.John.18.9: that the word might be fulfilled which he spoke, “Of those whom you have given me, I have lost none.”
verses.John.18.10: Simon Peter therefore, having a sword, drew it, struck the high priest’s servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant’s name was Malchus.
verses.John.18.11: Jesus therefore said to Peter, “Put the sword into its sheath. The cup which the Father has given me, shall I not surely drink it?”
verses.John.18.12: So the detachment, the commanding officer, and the officers of the Jews seized Jesus and bound him,
verses.John.18.13: and led him to Annas first, for he was father-in-law to Caiaphas, who was high priest that year.
verses.John.18.14: Now it was Caiaphas who advised the Jews that it was expedient that one man should perish for the people.
verses.John.18.15: Simon Peter followed Jesus, as did another disciple. Now that disciple was known to the high priest, and entered in with Jesus into the court of the high priest;
verses.John.18.16: but Peter was standing at the door outside. So the other disciple, who was known to the high priest, went out and spoke to her who kept the door, and brought in Peter.
verses.John.18.17: Then the maid who kept the door said to Peter, “Are you also one of this man’s disciples?” He said, “I am not.”
verses.John.18.18: Now the servants and the officers were standing there, having made a fire of coals, for it was cold. They were warming themselves. Peter was with them, standing and warming himself.
verses.John.18.19: The high priest therefore asked Jesus about his disciples and about his teaching.
verses.John.18.20: Jesus answered him, “I spoke openly to the world. I always taught in synagogues and in the temple, where the Jews always meet. I said nothing in secret.
verses.John.18.21: Why do you ask me? Ask those who have heard me what I said to them. Behold, they know the things which I said.”
verses.John.18.22: When he had said this, one of the officers standing by slapped Jesus with his hand, saying, “Do you answer the high priest like that?”
verses.John.18.23: Jesus answered him, “If I have spoken evil, testify of the evil; but if well, why do you beat me?”
verses.John.18.24: Annas sent him bound to Caiaphas, the high priest.
verses.John.18.25: Now Simon Peter was standing and warming himself. They said therefore to him, “You aren’t also one of his disciples, are you?” He denied it and said, “I am not.”
verses.John.18.26: One of the servants of the high priest, being a relative of him whose ear Peter had cut off, said, “Didn’t I see you in the garden with him?”
verses.John.18.27: Peter therefore denied it again, and immediately the rooster crowed.
verses.John.18.28: They led Jesus therefore from Caiaphas into the Praetorium. It was early, and they themselves didn’t enter into the Praetorium, that they might not be defiled, but might eat the Passover.
verses.John.18.29: Pilate therefore went out to them and said, “What accusation do you bring against this man?”
verses.John.18.30: They answered him, “If this man weren’t an evildoer, we wouldn’t have delivered him up to you.”
verses.John.18.31: Pilate therefore said to them, “Take him yourselves, and judge him according to your law.” Therefore the Jews said to him, “It is illegal for us to put anyone to death,”
verses.John.18.32: that the word of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spoke, signifying by what kind of death he should die.
verses.John.18.33: Pilate therefore entered again into the Praetorium, called Jesus, and said to him, “Are you the King of the Jews?”
verses.John.18.34: Jesus answered him, “Do you say this by yourself, or did others tell you about me?”
verses.John.18.35: Pilate answered, “I’m not a Jew, am I? Your own nation and the chief priests delivered you to me. What have you done?”
verses.John.18.36: Jesus answered, “My Kingdom is not of this world. If my Kingdom were of this world, then my servants would fight, that I wouldn’t be delivered to the Jews. But now my Kingdom is not from here.”
verses.John.18.37: Pilate therefore said to him, “Are you a king then?” Jesus answered, “You say that I am a king. For this reason I have been born, and for this reason I have come into the world, that I should testify to the truth. Everyone who is of the truth listens to my voice.”
verses.John.18.38: Pilate said to him, “What is truth?” When he had said this, he went out again to the Jews, and said to them, “I find no basis for a charge against him.
verses.John.18.39: But you have a custom that I should release someone to you at the Passover. Therefore, do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”
verses.John.18.40: Then they all shouted again, saying, “Not this man, but Barabbas!” Now Barabbas was a robber.
verses.John.20.1: Now on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene went early, while it was still dark, to the tomb, and saw that the stone had been taken away from the tomb.
verses.John.20.2: Therefore she ran and came to Simon Peter and to the other disciple whom Jesus loved, and said to them, “They have taken away the Lord out of the tomb, and we don’t know where they have laid him!”
verses.John.20.3: Therefore Peter and the other disciple went out, and they went toward the tomb.
verses.John.20.4: They both ran together. The other disciple outran Peter and came to the tomb first.
verses.John.20.5: Stooping and looking in, he saw the linen cloths lying there; yet he didn’t enter in.
verses.John.20.6: Then Simon Peter came, following him, and entered into the tomb. He saw the linen cloths lying,
verses.John.20.7: and the cloth that had been on his head, not lying with the linen cloths, but rolled up in a place by itself.
verses.John.20.8: So then the other disciple who came first to the tomb also entered in, and he saw and believed.
verses.John.20.9: For as yet they didn’t know the Scripture, that he must rise from the dead.
verses.John.20.10: So the disciples went away again to their own homes.
verses.John.20.11: But Mary was standing outside at the tomb weeping. So as she wept, she stooped and looked into the tomb,
verses.John.20.12: and she saw two angels in white sitting, one at the head and one at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.
verses.John.20.13: They asked her, “Woman, why are you weeping?” She said to them, “Because they have taken away my Lord, and I don’t know where they have laid him.”
verses.John.20.14: When she had said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing, and didn’t know that it was Jesus.
verses.John.20.15: Jesus said to her, “Woman, why are you weeping? Who are you looking for?” She, supposing him to be the gardener, said to him, “Sir, if you have carried him away, tell me where you have laid him, and I will take him away.”
verses.John.20.16: Jesus said to her, “Mary.” She turned and said to him, “Rabboni!” which is to say, “Teacher!”
verses.John.20.17: Jesus said to her, “Don’t hold me, for I haven’t yet ascended to my Father; but go to my brothers and tell them, ‘I am ascending to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.’”
verses.John.20.18: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had said these things to her.
verses.John.20.19: When therefore it was evening on that day, the first day of the week, and when the doors were locked where the disciples were assembled, for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the middle and said to them, “Peace be to you.”
verses.John.20.20: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his side. The disciples therefore were glad when they saw the Lord.
verses.John.20.21: Jesus therefore said to them again, “Peace be to you. As the Father has sent me, even so I send you.”
verses.John.20.22: When he had said this, he breathed on them, and said to them, “Receive the Holy Spirit!
verses.John.20.23: If you forgive anyone’s sins, they have been forgiven them. If you retain anyone’s sins, they have been retained.”
verses.John.20.24: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, wasn’t with them when Jesus came.
verses.John.20.25: The other disciples therefore said to him, “We have seen the Lord!” But he said to them, “Unless I see in his hands the print of the nails, put my finger into the print of the nails, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe.”
verses.John.20.26: After eight days, again his disciples were inside and Thomas was with them. Jesus came, the doors being locked, and stood in the middle, and said, “Peace be to you.”
verses.John.20.27: Then he said to Thomas, “Reach here your finger, and see my hands. Reach here your hand, and put it into my side. Don’t be unbelieving, but believing.”
verses.John.20.28: Thomas answered him, “My Lord and my God!”
verses.John.20.29: Jesus said to him, “Because you have seen me, you have believed. Blessed are those who have not seen and have believed.”
verses.John.20.30: Therefore Jesus did many other signs in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book;
verses.John.20.31: but these are written that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that believing you may have life in his name.
verses.John.14.1: “Don’t let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.
verses.John.14.2: In my Father’s house are many homes. If it weren’t so, I would have told you. I am going to prepare a place for you.
verses.John.14.3: If I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again and will receive you to myself; that where I am, you may be there also.
verses.John.14.4: You know where I go, and you know the way.”
verses.John.14.5: Thomas said to him, “Lord, we don’t know where you are going. How can we know the way?”
verses.John.14.6: Jesus said to him, “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.
verses.John.14.7: If you had known me, you would have known my Father also. From now on, you know him and have seen him.”
verses.John.14.8: Philip said to him, “Lord, show us the Father, and that will be enough for us.”
verses.John.14.9: Jesus said to him, “Have I been with you such a long time, and do you not know me, Philip? He who has seen me has seen the Father. How do you say, ‘Show us the Father’?
verses.John.14.10: Don’t you believe that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? The words that I tell you, I speak not from myself; but the Father who lives in me does his works.
verses.John.14.11: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me; or else believe me for the very works’ sake.
verses.John.14.12: Most certainly I tell you, he who believes in me, the works that I do, he will do also; and he will do greater works than these, because I am going to my Father.
verses.John.14.13: Whatever you will ask in my name, I will do it, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
verses.John.14.14: If you will ask anything in my name, I will do it.
verses.John.14.15: If you love me, keep my commandments.
verses.John.14.16: I will pray to the Father, and he will give you another Counselor, that he may be with you forever:
verses.John.14.17: the Spirit of truth, whom the world can’t receive, for it doesn’t see him and doesn’t know him. You know him, for he lives with you and will be in you.
verses.John.14.18: I will not leave you orphans. I will come to you.
verses.John.14.19: Yet a little while, and the world will see me no more; but you will see me. Because I live, you will live also.
verses.John.14.20: In that day you will know that I am in my Father, and you in me, and I in you.
verses.John.14.21: One who has my commandments and keeps them, that person is one who loves me. One who loves me will be loved by my Father, and I will love him, and will reveal myself to him.”
verses.John.14.22: Judas (not Iscariot) said to him, “Lord, what has happened that you are about to reveal yourself to us, and not to the world?”
verses.John.14.23: Jesus answered him, “If a man loves me, he will keep my word. My Father will love him, and we will come to him and make our home with him.
verses.John.14.24: He who doesn’t love me doesn’t keep my words. The word which you hear isn’t mine, but the Father’s who sent me.
verses.John.14.25: “I have said these things to you while still living with you.
verses.John.14.26: But the Counselor, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you all things, and will remind you of all that I said to you.
verses.John.14.27: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, I give to you. Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.
verses.John.14.28: You heard how I told you, ‘I am going away, and I will come back to you.’ If you loved me, you would have rejoiced because I said ‘I am going to my Father;’ for the Father is greater than I.
verses.John.14.29: Now I have told you before it happens so that when it happens, you may believe.
verses.John.14.30: I will no more speak much with you, for the prince of the world comes, and he has nothing in me.
verses.John.14.31: But that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father commanded me, even so I do. Arise, let’s go from here.
verses.John.16.1: “I have said these things to you so that you wouldn’t be caused to stumble.
verses.John.16.2: They will put you out of the synagogues. Yes, the time is coming that whoever kills you will think that he offers service to God.
verses.John.16.3: They will do these things because they have not known the Father nor me.
verses.John.16.4: But I have told you these things so that when the time comes, you may remember that I told you about them. I didn’t tell you these things from the beginning, because I was with you.
verses.John.16.5: But now I am going to him who sent me, and none of you asks me, ‘Where are you going?’
verses.John.16.6: But because I have told you these things, sorrow has filled your heart.
verses.John.16.7: Nevertheless I tell you the truth: It is to your advantage that I go away; for if I don’t go away, the Counselor won’t come to you. But if I go, I will send him to you.
verses.John.16.8: When he has come, he will convict the world about sin, about righteousness, and about judgment;
verses.John.16.9: about sin, because they don’t believe in me;
verses.John.16.10: about righteousness, because I am going to my Father, and you won’t see me any more;
verses.John.16.11: about judgment, because the prince of this world has been judged.
verses.John.16.12: “I still have many things to tell you, but you can’t bear them now.
verses.John.16.13: However, when he, the Spirit of truth, has come, he will guide you into all truth, for he will not speak from himself; but whatever he hears, he will speak. He will declare to you things that are coming.
verses.John.16.14: He will glorify me, for he will take from what is mine and will declare it to you.
verses.John.16.15: All things that the Father has are mine; therefore I said that he takes of mine and will declare it to you.
verses.John.16.16: “A little while, and you will not see me. Again a little while, and you will see me.”
verses.John.16.17: Some of his disciples therefore said to one another, “What is this that he says to us, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me;’ and, ‘Because I go to the Father’?”
verses.John.16.18: They said therefore, “What is this that he says, ‘A little while’? We don’t know what he is saying.”
verses.John.16.19: Therefore Jesus perceived that they wanted to ask him, and he said to them, “Do you inquire among yourselves concerning this, that I said, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me’?
verses.John.16.20: Most certainly I tell you that you will weep and lament, but the world will rejoice. You will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will be turned into joy.
verses.John.16.21: A woman, when she gives birth, has sorrow because her time has come. But when she has delivered the child, she doesn’t remember the anguish any more, for the joy that a human being is born into the world.
verses.John.16.22: Therefore you now have sorrow, but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one will take your joy away from you.
verses.John.16.23: “In that day you will ask me no questions. Most certainly I tell you, whatever you may ask of the Father in my name, he will give it to you.
verses.John.16.24: Until now, you have asked nothing in my name. Ask, and you will receive, that your joy may be made full.
verses.John.16.25: “I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. But the time is coming when I will no more speak to you in figures of speech, but will tell you plainly about the Father.
verses.John.16.26: In that day you will ask in my name; and I don’t say to you that I will pray to the Father for you,
verses.John.16.27: for the Father himself loves you, because you have loved me, and have believed that I came from God.
verses.John.16.28: I came from the Father and have come into the world. Again, I leave the world and go to the Father.”
verses.John.16.29: His disciples said to him, “Behold, now you are speaking plainly, and using no figures of speech.
verses.John.16.30: Now we know that you know all things, and don’t need for anyone to question you. By this we believe that you came from God.”
verses.John.16.31: Jesus answered them, “Do you now believe?
verses.John.16.32: Behold, the time is coming, yes, and has now come, that you will be scattered, everyone to his own place, and you will leave me alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.
verses.John.16.33: I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have trouble; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.”
verses.John.13.1: Now before the feast of the Passover, Jesus, knowing that his time had come that he would depart from this world to the Father, having loved his own who were in the world, he loved them to the end.
verses.John.13.2: During supper, the devil having already put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, to betray him,
verses.John.13.3: Jesus, knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he came from God and was going to God,
verses.John.13.4: arose from supper, and laid aside his outer garments. He took a towel and wrapped a towel around his waist.
verses.John.13.5: Then he poured water into the basin, and began to wash the disciples’ feet and to wipe them with the towel that was wrapped around him.
verses.John.13.6: Then he came to Simon Peter. He said to him, “Lord, do you wash my feet?”
verses.John.13.7: Jesus answered him, “You don’t know what I am doing now, but you will understand later.”
verses.John.13.8: Peter said to him, “You will never wash my feet!” Jesus answered him, “If I don’t wash you, you have no part with me.”
verses.John.13.9: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head!”
verses.John.13.10: Jesus said to him, “Someone who has bathed only needs to have his feet washed, but is completely clean. You are clean, but not all of you.”
verses.John.13.11: For he knew him who would betray him; therefore he said, “You are not all clean.”
verses.John.13.12: So when he had washed their feet, put his outer garment back on, and sat down again, he said to them, “Do you know what I have done to you?
verses.John.13.13: You call me, ‘Teacher’ and ‘Lord.’ You say so correctly, for so I am.
verses.John.13.14: If I then, the Lord and the Teacher, have washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another’s feet.
verses.John.13.15: For I have given you an example, that you should also do as I have done to you.
verses.John.13.16: Most certainly I tell you, a servant is not greater than his lord, neither is one who is sent greater than he who sent him.
verses.John.13.17: If you know these things, blessed are you if you do them.
verses.John.13.18: I don’t speak concerning all of you. I know whom I have chosen; but that the Scripture may be fulfilled, ‘He who eats bread with me has lifted up his heel against me.’
verses.John.13.19: From now on, I tell you before it happens, that when it happens, you may believe that I am he.
verses.John.13.20: Most certainly I tell you, he who receives whomever I send, receives me; and he who receives me, receives him who sent me.”
verses.John.13.21: When Jesus had said this, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, “Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me.”
verses.John.13.22: The disciples looked at one another, perplexed about whom he spoke.
verses.John.13.23: One of his disciples, whom Jesus loved, was at the table, leaning against Jesus’ chest.
verses.John.13.24: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, and said to him, “Tell us who it is of whom he speaks.”
verses.John.13.25: He, leaning back, as he was, on Jesus’ chest, asked him, “Lord, who is it?”
verses.John.13.26: Jesus therefore answered, “It is he to whom I will give this piece of bread when I have dipped it.” So when he had dipped the piece of bread, he gave it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot.
verses.John.13.27: After the piece of bread, then Satan entered into him. Then Jesus said to him, “What you do, do quickly.”
verses.John.13.28: Now nobody at the table knew why he said this to him.
verses.John.13.29: For some thought, because Judas had the money box, that Jesus said to him, “Buy what things we need for the feast,” or that he should give something to the poor.
verses.John.13.30: Therefore having received that morsel, he went out immediately. It was night.
verses.John.13.31: When he had gone out, Jesus said, “Now the Son of Man has been glorified, and God has been glorified in him.
verses.John.13.32: If God has been glorified in him, God will also glorify him in himself, and he will glorify him immediately.
verses.John.13.33: Little children, I will be with you a little while longer. You will seek me, and as I said to the Jews, ‘Where I am going, you can’t come,’ so now I tell you.
verses.John.13.34: A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another. Just as I have loved you, you also love one another.
verses.John.13.35: By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another.”
verses.John.13.36: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, where are you going?” Jesus answered, “Where I am going, you can’t follow now, but you will follow afterwards.”
verses.John.13.37: Peter said to him, “Lord, why can’t I follow you now? I will lay down my life for you.”
verses.John.13.38: Jesus answered him, “Will you lay down your life for me? Most certainly I tell you, the rooster won’t crow until you have denied me three times.

verses.Matt.1.1: 亚伯拉罕的后裔，大卫的子孙 ，耶稣基督的家谱：
verses.Matt.1.2: 亚伯拉罕生以撒；以撒生雅各；雅各生犹大和他的弟兄；
verses.Matt.1.3: 犹大从她玛氏生法勒斯和谢拉；法勒斯生希斯 ；希斯 生亚兰；
verses.Matt.1.4: 亚兰生亚米拿达；亚米拿达生拿顺；拿顺生撒门；
verses.Matt.1.5: 撒门从喇合氏生波阿斯；波阿斯从路得氏生俄备得；俄备得生耶西；
verses.Matt.1.6: 耶西生大卫王。 大卫从乌利亚的妻子生所罗门；
verses.Matt.1.7: 所罗门生罗波安；罗波安生亚比雅；亚比雅生亚撒；
verses.Matt.1.8: 亚撒生约沙法；约沙法生约兰； 约兰生乌西雅；
verses.Matt.1.9: 乌西雅生约坦；约坦生亚哈斯；亚哈斯生希西家；
verses.Matt.1.10: 希西家生玛拿西；玛拿西生亚们；亚们生约西亚；
verses.Matt.1.11: 百姓被迁到巴比伦的时候，约西亚生耶哥尼雅和他的弟兄。
verses.Matt.1.12: 迁到巴比伦之后，耶哥尼雅生撒拉铁；撒拉铁生所罗巴伯；
verses.Matt.1.13: 所罗巴伯生亚比玉；亚比玉生以利亚敬；以利亚敬生亚所；
verses.Matt.1.14: 亚所生撒督；撒督生亚金；亚金生以律；
verses.Matt.1.15: 以律生以利亚撒；以利亚撒生马但；马但生雅各；
verses.Matt.1.16: 雅各生约瑟，就是马利亚的丈夫。那称为基督的耶稣是从马利亚生的。
verses.Matt.1.17: 这样，从亚伯拉罕到大卫共有十四代；从大卫到迁至巴比伦的时候也有十四代；从迁至巴比伦的时候到基督又有十四代。
verses.Matt.1.18: 耶稣基督降生的事记在下面：他母亲马利亚已经许配了约瑟，还没有迎娶，马利亚就从圣灵怀了孕。
verses.Matt.1.19: 她丈夫约瑟是个义人，不愿意明明地羞辱她，想要暗暗地把她休了。
verses.Matt.1.20: 正思念这事的时候，有主的使者向他梦中显现，说：「大卫的子孙约瑟，不要怕！只管娶过你的妻子马利亚来，因她所怀的孕是从圣灵来的。
verses.Matt.1.21: 她将要生一个儿子，你要给他起名叫耶稣，因他要将自己的百姓从罪恶里救出来。」
verses.Matt.1.22: 这一切的事成就是要应验主借先知所说的话，
verses.Matt.1.23:
说：
必有童女怀孕生子；
人要称他的名为以马内利。 （以马内利翻出来就是「　神与我们同在」。）
verses.Matt.1.24: 约瑟醒了，起来，就遵着主使者的吩咐把妻子娶过来；
verses.Matt.1.25: 只是没有和她同房，等她生了儿子 ，就给他起名叫耶稣。
verses.Matt.8.1: 耶稣下了山，有许多人跟着他。
verses.Matt.8.2: 有一个长大麻风的来拜他，说：「主若肯，必能叫我洁净了。」
verses.Matt.8.3: 耶稣伸手摸他，说：「我肯，你洁净了吧！」他的大麻风立刻就洁净了。
verses.Matt.8.4: 耶稣对他说：「你切不可告诉人，只要去把身体给祭司察看，献上摩西所吩咐的礼物，对众人作证据。」
verses.Matt.8.5: 耶稣进了迦百农，有一个百夫长进前来，求他说：
verses.Matt.8.6: 「主啊，我的仆人害瘫痪病，躺在家里，甚是疼苦。」
verses.Matt.8.8: 百夫长回答说：「主啊，你到我舍下，我不敢当；只要你说一句话，我的仆人就必好了。
verses.Matt.8.9: 因为我在人的权下，也有兵在我以下；对这个说『去！』他就去；对那个说『来！』他就来；对我的仆人说：『你做这事！』他就去做。」
verses.Matt.8.10: 耶稣听见就希奇，对跟从的人说：「我实在告诉你们，这么大的信心，就是在以色列中，我也没有遇见过。
verses.Matt.8.11: 我又告诉你们，从东从西，将有许多人来，在天国里与亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各一同坐席；
verses.Matt.8.12: 惟有本国的子民竟被赶到外边黑暗里去，在那里必要哀哭切齿了。」
verses.Matt.8.13: 耶稣对百夫长说：「你回去吧！照你的信心，给你成全了。」那时，他的仆人就好了。
verses.Matt.8.14: 耶稣到了彼得家里，见彼得的岳母害热病躺着。
verses.Matt.8.15: 耶稣把她的手一摸，热就退了；她就起来服事耶稣。
verses.Matt.8.16: 到了晚上，有人带着许多被鬼附的来到耶稣跟前，他只用一句话就把鬼都赶出去，并且治好了一切有病的人。
verses.Matt.8.17:
这是要应验先知以赛亚的话，说：
他代替我们的软弱，
担当我们的疾病。
verses.Matt.8.18: 耶稣见许多人围着他，就吩咐渡到那边去。
verses.Matt.8.19: 有一个文士来，对他说：「夫子，你无论往哪里去，我要跟从你。」
verses.Matt.8.20: 耶稣说：「狐狸有洞，天空的飞鸟有窝，人子却没有枕头的地方。」
verses.Matt.8.21: 又有一个门徒对耶稣说：「主啊，容我先回去埋葬我的父亲。」
verses.Matt.8.22: 耶稣说：「任凭死人埋葬他们的死人；你跟从我吧！」
verses.Matt.8.23: 耶稣上了船，门徒跟着他。
verses.Matt.8.24: 海里忽然起了暴风，甚至船被波浪掩盖；耶稣却睡着了。
verses.Matt.8.25: 门徒来叫醒了他，说：「主啊，救我们，我们丧命啦！」
verses.Matt.8.26: 耶稣说：「你们这小信的人哪，为什么胆怯呢？」于是起来，斥责风和海，风和海就大大地平静了。
verses.Matt.8.27: 众人希奇，说：「这是怎样的人？连风和海也听从他了！」
verses.Matt.8.28: 耶稣既渡到那边去，来到加大拉人的地方，就有两个被鬼附的人从坟茔里出来迎着他，极其凶猛，甚至没有人能从那条路上经过。
verses.Matt.8.29: 他们喊着说：「　神的儿子，我们与你有什么相干？时候还没有到，你就上这里来叫我们受苦吗？」
verses.Matt.8.30: 离他们很远，有一大群猪吃食。
verses.Matt.8.31: 鬼就央求耶稣，说：「若把我们赶出去，就打发我们进入猪群吧！」
verses.Matt.8.32: 耶稣说：「去吧！」鬼就出来，进入猪群。全群忽然闯下山崖，投在海里淹死了。
verses.Matt.8.33: 放猪的就逃跑进城，将这一切事和被鬼附的人所遭遇的都告诉人。
verses.Matt.8.34: 合城的人都出来迎见耶稣，既见了就央求他离开他们的境界。
verses.Matt.2.1: 当希律王的时候，耶稣生在犹太的伯利恒。有几个博士从东方来到耶路撒冷，说：
verses.Matt.2.2: 「那生下来作犹太人之王的在哪里？我们在东方看见他的星，特来拜他。」
verses.Matt.2.3: 希律王听见了，就心里不安；耶路撒冷合城的人也都不安。
verses.Matt.2.4: 他就召齐了祭司长和民间的文士，问他们说：「基督当生在何处？」
verses.Matt.2.5: 他们回答说：「在犹太的伯利恒。因为有先知记着，说：
verses.Matt.2.6:
犹大地的伯利恒啊，
你在犹大诸城中并不是最小的；
因为将来有一位君王要从你那里出来，
牧养我以色列民。」
verses.Matt.2.7: 当下，希律暗暗地召了博士来，细问那星是什么时候出现的，
verses.Matt.2.8: 就差他们往伯利恒去，说：「你们去仔细寻访那小孩子，寻到了就来报信，我也好去拜他。」
verses.Matt.2.9: 他们听见王的话就去了。在东方所看见的那星忽然在他们前头行，直行到小孩子的地方，就在上头停住了。
verses.Matt.2.10: 他们看见那星，就大大地欢喜；
verses.Matt.2.11: 进了房子，看见小孩子和他母亲马利亚，就俯伏拜那小孩子，揭开宝盒，拿黄金、乳香、没药为礼物献给他。
verses.Matt.2.12: 博士因为在梦中被主指示不要回去见希律，就从别的路回本地去了。
verses.Matt.2.13: 他们去后，有主的使者向约瑟梦中显现，说：「起来！带着小孩子同他母亲逃往埃及，住在那里，等我吩咐你；因为希律必寻找小孩子，要除灭他。」
verses.Matt.2.14: 约瑟就起来，夜间带着小孩子和他母亲往埃及去，
verses.Matt.2.15: 住在那里，直到希律死了。这是要应验主借先知所说的话，说：「我从埃及召出我的儿子来。」
verses.Matt.2.16: 希律见自己被博士愚弄，就大大发怒，差人将伯利恒城里并四境所有的男孩，照着他向博士仔细查问的时候，凡两岁以里的，都杀尽了。
verses.Matt.2.17: 这就应了先知耶利米的话，说：
verses.Matt.2.18:
在拉玛听见号咷大哭的声音，
是拉结哭她儿女，
不肯受安慰，
因为他们都不在了。
verses.Matt.2.19: 希律死了以后，有主的使者在埃及向约瑟梦中显现，说：
verses.Matt.2.20: 「起来！带着小孩子和他母亲往以色列地去，因为要害小孩子性命的人已经死了。」
verses.Matt.2.21: 约瑟就起来，把小孩子和他母亲带到以色列地去；
verses.Matt.2.22: 只因听见亚基老接着他父亲希律作了犹太王，就怕往那里去，又在梦中被主指示，便往加利利境内去了，
verses.Matt.2.23: 到了一座城，名叫拿撒勒，就住在那里。这是要应验先知所说，他将称为拿撒勒人的话了。
verses.Matt.3.1: 那时，有施洗的约翰出来，在犹太的旷野传道，说：
verses.Matt.3.3:
这人就是先知以赛亚所说的。他说：「在旷野有人声喊着说：
预备主的道，
修直他的路！」
verses.Matt.3.4: 这约翰身穿骆驼毛的衣服，腰束皮带，吃的是蝗虫、野蜜。
verses.Matt.3.5: 那时，耶路撒冷和犹太全地，并约旦河一带地方的人，都出去到约翰那里，
verses.Matt.3.6: 承认他们的罪，在约旦河里受他的洗。
verses.Matt.3.7: 约翰看见许多法利赛人和撒都该人也来受洗，就对他们说：「毒蛇的种类！谁指示你们逃避将来的愤怒呢？
verses.Matt.3.8: 你们要结出果子来，与悔改的心相称。
verses.Matt.3.9: 不要自己心里说：『有亚伯拉罕为我们的祖宗。』我告诉你们，　神能从这些石头中给亚伯拉罕兴起子孙来。
verses.Matt.3.10: 现在斧子已经放在树根上，凡不结好果子的树就砍下来，丢在火里。
verses.Matt.3.11: 我是用水给你们施洗，叫你们悔改。但那在我以后来的，能力比我更大，我就是给他提鞋也不配。他要用圣灵与火给你们施洗。
verses.Matt.3.12: 他手里拿着簸箕，要扬净他的场，把麦子收在仓里，把糠用不灭的火烧尽了。」
verses.Matt.3.13: 当下，耶稣从加利利来到约旦河，见了约翰，要受他的洗。
verses.Matt.3.14: 约翰想要拦住他，说：「我当受你的洗，你反倒上我这里来吗？」
verses.Matt.3.15: 耶稣回答说：「你暂且许我，因为我们理当这样尽诸般的义 。」于是约翰许了他。
verses.Matt.3.16: 耶稣受了洗，随即从水里上来。天忽然为他开了，他就看见　神的灵仿佛鸽子降下，落在他身上。
verses.Matt.3.17: 从天上有声音说：「这是我的爱子，我所喜悦的。」
verses.Matt.4.1: 当时，耶稣被圣灵引到旷野，受魔鬼的试探。
verses.Matt.4.2: 他禁食四十昼夜，后来就饿了。
verses.Matt.4.3: 那试探人的进前来，对他说：「你若是　神的儿子，可以吩咐这些石头变成食物。」
verses.Matt.4.4:
耶稣却回答说：「经上记着说：
人活着，不是单靠食物，
乃是靠　神口里所出的一切话。」
verses.Matt.4.5: 魔鬼就带他进了圣城，叫他站在殿顶 上，
verses.Matt.4.6:
对他说：「你若是　神的儿子，可以跳下去，因为经上记着说：
主要为你吩咐他的使者
用手托着你，
免得你的脚碰在石头上。」
verses.Matt.4.7: 耶稣对他说：「经上又记着说：『不可试探主—你的　神。』」
verses.Matt.4.8: 魔鬼又带他上了一座最高的山，将世上的万国与万国的荣华都指给他看，
verses.Matt.4.9: 对他说：「你若俯伏拜我，我就把这一切都赐给你。」
verses.Matt.4.10:
耶稣说：「撒但 ，退去吧！因为经上记着说：
当拜主—你的　神，
单要事奉他。」
verses.Matt.4.11: 于是，魔鬼离了耶稣，有天使来伺候他。
verses.Matt.4.12: 耶稣听见约翰下了监，就退到加利利去；
verses.Matt.4.13: 后又离开拿撒勒，往迦百农去，就住在那里。那地方靠海，在西布伦和拿弗他利的边界上。
verses.Matt.4.14: 这是要应验先知以赛亚的话，
verses.Matt.4.15:
说：
西布伦地，拿弗他利地，
就是沿海的路，约旦河外，
外邦人的加利利地—
verses.Matt.4.16:
那坐在黑暗里的百姓看见了大光；
坐在死荫之地的人有光发现照着他们。
verses.Matt.4.17: 从那时候，耶稣就传起道来，说：「天国近了，你们应当悔改！」
verses.Matt.4.18: 耶稣在加利利海边行走，看见弟兄二人，就是那称呼彼得的西门和他兄弟安得烈，在海里撒网；他们本是打鱼的。
verses.Matt.4.19: 耶稣对他们说：「来跟从我，我要叫你们得人如得鱼一样。」
verses.Matt.4.20: 他们就立刻舍了网，跟从了他。
verses.Matt.4.21: 从那里往前走，又看见弟兄二人，就是西庇太的儿子雅各和他兄弟约翰，同他们的父亲西庇太在船上补网，耶稣就招呼他们，
verses.Matt.4.22: 他们立刻舍了船，别了父亲，跟从了耶稣。
verses.Matt.4.23: 耶稣走遍加利利，在各会堂里教训人，传天国的福音，医治百姓各样的病症。
verses.Matt.4.24: 他的名声就传遍了叙利亚。那里的人把一切害病的，就是害各样疾病、各样疼痛的和被鬼附的、癫痫的、瘫痪的，都带了来，耶稣就治好了他们。
verses.Matt.4.25: 当下，有许多人从加利利、低加坡里、耶路撒冷、犹太、约旦河外来跟着他。
verses.Matt.7.1: 「你们不要论断人，免得你们被论断。
verses.Matt.7.2: 因为你们怎样论断人，也必怎样被论断；你们用什么量器量给人，也必用什么量器量给你们。
verses.Matt.7.3: 为什么看见你弟兄眼中有刺，却不想自己眼中有梁木呢？
verses.Matt.7.4: 你自己眼中有梁木，怎能对你弟兄说：『容我去掉你眼中的刺』呢？
verses.Matt.7.5: 你这假冒为善的人！先去掉自己眼中的梁木，然后才能看得清楚，去掉你弟兄眼中的刺。
verses.Matt.7.6: 不要把圣物给狗，也不要把你们的珍珠丢在猪前，恐怕它践踏了珍珠，转过来咬你们。」
verses.Matt.7.7: 「你们祈求，就给你们；寻找，就寻见；叩门，就给你们开门。
verses.Matt.7.8: 因为凡祈求的，就得着；寻找的，就寻见；叩门的，就给他开门。
verses.Matt.7.9: 你们中间谁有儿子求饼，反给他石头呢？
verses.Matt.7.11: 你们虽然不好，尚且知道拿好东西给儿女，何况你们在天上的父，岂不更把好东西给求他的人吗？
verses.Matt.7.12: 所以，无论何事，你们愿意人怎样待你们，你们也要怎样待人，因为这就是律法和先知的道理。」
verses.Matt.7.13: 「你们要进窄门。因为引到灭亡，那门是宽的，路是大的，进去的人也多；
verses.Matt.7.14: 引到永生，那门是窄的，路是小的，找着的人也少。」
verses.Matt.7.15: 「你们要防备假先知。他们到你们这里来，外面披着羊皮，里面却是残暴的狼。
verses.Matt.7.16: 凭着他们的果子，就可以认出他们来。荆棘上岂能摘葡萄呢？蒺藜里岂能摘无花果呢？
verses.Matt.7.17: 这样，凡好树都结好果子，惟独坏树结坏果子。
verses.Matt.7.18: 好树不能结坏果子；坏树不能结好果子。
verses.Matt.7.19: 凡不结好果子的树就砍下来，丢在火里。
verses.Matt.7.20: 所以，凭着他们的果子就可以认出他们来。」
verses.Matt.7.21: 「凡称呼我『主啊，主啊』的人不能都进天国；惟独遵行我天父旨意的人才能进去。
verses.Matt.7.22: 当那日必有许多人对我说：『主啊，主啊，我们不是奉你的名传道，奉你的名赶鬼，奉你的名行许多异能吗？』
verses.Matt.7.23: 我就明明地告诉他们说：『我从来不认识你们，你们这些作恶的人，离开我去吧！』」
verses.Matt.7.24: 「所以，凡听见我这话就去行的，好比一个聪明人，把房子盖在磐石上；
verses.Matt.7.25: 雨淋，水冲，风吹，撞着那房子，房子总不倒塌，因为根基立在磐石上。
verses.Matt.7.26: 凡听见我这话不去行的，好比一个无知的人，把房子盖在沙土上；
verses.Matt.7.27: 雨淋，水冲，风吹，撞着那房子，房子就倒塌了，并且倒塌得很大。」
verses.Matt.7.28: 耶稣讲完了这些话，众人都希奇他的教训；
verses.Matt.7.29: 因为他教训他们，正像有权柄的人，不像他们的文士。
verses.Matt.10.1: 耶稣叫了十二个门徒来，给他们权柄，能赶逐污鬼，并医治各样的病症。
